verses.t: Awa ndi mayina a ana a Isiraeli — omwe ndi Yakobo — amene adabwera ku Igupito ndi abambo awo, aliyense ndi banja lake:
Rubeni, Simeoni, Lawi, Yuda,
Isakara, Zebuloni, Benjamini,
Dani, Nafitali, Gadi, ndi Aseri.
Pakuwerengera, Yakobo anali ndi zidzukulu makumi asanu ndi awiri ku Igupito, kuphatikiza Yosefe amene anali kumeneko kale.
Patapita nthawi, Yosefe ndi abale ake onse anamwalira, kupereza mibadwo yonse imeneyo.
Koma zidzukulu zawo, Aisraeli, anachuluka kwambiri, nabirikirika mosadziwa muyeso. Anadzala ndi mphamvu ndiponso anadzaza dziko lonse.
Kenaka mfumu yatsopano inabwera ku Igupito — imene sinkadziwa kanthu konse za Yosefe ndi zimene anachita.
Inauza anthu ake, 'Taonani, anthu a Isiraeli atsala pang'ono kutiposera ndiponso ali amphamvu kuposa ife.
Tiyenera kukonza chano choti tiwaletse kuchuluka. Ngati sitidzachita choncho, ndipo ngati nkhondo idzabuka, iwo adzagwirizana ndi adani athu natimenyana. Ndipo akatero adzathawa dziko.'

Choncho aEgipito anapanga Aisraeli akapolo. Anawika asilikali owaopseza pa iwo, kufuna kuwatopetsa ndi ntchito yovuta. Anawalazga kumanga mizinda ya Pithimu ndi Rameses ngati malo osungira katundu a mfumu.
Koma anthu anachulukabe mitundu mitundu, moopsyetsa aEgipito.
Choncho aEgipito anachita Aisraeli ntchito molakwa ndi chisoni chilichonse.
Anapanga moyo wawo kukhala wowawa, nawachitisa ntchito yovuta ya odula njerwa ndi madenga, ndiponso ntchito zonse za m'minda. Ndithu, anawachitiritsa chilichonse mwamphamvu.
Ndipo Farao, mfumu ya Igupito, anauza azamidwife aHebri, Shifira ndi Pua:
Mukamathandiza amayi aHebri kubereka, onetsetsani pomabadwa. Ngati ndi mwana wamwamuna, mumuphere; ngati ndi mwana wamkazi, mumulikitse.
Koma azamidwife anaopa Mulungu, ndipo sanachite monga mfumu inawauza. Anapulumutsa ana aamwamuna onse.
Choncho mfumu ya Igupito idayitana azamidwife. 'N'chifukwa chiyani mwachita izi?' inafunsa. 'N'chifukwa chiyani munapulumutsa ana aamwamuna?'
Amayi aHebri si ngati amayi aEgipito,' azamidwife anayankha. 'Amachita bwino kwambiri ndiponso amabadwa msanga, moti titafika, mwana wabadwera kale.
Mulungu anachitira zabwino azamidwife aja, ndipo Aisraeli anachulukabe, nakula ndi mphamvu.
Ndipo chifukwa azamidwife anaopa Mulungu, Iye anawapatsa mabanja awo.
Pamenepo Farao analamula anthu ake onse: 'Ponyani mwana wamwamuna aliyense wobadwa wa Ahebri mu Naili. Koma ana aakazi muwalikitse.'
Pa nthawi imeneyo, mwamuna wina wa fuko la Lawi anakwatira mkazi wa fuko lomwelo.
Mkazi anatenga pakati nabala mwana wamwamuna. Ataona kuti anali wokongola, namubisa miyezi itatu.
Koma ataona kuti sanakwanise kumubisa nthawi yaitali, anakonza dengu la papyrus nakhadzitira ndi nsupa ndi utaka. Naika mwana m'dengu, nauyika pakati pa matsanga m'mbali mwa Naili.
Mlongo wa mwana adaimirira patali kuti aone zimene zidzamchitikira.
Patapita pang'ono mwana wa Farao adatsika kukucha m'mtsinje, ndipo akapolo ake anamuka m'mphepete mwa Naili. Mfumuyo ataona dengu pakati pa mtsanga, anatuma mzimu wake kukatenga.
Mfumu inatsegula dengu — ndi mwana! Mwana wosakula analira, ndipo inachita chifundo naye. 'Uyu ndi mwana wa aHebri,' inauza.
Pamenepo mlongo wa mwana anafika kwa mfumu. 'Kodi ndiyende kukafunira mkazi waHebri wosonkha kuti akamuyamwitse mwana?' anafunsa.
'Inde, pitako!' mfumu inayankha. Mtsikanayu anapita nakayitana mayi wake mwana.
'Tenga mwana uyu ukamuyamwitse,' mfumu inauza mayi wa mwana. 'Ndidzakupatsa malipiro.' Mkazi anatenga mwanawo nawubweretsa kunyumba, nakayamwitsa.
Mwana atakula, mayi wake amubweretsa kwa mwana wa Farao, amene anamtenga ngati mwana wake. Mfumu inammitcha Mose, itanena kuti, 'Namukwatula m'madzi.'
Patapita zaka zambiri, Mose atakula, anapita kukawona anthu ake aHebri, nakuona momwe ankagwiririra ntchito. Pamenepo anaona Mwigupito akumenyera mnzake Mhebri.
Atayangana mbali zonse kuti aone ngati pali wina, Mose anapha Mwigupito namubisa m'mchenga.
M'mawa wake Mose atapitanso, anaona aHebri awiri akumenyana. 'N'chifukwa chiyani umenyera mnzako?' anafunsa amene anayamba.
Ndani akuika uthawi ndi woweruza patikhu?' munthu anayankha. 'Kodi ufuna kundipha monga unapha Mwigupito uja?' Pamenepo Mose anachita mantha, naganiza kuti, 'Choncho, anthu adziwa zimene ndinachita.
Ndithu, Farao anakumana ndi nkhaniyi nayang'ana kupherana Mose. Koma Mose anathawa kwa Farao napita kukhala ku Midiani. Atafika ku Midiani, anakhala pafupi ndi chitsime.
Wansembe wa ku Midiani anali ndi ana aakazi asanu ndi awiri amene anabwera kukateka madzi kuzadza zigwa za nkhumba ya abambo awo.
Koma akhobiti ena anabwera nawapilikitsira. Pamenepo Mose anaimirira ndi kuwateteza ana aakazi aja, ndipo iye akateka madzi kwa nkhumba yawo.
Ana aakazi aja atabwera kwa Reueli, abambo awo, iye anafunsa, 'N'chifukwa chiyani mwabwera msanga lero?'
Mwigupito unatipulumutsa ku akhobiti,' iwo anayankha. 'Ndipo anakateka madzi, nawithira nkhumba.
'Kodi ali kuti?' abambo anafunsa. 'N'chifukwa chiyani munamusiya? Mumuitane kuti akabwere kudya nafe.'
Mose anagwirizana kukhalako naye. Pa nthawi yake, Reueli anapatsa Mose mwana wake wamkazi Zipora kukhala mkazi wake.
Kenaka Zipora anabala mwana wamwamuna, ndipo Mose anammitcha Geresomu, ponena kuti, 'Ndakhala mlendo m'dziko la alendo.'
Patapita zaka zambiri, mfumu ya Igupito inamwalira. Aisraeli ankadandaula chifukwa cha ukapolo wawo, nakulira chithandizo. Kulira kwawo kwadzera kwa Mulungu.
Mulungu anakumva kudandaula kwawo, ndipo anakumbukira pangano lake ndi Abrahamu, Isaki, ndi Yakobo.
Mulungu anasunthira maso ake Aisraeli, ndipo anadziwa kuti nthawi inafika.
Tsiku lina Mose anali kusunga nkhumba ya Jetiro, abambo ake apakwati, wansembe wa ku Midiani. Anatsogola nkhumba kutchire kwakutali nakafika ku Sinai, phiri la Mulungu.
Kumeneko mngelo wa Yehova anaonekera kwa iye m'moto wolawika mkati mwa bwinja. Mose anayang'anitsitsa mwakudabwa. Ngakhale bwinja linatentha, silimapya.
Zimenezi n'zodabwitsa!' Mose anauza yekha. 'N'chifukwa chiyani bwinja liri kutentha koma silipya? Ndiyenera kupita kukaona.
Yehova ataona Mose akubwera kukaona, Mulungu anamuyitana kuchokera pakati mwa bwinja. 'Mose! Mose!' Mose anayankha, 'Ndili pano!'
'Usabwere pafupi,' Yehova anachenjeza. 'Suta nsapato zako, pakuti uimirira pa malo oyera.
Ndine Mulungu wa abambo ako — Mulungu wa Abrahamu, Mulungu wa Isaki, ndi Mulungu wa Yakobo.' Mose atazmva izi, anabisa nkhope yake, chifukwa anaopa kuyang'ana Mulungu.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Ndithu, ndaona mazunzo a anthu anga ku Igupito. Ndakumva kulira kwawo chifukwa cha asilikali awo ovuta. Inde, ndidziwa ululu wawo.

Choncho ndatsika kudzawapulumutsa ku manja a aEgipito ndikuwatsogolera kutuluka ku Igupito kupita m'dziko lawo lokongola ndi lalifupi. Ndi dziko loyenda mkaka ndi uchi — m'dziko kumene aKanani, aHiti, aAmori, aPerezi, aHivi, ndi aYebusi akukhalamo.
Taona! Kulira kwa anthu a Isiraeli kwanifika, ndipo ndaona momwe aEgipito akuwazunzira.
Tsopano pita, pakuti ndi ine ndikutuma kwa Farao. Uyenera kutsogolera anthu anga Isiraeli kutuluka ku Igupito.'
Koma Mose anakanena kwa Mulungu, 'Ndine ndani kuti ndikasonkhane ndi Farao? Ndine ndani kuti nditsogolere Aisraeli kutuluka ku Igupito?'
Mulungu anayankha, 'Ndidzakhala nawe. Ndipo ichi ndi chizindikiro chakuti ine ndakutuma: Ukadzatulutsa anthu ku Igupito, mudzalambira Mulungu pa phiri ili.'
Koma Mose anakananso, 'Ndikasiya anthu a Isiraeli ndinene, "Mulungu wa makolo anu wandituma kwa inu," iwo adzanifunsa, "Dzina lake ndi chiyani?" Ndidzawauza chiyani?'
Mulungu anayankha Mose, 'NDINE AMENE NDIRI. Uzinena kwa anthu a Isiraeli kuti: NDIRI watuma ine kwa inu.'

Mulungu anapitiriza kunena kwa Mose, 'Uzinena kwa anthu a Isiraeli kuti: Yehova, Mulungu wa makolo anu — Mulungu wa Abrahamu, Mulungu wa Isaki, ndi Mulungu wa Yakobo — wandituma kwa inu. Ichi ndi dzina langa mpaka muyaya; ichi ndi dzina langa la kukumbukira mibadwo yonse.

'Pita tsopano ukasonkhanitze akulu onse a Isiraeli. Uwauze, "Yehova, Mulungu wa makolo anu — Mulungu wa Abrahamu, Isaki, ndi Yakobo — anaunika kwa ine. Anauza kuti, 'Ndakusulirani ndikuona momwe aEgipito akukuchitirirani.
Ndalonjeza kukutulutsani ku mazunzo a ku Igupito, ndikutsogolerani ku dziko loyenda mkaka ndi uchi — kumene aKanani, aHiti, aAmori, aPerezi, aHivi, ndi aYebusi akukhalamo."

Akulu a Isiraeli adzamvera mawu ako. Ndipo iwe pamodzi ndi akulu uyenera kupita kwa mfumu ya Igupito ndinena, "Yehova, Mulungu wa aHebri, wachitikirira ife. Choncho tikukuomba kuti utilole kufika ulendo wa masiku atatu kutchire kukapereka nsembe kwa Yehova Mulungu wathu."
'Koma ine ndidziwa kuti mfumu ya Igupito sidzakukusiyani kupita — ai, mwai manja amphamvu ngayi.
Choncho ndidzawonjezera dzanja langa ndikumenyera aEgipito, ndikuchita zodabwitsa zonse pakati pawo. Pamenepo adzakusiyani kupita.
Ndipo ndidzapangitsa aEgipito kuona Aisraeli ndi maso a chisoni. Adzakupatsa mphatso mukanyamuka — simudzatuluka manja atalala.

Mayi aliyense wa Isiraeli adzapemba kwa mnansi wake wa mEgipito ndi kwa akazi akunja okhalamo, zinthu za siliva ndi golide ndi zovala. Mudzaveka ana anu aamwamuna ndi aakazi nawo, kuchotsa chuma aEgipito.'
Koma Mose anakananso, 'Kodi ngati iwo sadzandikhulupirira kapena kumvera? Ngati anena, "Yehova sanakuonekere kwa iwe"?'
Pamenepo Yehova anamufunsa, 'Ndi chiyani cha m'dzanja lako?' 'Ndodo,' Mose anayankha.
'Iyiponya pansi,' Yehova anamuuza. Choncho Mose anaponya ndodo, naisintha kukhala njoka! Mose anathamanga.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Yolora ukagwire m'mchira wake.' Mose anayolora nakagwira, naisintha kubweranso kukhala ndodo m'dzanja lake.
Yatha chizindikiro ichi,' Yehova anauza Mose, 'ndipo iwo adzakhulupirira kuti Yehova, Mulungu wa makolo awo — Mulungu wa Abrahamu, Mulungu wa Isaki, ndi Mulungu wa Yakobo — ndithu anaonekera kwa iwe.
Kenaka Yehova anauza Mose, 'Tsopano ikha dzanja lako mkati mwa chovala chako.' Mose anaikha dzanja lake mkati, ndi pamene analizitula, dzanja lake linafiira ngati thenga — chidwala chomfa.
'Bwezera dzanja lako mkati mwa chovala,' Yehova anauza. Mose analiika mkati, ndipo analitulula — linawoneraso ngati thupi lake linalosali.
Yehova anauza Mose, 'Ngati sadzakhulupirira kapena kumvera chizindikiro choyamba, adzakhulupirira chizindikiro chachiwiri.
Ngati sadzakhulupirira ngakhale zizindikiro izi ziwiri, tenga madzi ku Naili uponyere pansi. Madzi a Naili adzasinthika kukhala magazi pa nthaka youma.'
Koma Mose anakana kwa Yehova, 'Pepani, Ambuye. Sindine wokwanira kuyankhula. Sinkadali ndi luso limeneli ndi kale, ndipo sizinabwere, ngakhale wayankhula ndi ine. Lilime langa limbakangomanga.'
Pamenepo Yehova anafunsa Mose, 'Ndani apanga khutu la munthu? Ndani atsimikizira kuti anthu ayankhula kapena asamayankhule, amve kapena asamve, aone kapena asamaone? Si ine, Yehova?
Tsopano pita! Ndidzakhala nawe ukayankhula, ndipo ndidzakuphunzitsa zimene uyenera kunena.'
Koma Mose anakananso, 'Ambuye, ndakukombera! Tumiza munthu wina aliyense.'
Pamenepo Yehova anakwiya ndi Mose. 'Kodi mlongo wako Aroni, Mlawi, si ndi luso la kuyankhula? Ndipo taona, akubwera kuzakukumana nawe. Adzasangalala kukuona.
Yankhula naye umike mawu m'kamwa mwake. Ndidzakhala ndi ninuyo mukayankhula, ndipo ndidzakuphunzitsa inu awiri zimene muyenera kuchita.
Aroni adzayankhula kwa anthu m'malo mwako. Iye adzakhala kwa iwe ngati kamwa, ndipo iwe udzakhala kwa iye ngati Mulungu, ukummuuza zimene uyenera kunena.
Tenga ndodo yako udzathera zizindikiro za zodabwitsa zimene ndakuonetsa.'
Choncho Mose anabwerera kwa Jetiro, abambo ake apakwati. 'Ndiloleni ndibwerenso kwa abale anga ku Igupito,' Mose anauza. 'Sindikudziwa ngati akukhala moyo.' 'Pita ndi mtendere,' Jetiro anayankha.
Mose asananyamuke ku Midiani, Yehova anauza, 'Bwerera ku Igupito, pakuti onse amene anafuna kukupha akwana mfu.'
Choncho Mose anatenga mkazi wake ndi ana ake, nawaikira pa bulu, nabwerera ku Igupito. M'dzanja lake ankanyamula ndodo ya Mulungu.
Yehova anauza Mose, 'Ukafika ku Igupito, uzichita zodabwitsa zonse zimene ndakupatsa mphamvu zazo pamaso pa Farao. Koma ndidzolimbitsa mtima wake kuti asakatule anthu.
Ndipo uzinene Farao, "Yehova akuti tere: Isiraeli ndi mwana wanga woyamba kubadwa.
Ndakuuza kuti, 'Katula mwana wanga kuti azindilambire.' Koma uchikana, choncho tsopano ndidzapha mwana wako woyamba kubadwa!"
Pa ulendo kupita ku Igupito, pa malo kumene Mose ndi banja lake anayimirira usiku, Yehova ankamupezera ndipo anafuna kumpha.
Koma Zipora, mkazi wa Mose, anatenga theka la mwala nasala mwana wawo. Nalikangamiza m'mapazi a Mose nanena, 'Tsopano ndiwe wokwatiwa ndi magazi kwa ine.'
(Polankhula 'wokwatiwa ndi magazi,' ankalankhula za mdulidwe.) Atatero Yehova anamusiira.
Tsopano Yehova anauza Aroni, 'Pita kutchire kukakumana ndi Mose.' Aroni anapita nakakumana ndi Mose pa phiri la Mulungu, nakwatirana.
Mose anauza Aroni zonse zimene Yehova anauza kuti anene, ndi zizindikiro zonse za zodabwitsa zimene iye anamulamula kuchita.
Pamenepo Mose ndi Aroni anabwerera ku Igupito nakasonkhanitza akulu onse a Isiraeli.
Aroni anauza onse zimene Yehova anauza Mose, ndipo Mose anachita zizindikiro za zodabwitsa pamaso pawo.
Pamenepo anthu a Isiraeli anakhulupirira. Atamuva Yehova anali ndi nkhawa zawo ndi kuzindikira mazunzo awo, anagwada pansi nalambira.

Pambuyo pa kuwonetsera nkhaniyi kwa akulu a Isiraeli, Mose ndi Aroni anapita kwa Farao nannena, 'Yehova, Mulungu wa Isiraeli, akuti: Katula anthu anga kuti akachite chikondwerero m'dzina langa kutchire.'
'Ndani Yehova?' Farao anayankha mochidwala. 'N'chifukwa chiyani ndimve mawu ake ndikature Isiraeli? Sindikudziwa Yehova, ndipo sizikatula Isiraeli.'

Koma Aroni ndi Mose anakananso. 'Mulungu wa aHebri watichitikirira,' iwo anauza. 'Choncho tikulomba kuti utilole kupita ulendo wa masiku atatu kutchire kukapereka nsembe kwa Yehova Mulungu wathu. Akazotera, adzatipha ndi mliri kapena lupanga.'
Farao anayankha, 'Mose ndi Aroni, n'chifukwa chiyani mukusokoneza anthu pa ntchito zawo? Bwererani ku ntchito yanu!
Taonani, anthu anu ndi ochuluka m'dziko muno, ndipo inu mukuwalekanitsitsa ndi ntchito zawo.'
Tsiku lomwelo Farao anapereka lamulo ili kwa akupereka ntchito yawo aEgipito ndi alangizi aIsiraeli:
'Musalipe njerwa yoti iwe m'mala mwa ziduli zake. Apangidwire azitenga okha!
Koma akakamizireni kupanga chipande chomwecho chidali. Musamuchepetse chiwerengero. Ndi olema, nthawi ndiyo amachita kuja, "Tituluke, tikaperekere nsembe Mulungu wathu."
Akakamizireni ntchito yoposa, kuti agwire mosangalala. Asamve miseche!'
Choncho akupereka ntchito ndi alangizi anapita kwa anthu nanena, 'Farao akuti tere: Sidzakupekereni njerwa.
Pitani muzitenga nokha. Mkateseni m'khomali linalose. Koma chiwerengero cha ziduli sichichepetsa!'
Choncho anthu anabalalika m'dziko lonse la Igupito kukafunafuna chipabi m'malo mwa njerwa.
Akupereka ntchito ankawakakamiza mwamphamvu. 'Uzuzani chiwerengero cha ziduli nsiku ndi nsiku, monga munachitira polandira njerwa!' ankalamulira.
Kenaka anakamenyetsa alangizi a Isiraeli amene akupereka ntchito anawaikira kupereka ntchito iwo. 'N'chifukwa chiyani simunathe chiwerengero cha ziduli dzulo kapena lero?' ankawalamulira.
Choncho alangizi a Isiraeli anapita kwa Farao nakamulomba. 'Musatichite ife akapolo anu motere,' anakamba.
Sitipatsidwa njerwa, koma akupereka ntchito akuyankhula, "Pangani ziduli!" Ndi ife amene tikusweka, koma si chiphaso chathu! Anthu anu ndi omwe ali ndi cholakwa!
Koma Farao anafuwula, 'Ndi olema, mwini mwina muno! Motero mukuti, "Tituluke tikapereke nsembe kwa Yehova."
Tsopano bwererani ku ntchito yanu! Njerwa sidzakuperekedwa, koma mudzapereka chiwerengero chathunthu cha ziduli.'
Alangizi a Isiraeli anaona kuti anali m'chisautso chachikulu atauzidwa, 'Simudzacheputsa chiwerengero cha ziduli nsiku ndi nsiku.'
Pamene anatuluka ku bwalo la Farao, anakumana ndi Mose ndi Aroni amene ankawadikira kunja.
Alangizi anauza iwo, 'Yehova akuweruze nakupatseni chilango chanu! Mwatipangitsa kunyansa kwa Farao ndi antchito ake. Mwaika lupanga m'manja mwawo kuti tipha!'
Pamenepo Mose anabwerera kwa Yehova nakana, 'Ambuye, n'chifukwa chiyani wabweretsa zobvuta izi kwa anthu anu? N'chifukwa chiyani wandituma?
Kuyambira nditafika kwa Farao kulankhula m'dzina lako, iye wazunzitsa anthu anu atoposa. Ndipo inu simunathandize kalikonse kuwapulumutsa!'
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Tsopano udzaona zimene ndidzachita kwa Farao. Adzakakamizidwa ndi dzanja langa lamphamvu kutula anthu. Ndithu, iye adzawapilikitsira kutuluka m'dziko lake!'
Ndipo Mulungu anauza Mose, 'Ndine Yehova.
Ndinaonekera kwa Abrahamu, Isaki, ndi Yakobo ngati Mulungu Wamphamvu — koma sindinawulure dzina langa Yehova kwa iwo.
Ndiponso ndinatsimikizira pangano langa nawo. M'munsi mwake, ndinaalonjeza kuwapatsa dziko la Kanani, kumene ankakhala ngati alendo.
Tsopano ndakumva kugaagaa kwa anthu a Isiraeli, amene aEgipito akuwasanda ukapolo. Ndipo ndijakumbukira pangano langa nawo.
'Choncho uze anthu a Isiraeli kuti: Ndine Yehova. Ndidzakunyamutsani ku mazunzo anu ndikukupulumutsani ku ukapolo ku Igupito. Ndidzakuombola ndi dzanja lamphamvu ndi miyeso yachilungamo.
Ndidzakutenga kukhala anthu anga, ndipo ndidzakhala Mulungu wanu. Pamenepo mudziwa kuti ndine Yehova Mulungu wanu amene wakutulutsani ku mazunzo a ku Igupito.
Ndidzakubwererani ku dziko limene ndinalumbira kupatsa Abrahamu, Isaki, ndi Yakobo. Ndidzalipatsa inu ngati cholowa. Ndine Yehova!'
Choncho Mose anauza anthu a Isiraeli zimene Yehova anauza, koma iwo sanamve. Ukapolo unkawapwetekera mtima kwambiri, ndipo anali opanda mphamvu za kumvera.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose,
'Pita, ukalankhulirane ndi Farao, mfumu ya Igupito, kuti atulute anthu a Isiraeli m'dziko lake.'
'Koma Ambuye!' Mose anakana. 'Anthu anga aIsiraeli sanandimve. N'chifukwa chiyani Farao adzandimva? Ine sindine wokwanira kuyankhula!'
Koma Yehova analankhula ndi Mose ndi Aroni, nawauza lamulo kwa Aisraeli ndi kwa Farao, mfumu ya Igupito — kutsogolera anthu a Isiraeli kutuluka ku Igupito.
Awa ndi mafuko a Isiraeli monga akafunidwe m'mbadwo: Ana a Rubeni, woyamba kubadwa wa Isiraeli, anali Hanoki, Pallu, Hezironi, ndi Karami. Awa ndi mabanja a Rubeni.
Ana a Simeoni anali Yemueli, Yamini, Ohadi, Yakini, Zohara, ndi Sauli. (Mayi a Sauli anali mzokazi wakuKanani.) Awa ndi mabanja a Simeoni.
Awa ndi zidzukulu za Lawi monga zikalembedwa m'mbadwo wawo: Ana a Lawi anali Geresoni, Kohati, ndi Merari. (Lawi anakhalamo zaka zana ndi makumi atatu ndi asanu ndi awiri.)
Zidzukulu za Geresoni zinali Libini ndi Simei, aliyense kukhala ndi mabanja awo.
Zidzukulu za Kohati zinali Amaramu, Izihara, Hebironi, ndi Uzieli. (Kohati anakhalamo zaka zana ndi makumi atatu ndi atatu.)
Zidzukulu za Merari zinali Mahali ndi Musi. Awa ndi mabanja a Lawi monga kalembedwe m'mbadwo wawo.
Amaramu anakwatira Yokebed, mchemwali wa abambo ake, ndipo iye anabereka Aroni ndi Mose. (Amaramu anakhalamo zaka zana ndi makumi atatu ndi asanu ndi awiri.)
Ana a Izihara anali Kora, Nefegi, ndi Zikiri.
Ana a Uzieli anali Misaeli, Elizafani, ndi Sitiri.
Aroni anakwatira Elisheba, mwana wa Aminadabu ndi mchemwali wa Nahisoni, ndipo iye anabereka Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazara, ndi Itamara.
Ana a Kora anali Asira, Elekana, ndi Abiasafa. Awa ndi mabanja a Kora.
Eleazara mwana wa Aroni anakwatira mwana wa Putieli, ndipo iye anabereka Fineasi. Awa ndi mawu a mabanja a Lawi, monga alembedwe m'mbadwo wawo.
Aroni ndi Mose otchulidwa m'mndandanda uno ndi amene Yehova anawalamula, 'Tulutsani anthu a Isiraeli ku Igupito ngati gulu lankhondo.'
Ndi Mose ndi Aroni amene analankhula ndi Farao, mfumu ya Igupito, za kutsogolera Isiraeli kutuluka ku Igupito.
Yehova atalankhula ndi Mose m'dziko la Igupito,
anauza, 'Ndine Yehova! Uze Farao, mfumu ya Igupito, chilichonse chimene ndikuuza.'
Koma Mose anakana kwa Yehova, 'Sindinthazi! Sindine wokwanira kuyankhula! N'chifukwa chiyani Farao adzandimva?'
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Onetsetsani izi. Ndidzakupanga kukhala ngati Mulungu kwa Farao, ndipo mlongo wako Aroni adzakhala mneneri wako.
Uze Aroni chilichonse chimene ndikulamula, ndipo Aroni alamulirenso Farao kuti atulute anthu a Isiraeli m'dziko lake.
Koma ndidzolimbitsa mtima wa Farao kuti ndikulitsite zizindikiro ndi zodabwitsa m'dziko la Igupito.
Ngakhale choncho Farao sadzamvera. Ndipo ndidzamenya Igupito, nditulutse magulu anga — anthu anga Aisraeli — ku Igupito ndi zoweruza zachikulu.
Ndidzakweza dzanja langa lamphamvu ndikutulutsa Aisraeli, ndipo pamenepo aEgipito adzadziwa kuti ndine Yehova.'
Choncho Mose ndi Aroni anachita monga Yehova anawalamulidwa.
Mose anali ndi zaka makumi asanu ndi atatu, ndipo Aroni anali ndi zaka makumi asanu ndi atatu, pamene anapita kwa Farao ndi zomwe anafuna.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose ndi Aroni,
Farao adzafunsa, "Onetsani chizindikiro." Uze Aroni, "Ponya ndodo patsogolo pa Farao, naisinthe kukhala njoka."
Choncho Mose ndi Aroni anapita kwa Farao nachita monga Yehova anawalamula. Aroni anaponya ndodo yake patsogolo pa Farao ndi antchito ake, naisintha kukhala njoka!
Pamenepo Farao anayitana azinjeru ake ndi akuchita milingo, ndipo asilikali azimilingo a Igupito awo anachitanso chimodzimodzi ndi milingo yawo.
Aliyense anaponya ndodo yawo, naisintha kukhala njoka! Koma ndodo ya Aroni inadya ndodo zawo.
Pamenepo mtima wa Farao unakhala wouma. Iye anakana kumvera, monga Yehova analosera.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Mtima wa Farao ukhuta, ndipo akuchikanso kutula anthu.
Pita kwa Farao m'mawa akatsikira kumtsinje. Imirira m'mphepete mwa Naili ukamukumane. Sungirira ndodo imene inasinthidwa kukhala njoka.
Pamenepo muze, "Yehova, Mulungu wa aHebri, wandituma kunena, 'Katula anthu anga kuti azindilambire kutchire.' Koma kufikira tsopano, suwamvera.
Choncho Yehova akuti: 'Ndidzakuonetsa kuti ndine Yehova.' Taona! Ndidzamenya madzi a Naili ndi ndodo iyi ya m'dzanja langa, naisinthe kukhala magazi.
Nsomba za m'tsinje zidzafa, ndipo mtsinje udzanunkhira. AEgipito sadzakwanisa kumwa madzi a Naili."

Kenaka Yehova anauza Mose, 'Uze Aroni, "Kweza dzanja lako ndi ndodo pa madzi onse a Igupito — mitsinje yake, misindi yake, zipata zake, ndi zosunga madzi zonse. Asinthike kukhala magazi. Madzi azadzala m'Igupito lonselo, ngakhale m'mikebe ya matabwa ndi mikebe ya miyala.'
Choncho Mose ndi Aroni anachita monga Yehova analamula. Farao ndi antchito ake onse akuona, Aroni anakweza ndodo yake ndi nagwira Naili, ndipo mtsinje wonse unasinthika kukhala magazi!
Nsomba m'tsinje zinafa, ndipo mtsinje unanyansa moti aEgipito sanakwanise kumwa madzi ake. Panali magazi m'dziko lonse la Igupito.
Koma azimilingo a Igupito anachitanso chimodzimodzi ndi milingo yawo, ndipo mtima wa Farao unakhala wouma. Anakana kumvera Mose ndi Aroni, monga Yehova analosera.
Farao anabwerera ku nyumba yake, osaganizira nkhaniyo.
Kenaka aEgipito onse anakumba m'mphepete mwa mtsinje kukafunafuna madzi odyedwa, pakuti sanakwanise kumwa madzi a Naili.
Masiku asanu ndi awiri anakwera kuchokera nthawi Yehova anagwera Naili.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Bwerera kwa Farao umuze, "Yehova akuti: Katula anthu anga kuti azindilambire.
Ngati ukakana kutula, ndidzatumiza mliri wa achule m'dziko lako lonse.

Naili idzadzala achule. Adzabwera m'nyumba yako, ngakhale m'chipinda chako cogona ndi pamwamba pa bedi lako! Adzalowera m'nyumba za antchito ako ndi anthu ako. Adzalowera ngakhale m'zitaniro ndi m'misutu yako.
Achule adzakuwamba iwe, anthu ako, ndi antchito ako onse.'
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Uze Aroni, "Kweza ndodo m'dzanja lako pa mitsinje yonse, misindi, ndi zipata za Igupito, kuti achule abwere m'dziko lonse.'
Choncho Aroni anakweza dzanja lake pa madzi a Igupito, ndi achule anabwera nakaphimbira dziko lonse!
Koma azimilingo anachitanso chimodzimodzi ndi milingo yawo. Iwo nawonso anapangitsa achule kubwera pa dziko la Igupito.
Pamenepo Farao anayitana Mose ndi Aroni nalomba, 'Pempherani kwa Yehova kuti achotse achule kwa ine ndi anthu anga. Ndidzatula anthu kuti akapereke nsembe kwa Yehova.'
Iwe utsimikizire!' Mose anayankha. 'Ndipuza nthawi ya ife kukupempherera iwe ndi antchito ako ndi anthu ako, kuti achule achokere kwa iwe ndi nyumba zako. Adzasalira mu Naili yokha.
'Mawa!' Farao anauza. 'Chabwino,' Mose anayankha, 'zidzakhala monga unauza. Pamenepo udzadziwa kuti palibe wina ngati Yehova Mulungu wathu.
Achule achoka kwa iwe ndi nyumba zako, antchito ako, ndi anthu ako. Adzasalira mu Naili yokha.'
Choncho Mose ndi Aroni anatuluka ku bwalo la Farao, ndipo Mose anafuula kwa Yehova za achule amene anabweretsa pa Farao.
Yehova anachita monga Mose analombera. Achule anafa m'nyumba, m'malo onyamilikidwa, ndi m'minda.
AEgipito anasonkhanitsa mipanda ya achule, ndipo dziko linadzala fungo loyipa kwambiri.
Koma Farao ataona kuti anapokelera mpumulo, anakakamizanso mtima wake. Anakana kumvera Mose ndi Aroni, monga Yehova analosera.
Choncho Yehova anauza Mose, 'Uze Aroni, "Kweza ndodo yako umeneye pa fumbi lapansi. Lisinthe kukhala mvu m'dziko lonse la Igupito.'

Choncho Mose ndi Aroni anachita monga Yehova anawalamula. Aroni anakweza dzanja lake ndi ndodo yake nagwera nthaka, ndipo mvu zinadzala m'dziko lonse, zikuwaphimba anthu ndi nyama. Fumbi lonse la Igupito linasinthika kukhala mvu.
Azimilingo anayesa kuchita chimodzimodzi ndi milingo yawo kuti abweretse mvu, koma sanakwanise. Mvu zinkaphimba anthu ndi nyama.
'Ichi ndi chala cha Mulungu!' azimilingo anauza Farao. Koma mtima wa Farao unakhala wouma. Anakana kumvera, monga Yehova analosera.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Dzuka m'mawa ndikaimirire njira ya Farao akatsikira kumtsinje. Muze, "Yehova akuti: Katula anthu anga kuti azindilambire.
Ngati ukakana, ndidzatumiza viyuni m'badala mwako, antchito ako, anthu ako, ndi nyumba zako zonse. Nyumba za aEgipito zidzadzala viyuni, ndipo nthaka idzaphimbidwa nazo.
Koma tsiku limenelo ndidzasungira dera la Goseni, kumene anthu anga akukhala. Palibenso viyuni kumeneko. Pamenepo udzadziwa kuti ine ndine Yehova pa dziko lonse.
Ndidzaika chipataganya pakati pa anthu anga ndi anthu ako. Chizindikiro ichi chidzachitika mawa."
Yehova anachita monga anauza. Viyuni antinkhana anadzala bwalo la Farao ndi nyumba za antchito ake. M'dziko lonse la Igupito zinasokonezedwa ndi viyuni.
Farao anayitana Mose ndi Aroni. 'Chabwino! Pitani mukapereke nsembe kwa Mulungu wanu,' anauza. 'Koma muzichita m'dziko lomweli.'
Koma Mose anayankha, 'Zingathe? Nsembe zimene tikapereka kwa Yehova Mulungu wathu ndi chidina kwa aEgipito. Ngati tikapereka nsembe zimene aEgipito akuona, atitaya miyala.
Tiyenera kupita ulendo wa masiku atatu kutchire kukapereka nsembe kwa Yehova Mulungu wathu, monga analamula.'
Chabwino, pita,' Farao anayankha. 'Ndikukusiyani kupita kutchire kukapereka nsembe kwa Yehova Mulungu wanu. Koma musapite kutali. Tsopano fulumirani mukamapemphere kwa Mulungu chifukwa cha ine.

Mose anayankha, 'Ndisiyayi, ndizapemphera kwa Yehova, ndipo mawa viyuni zidzachoka kwa iwe ndi antchito ako ndi anthu ako. Koma ndikuchenjeza, Farao, musanamizanso ndikukanirira anthu kupita kukapereka nsembe kwa Yehova.'
Choncho Mose anatuluka kwa Farao nakapempherera kwa Yehova kuti achotse viyuni.
Yehova anachita monga Mose analomba — viyuni anachoka kwa Farao, antchito ake, ndi anthu ake. Sipanasintha ngakhale chimodzi.
Koma Farao anakakamizanso mtima wake ndipo anakana kutula anthu.
'Bwerera kwa Farao,' Yehova analamula Mose. 'Muze, "Yehova, Mulungu wa aHebri, akuti: Katula anthu anga kuti azindilambire.
Ukakana kuwatula,
dzanja la Yehova lidzagwera pa ziweto zako zonse — amayi, abulu, ngamira, ng'ombe, nkhosa ndi mbuzi — ndi mliri wowpha.
Koma Yehova adzaika chipataganya pakati pa ziweto za Aisraeli ndi za aEgipito. Sipadzafa ngakhale chimodzi cha chiweto cha Isiraeli!
Yehova watsimikizira kale nthawi ya mliriyo. Wanenera kuti adzagwera dziko mawa."
Ndipo Yehova anachita monga anauza. M'mawa wake ziweto zonse za aEgipito zinafera, koma Aisraeli sanapheretse ngakhale chimodzi.
Farao anatuma antchito ake kukafufuza, ndipo anapeza kuti Aisraeli sanapheretse ngakhale chimodzi! Koma ngakhale choncho mtima wa Farao unakhala wouma, ndipo anakana kutula anthu.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose ndi Aroni, 'Tengani m'manja mwanu udzu wa ng'anjo, ndipo Mose awuponyere m'mwamba, Farao akuona.
Phulusa lidzabalalika ngati fumbi m'dziko lonse la Igupito, ndipo lidzabweretsa mawindi odupa pa anthu ndi nyama m'dziko lonse.'
Choncho anatenga udzu wa ng'anjo napita naimirira patsogolo pa Farao. Farao akuona, Mose anaponya udzu m'mwamba, ndipo mawindi adupa pa anthu ndi nyama.
Ngakhale azimilingo anakwanisa kuimirira patsogolo pa Mose, chifukwa mawindi adupa iwo amene ndi aEgipito onse.
Koma Yehova analimbitsa mtima wa Farao, ndipo monga Yehova analosera kwa Mose, Farao anakana kumvera.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Dzuka m'mawa naimirire patsogolo pa Farao. Muze, "Yehova, Mulungu wa aHebri, akuti: Katula anthu anga kuti azindilambire.
Ngati siuchita, tsiku limenelo ndidzatumizira mliri wochokera pa ine, pa antchito ako, ndi pa anthu ako. Pamenepo udzadziwa kuti palibe mofanana ndi ine m'dziko lonse lapansi.
Pana nthawi ndinakwanisa kukweza dzanja langa ndikumenyera iwe ndi anthu ako ndi mliri wokusowanitsa ku dziko.
Koma ndakusunga ndi cholinga — kuti ndikuonetse mphamvu zanga, ndipo dzina langa lidziwike m'dziko lonse.
Koma ukukalambabira anthu anga ndipo ukakana kuwatula.
Choncho mawa pali nthawi imeneyi, ndidzabutsa mvula yovuta kwambiri, moti kuyambira pamene Igupito inayambika mpaka tsiku lino, siinabwere mvula yotero.
Fulumirani! Ika ziweto zako ndi akapolo ako m'malo odalika. Munthu kapena nyama aliyense amene adzasalira kutchire adzaphedwa ndi mvula!"
Antchito ena a Farao anaopa mawu a Yehova, nabweretsa msanga akapolo ndi ziweto zawo m'nyumba.
Koma amene anapondereza mawu a Yehova anasiya zawo kutchire.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Kweza dzanja lako kumwamba kuti mvula igwe pa anthu, ziweto, ndi zomera zonse m'dziko lonse la Igupito.'
Choncho Mose anakweza ndodo yake kumwamba, ndipo Yehova anatumiza ngʼanjo ndi mvula, ndipo moto unaduka pansi. Yehova anatumiza mvula yovuta kwambiri pa dziko lonse la Igupito.
Panali mvula yovuta, ndi moto wolawika pakati pake, zinthu zosaoneka kuchokera pamene Igupito inabadwira monga dziko.
Mvula inagwetsa chilichonse kunze — anthu, nyama, ndi zomera. Ngakhale mitengo inasweka.
Komabe m'dera la Goseni, kumene Aisraeli ankakhala, sinathe mvula.
Pamenepo Farao anayitana msanga Mose ndi Aroni. 'Ndinapanga tchimo tsopano,' iye analandula. 'Yehova ndi wachilungamo, ndipo ine ndi anthu anga tili olakwa.
Pemphani kwa Yehova, wakwanira kale ngʼanjo yosaopera ndi mvula. Ndidzakusiyani kupita — simudzasalira.'
'Kundituluka ku mzinda, ndidzakweza manja anga napempherera Yehova,' Mose anayankha. 'Ngʼanjo idzaima, mvula nayimitsidwa, kuti udziwe kuti dziko ndi la Yehova.
Koma ndidziwa kuti iwe ndi antchito ako simunaope Yehova Mulungu ndithu.'
(Katani ndi shayiri zinaonongeka ndi mvula, pakuti shayiri inali ndi mbewu ndipo katani inali yabukula.
Koma tirigu ndi emere zinasalira, chifukwa zinali za m'tsogolo ndipo zinali zisanamera m'nthaka.)
Choncho Mose anatuluka ku bwalo la Farao natuluka m'mzinda. Anakweza manja ake kwa Yehova, ndipo ngʼanjo ndi mvula zinaimirira.
Koma Farao ataona kuti mvula, ngʼanjo, ndi ngʼanjo zinaimirira, iye ndi antchito ake anapanga tchimo linalosali, ndipo Farao anakakamizanso mtima wake.
Chifukwa mtima wake unali wouma, Farao anakana kutula anthu, monga Yehova analosera kudzera mwa Mose.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Bwerera kwa Farao ukanene mawu ako. Ine ndalimbitsa mtima wake ndi wa antchito ake kuti ndionetse zizindikiro zanga pakati pawo.
Ndachita zimenezi kuti ukalankhule ndi ana ako ndi zidzukulu nthali ya momwe ndidachita mwano ndi aEgipito, ndi zizindikiro zimene ndinachita pakati pawo — kuti mudziwe kuti ine ndine Yehova.'
Choncho Mose ndi Aroni anapita kwa Farao nanena, 'Yehova, Mulungu wa aHebri, akuti: Mpaka liti ukakana kudzichepetsa pamaso panga? Katula anthu anga kuti azindilambire.
Ngati ukakana, taona! Mawa ndidzabweretsa dzombe m'dziko lako.
Adzaphimba dziko lonse moti sudzakwanisa kuona nthaka. Adzadya chotsala ka mbewu zimene mvula sizinaononga, kuphatikiza mitengo yonse ilikuyanjanjika m'minda.

Adzadzala nyumba zako ndi za antchito ako ndi za anthu ako onse. Kuyambira pamene makolo ako ndi makolo a makolo ako anabadwa mpaka tsiku lino, Igupito sinaone zoipa otero!' Atanena izi, Mose anatembenuka napita.
Antchito a Farao anafika kwa Farao nalomba, 'Mpaka liti munthu uyu atisunga ngati akapolo? Katura amuna kuti azilambire Yehova Mulungu wawo! Kodi sukuona kuti Igupito watheratu?'
Choncho Mose ndi Aroni anabwereretsa kwa Farao. 'Chabwino,' Farao anauza. 'Pitani mulambire Yehova Mulungu wanu. Koma ndani amene adzapita nawo?'

Mose anayankha, 'Tiyenera kupita tonse pamodzi — ana athu aakuluakulu ndi aazing'onozing'ono, ana athu amwamuna ndi aakazi, ndi ziweto ndi nkhumba zathu. Tiyenera kukondwerera chikondwerero kwa Yehova.'
Farao anayankha, 'Ndithu Yehova akhale nanu ngati ndidzakusiyani kupita ndi ana anu! Kwaona kuti mukufuna kuchita zoipa.
Ai! Amuna okha ndi amene angapite kulambira Yehova, ndi zimene munafuna.' Natulutsa Mose ndi Aroni ku bwalo.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Kweza dzanja lako pa dziko la Igupito kuti dzombe abwere. Adzaphimba dziko lonse nadya chilichonse chomera chimene chatsalira ndi mvula.'
Choncho Mose anakweza ndodo yake pa Igupito, ndipo Yehova anabweretsa mphepo ya kum'mawa m'dziko lonse usana ndi usiku. Mawa wake, mphepo ya kum'mawa inabweretsa dzombe.
Dzombe anadzera pa dziko lonse la Igupito, nasinthika m'malo moyo m'chidzalo choyipa kwambiri. Anali dzombe oyipa kwambiri m'mbiri yonse ya Igupito, ndipo sapananso otero.

Anapbhimira dziko lonse, ndipo dziko linachita mdima. Anadya chilichonse chomera m'minda ndi chipatso chonse pa mitengo chimene mvula sichinaononga. Sisinala tsamba kapena chomera chilichonse pa mitengo kapena m'minda m'dziko lonse la Igupito.
Farao anayitana msanga Mose ndi Aroni. 'Ndinachimwa kwa Yehova Mulungu wanu ndi kwa inu,' iye analandula.
Chondikhalilireni tchimo langa kaMozi kamodzi, ndi pemphani kwa Yehova Mulungu wanu kuti achotse imfa iyi kwa ine.
Choncho Mose anatuluka kwa Farao nakapempherera kwa Yehova.
Yehova anasinthira mphepo, ndi mphepo yamphamvu ya kum'madzulo inabweretsa dzombe ku Nyanja Ilokomera. Sipanasiyidwe ngakhale dzombe m'malo ake m'dziko lonse la Igupito.
Koma Yehova analimbitsa mtima wa Farao, ndipo anakana kutula anthu.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Kweza dzanja lako kumwamba, kuti mdima ufike pa dziko la Igupito — mdima wosigwa ndi manja.'
Choncho Mose anakweza dzanja lake kumwamba, ndipo mdima wowaza unadzala m'dziko lonse la Igupito kwa masiku atatu.
Pa nthawi yonse imeneyo anthu sanakwanise kuonana, ndipo palibe amene ananyamuka. Koma Aisraeli anali ndi kuwala m'malo mwawo.
Pamene Farao anayitana Mose. 'Pita ukalamulirenso Yehova,' iye anauza. 'Ziweto zako zikhale pano. Ngakhale ana ako aazing'onozing'ono ungatenge nawo.'
'Ayi,' Mose anauza. 'Iwe uyenera kutipatsa nyama za nsembe ndi nsembe zayotcha kwa Yehova Mulungu wathu.

Ziweto zathu zonse ziyenera kupita nazo, ngakhale chipata chomodzi. Tiyenera kusankhira nsembe kwa Yehova Mulungu wathu kuchokera mwa ziweto izi. Ndipo sitidziwa momwe tikudzalambirirani Yehova mpaka tilafike kumeneko.'
Koma Yehova analimbitsa mtima wa Farao nthawi imeneyo, ndipo sanakatule.
Tuluka!' Farao anafuwulira Mose. 'Ndikuchenjeza. Usadzabwere kuona nkhope yanga! Tsiku ukaona nkhope yanga, udzafa!
Chabwino,' Mose anayankha. 'Sidzabwereranso kuona nkhope yako.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Ndidzagwera Farao ndi dziko la Igupito ndi mliri wina imodzi yomaliza. Atatero, Farao adzakusiyani kutuluka m'dziko ino. Ndithu, adzakupilikitsira kutuluka.
Uze amuna ndi akazi onse a Isiraeli kuti apembe a mEgupito awo zinthu za siliva ndi golide.'
(Tsopano Yehova anachita aEgipito kuona Aisraeli ndi maso a chisoni. Ndipo Mose anakadula kwambiri m'dziko la Igupito, pamaso pa antchito a Farao ndi pa anthu a Igupito.)
Mose anauza Farao, 'Yehova akuti: Pakati pa usiku ndidzadutsa pakati pa Igupito.

Ana oyamba kubadwa aamwamuna adzafa m'mabanja onse a Igupito, kuyambira woyamba kubadwa wa Farao amene akhala pa mpando wake wachifumu, mpaka woyamba kubadwa wa mnyamata yaikidwa m'chaiko. Ngakhale ana oyamba kubadwa a ziweto adzafa.
Pamenepo kulira kwa chisoni kudzadzaza m'dziko lonse la Igupito, kulira kosakumbukirika koyambika nthawi imene Igupito inayambika monga dziko.
Koma pakati pa Aisraeli, ngakhale galu sadzamveka kuboneka. Pamenepo udzadziwa kuti Yehova aika pataganya pakati pa aEgipito ndi Aisraeli.

Antchito ako onse a ku Igupito adzabwera kwa ine nagwada pansi. "Tulukani!" adzalomba. "Iwe ndi anthu onse okutsatira!" Pambuyo pa izi, ndituluka!' Mose anatero, nyoni yoyaka mu mtima wake, natuluka kwa Farao.
Tsopano Yehova anauza Mose kale kale, 'Farao sadzakumvera, kuti zizindikiro ndi zodabwitsa zanga zikule m'dziko la Igupito.'
Mose ndi Aroni anachita zodabwitsa izi zonse pamaso pa Farao, koma Yehova analimbitsa mtima wa Farao, ndipo anakana kutulutsa Aisraeli m'dziko lake.
Aisraeli akili m'dziko la Igupito, Yehova anapatsa Mose ndi Aroni malamulo awa:
'Mwezi uno ukhale woyamba kwa inu, kukhala mwezi woyamba wa chaka chako.
Ulalikire banja lonse la Isiraeli kuti pa tsiku lachumi la mwezi uno, banja lililonse lisankhe mwana wa nkhumba kapena mbuzi imodzi — nyama imodzi pa nyumba.
Ngati banja ndi laling'ono kwambiri kuti lithe kudya nyama yonse, liphatikizike ndi banja lina la m'dera. Gawanani nyama malinga ndi chiwerengero cha anthu m'banja ndi momwe angadye.
Nyama imene musankhire iyenera kukhala ya zaka zomwe zimodzi, wamwamuna, ndi mwana wa nkhumba kapena mbuzi, wopanda chikalata.
'Samalani nyama iyi mpaka usiku wa tsiku lakhumi ndi linayi la mwezi woyamba. Pamenepo banja lonse la Isiraeli liipherenge madzulo.
Itenga magazi ndi kuwakolezera pa migonjoralo ndi pa mwamba wa mikomo ya nyumba kumene akadya nyama imeneyo.
Usiku umodziwo ayenera kudya nyama, iikidwe pa moto, pamodzi ndi masamba obiriwira owawa ndi mkate wopanda thobwa.
Musaidye nyama yalemba kapena yogotcha m'madzi. Iyenera kuikidwa yonse pa moto — mutu wake, miyendo yake, ndi m'mimba mwake.
Musasiyire chilichonse mpaka m'mawa. Chilichonse chosasala chilowetsedwe m'moto m'mawa.
'Izi ndi malangizo a kudya chakudya ichi: Valaniko zigamba zanu, sungani nsapato zanu, ndi nyamula ndodo zanu. Dya chakudyachi mwachikangache, pakuti ndi Pasika ya Yehova.
Pa usiku umodziwo ndidzadutsa m'dziko lonse la Igupito ndikupha ana oyamba kubadwa onse aamwamuna mu Igupito — anthu ndi ziweto. Ndidzaweruzanso milungu yonse ya Igupito, pakuti ndine Yehova!
Koma magazi pa mikomo yanu adzakhala chizindikiro chakuonetsa nyumba kumene mukukhala. Ndidzaona magazi ndipo ndidzakusamalirani. Mliri wowpha sudzakugwera mukandigwa ku Igupito.
'Tsiku iri ndi tsiku lokumbukira. Chaka ndi chaka, m'badwo ndi m'badwo, muzikondwerera ngati chikondwerero chapadera kwa Yehova. Ichi ndi lamulo mpaka muyaya.

Masiku asanu ndi awiri mukhale mukudya mkate wopanda thobwa. Pa tsiku loyamba la chikondwererochi, chosakula chilichonse chichotseredwe m'nyumba zanu. Aliyense amene adzadya mkate wa thobwa masiku asanu ndi awiri a chikondwererochi adzachotsedwa m'banja la Isiraeli.

Pa tsiku loyamba la chikondwerero ndi pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri, anthu onse agromolere tsiku loyera. Pazitsiku izi palibe ntchito ya mtundu ulifonse imene ingachitike — kupatulapo kaphunzitso ka chakudya chokha.
'Kondwerereni Chikondwerero cha Mkate Wopanda Thobwa, chifukwa tsiku limeneli ndinakutulutsa magulu anu ku Igupito. Chikondwererochi chikhale lamulo kwa inu mpaka muyaya, m'badwo ndi m'badwo.
Kuyambira usiku wa tsiku lakhumi ndi linayi la mwezi woyamba mpaka usiku wa tsiku lakhumi ndi linayi ndi limodzi la mwezi umodziwo, mudye mkate wopanda thobwa.

Pa masiku asanu ndi awiri amenewo, musalowe thobwa m'nyumba zanu. Aliyense amene adzadye chakudya cha thobwa pa sabata imeneyi adzachotsedwa ku banja la Isiraeli — kaya ndi mwini dziko kapena wobadwa ku Isiraeli.
Pazitsiku zimenezo musamadye chilichonse cha thobwa. Muzidya mkate wopanda thobwa m'malo onse mukukhala.'
Pamenepo Mose anayitana akulu onse a Isiraeli nanena nawo, 'Pitani, sankhani mwana wa nkhumba kapena mbuzi kwa banja lililonse, ndi muiphe nsembe ya Pasika.
Cholani magazi m'mbiya. Kenaka tengani nkhawi ya hisopo nambyotsera m'magazi. Ngʼokozerani migonjoralo ndi mbali ziwiri za mikomo ya nyumba zanu. Ndipo palibe amene azituluka pajero mpaka m'mawa.
Pakuti Yehova adzadutsa kugwera aEgipito. Koma adzaona magazi pa mwamba ndi mbali za mikomo, ndipo Yehova adzakusamalirani nyumba yanu. Sadzalola mngelo wowpha kulowa nyumba yanu nakupheniphenani.
'Zikhale lamulo mpaka muyaya kwa inu ndi zidzukulu zanu.
Mukalowa dziko limene Yehova adzakupatsa monga analumbirira, mucisunga chikondwererero ichi.
Ana anu akafunsa, "Chikondwerero ichi chamatanthauza chiyani?"

Muwauze, "Ndi nsembe ya Pasika kwa Yehova, amene anasamalira nyumba za Aisraeli ku Igupito. Iye anagwera aEgipito koma anasungira mabanja athu."' Mose atatsiriza kulankhula, anthu onse anagwada pansi nalambira.
Choncho anthu a Isiraeli anachita monga Yehova analamula kudzera mwa Mose ndi Aroni.

Ndipo pakati pa usiku, Yehova anagwera ana oyamba kubadwa onse m'dziko lonse la Igupito, kuyambira woyamba kubadwa wa Farao amene ankakhala pa mpando wake, mpaka woyamba kubadwa wa wamkutu m'jele. Ngakhale ana oyamba kubadwa a ziweto anafera.
Farao ndi antchito ake onse ndi anthu onse a Igupito anadzuka pakati pa usiku, ndipo kulira kwa chisoni kunadza m'dziko lonse la Igupito. Panalibe nyumba imodzi kumene palibe wina wanamwalira.
Farao anatuma anthu kwa Mose ndi Aroni usiku umodziwo. 'Tulukani!' analamulidwa. 'Siyani anthu anga — ndi inu ndi Aisraeli nonse! Pitani mukalamulirenso Yehova monga munafuna.
Tenanso ziweto ndi nkhumba zanu, monga munauza, ndipo nyamukani. Koma ndilotsirani pamukamuka.'
AEgipito anakakamiza Aisraeli kutuluka msanga, pakuti iwo anganena, 'Onse tidzafa!'
Aisraeli anatenga mkate wosaganduka ndi thobwa. Anasamalitsa zosweka zawo m'zovala zawo nazisunga pa mapewa awo.
Ndipo anthu a Isiraeli anachita monga Mose anawauza; anapemba aEgipito zovala ndi zinthu za siliva ndi golide.
Yehova anachita aEgipito kuona Aisraeli ndi maso a chisoni, ndipo iwo anawapatsa chilichonse chimene anachipemba. Motero anavula chuma aEgipito!
Usiku umodziwo anthu a Isiraeli ananyamuka ku Rameses nakapita ku Sukoti. Panali amuna okwana mazana asanu ndi limodzi, kupanda akazi ndi ana.
Gulu lachanganya la anthu osakhala Aisraeli linapita nawo, pamodzi ndi nkhumba ndi ziweto zambiri kwambiri.
Mkate zimene iwo anabaka anali mkate opanda thobwa wa ufa chimene anabweretsa ku Igupito. Wopanda thobwa chifukwa anazindulirika msaka m'Igupito ndipo sanali ndi nthawi yokonzekera kalikonse.
Anthu a Isiraeli anakhala ku Igupito kwa zaka mazana anayi ndi makumi atatu.
Ndithu, pa tsiku lomaliza la chaka cha mazana anayi ndi makumi atatu, magulu onse a Yehova anatuluka ku Igupito.
Pa usiku umodziwo Yehova anakwaniritsa lonjezo lake kutulutsa anthu ake ku dziko la Igupito. Choncho usiku uyu ndi waufumu wake, ndi kukumbukidwa ndi Aisraeli onse, m'badwo ndi m'badwo.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose ndi Aroni, 'Izi ndi malamulo a Pasika: Aliyense wapachilendo asamadye nsembe ya Pasika.
Koma akapolo omwe agulitsidwe angadya ngati asaliriridwa mdulidwe.
Abwera kwa nthawi yochepa ndi antchito opindulika asamadye.
Nsembe ya Pasika idyedwe m'nyumba imodzi. Musatulutse nyama kunja, ndipo musaphule fupa lake.
Banja lonse la Isiraeli lizisunge Chikondwerero cha Pasika.

'Ngati alendo akukhala pakati panu nafuna kukondwerera Pasika ya Yehova, amwamuna awo onse asaliridwe mdulidwe. Pambuyo pa izi angakondwerere Pasika pamodzi ndi wobadwa ku Isiraeli. Koma amwamuna wosadulidwa asamadye Pasika.
Chilamulo chimodzi chikhale kwa wobadwa m'dziko ndi kwa alendo akukhala pakati panu.'
Choncho anthu onse a Isiraeli anachita chilichonse chimene Yehova analamula Mose ndi Aroni.
Pa tsiku lomwelo Yehova anaturutsa anthu a Isiraeli ku Igupito, ngati gulu lankhondo.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose,
Ndipereke ana oyamba kubadwa onse a Isiraeli. Wosakula woyamba kubadwa, wa anthu ndi wa nyama, ndi wanga.

Choncho Mose anauza anthu, 'Tsiku ili likhale lokumbukira mpaka muyaya — tsiku limene munanyamuka ku Igupito, malo a ukapolo. Yehova wakutulutsa lero ndi mphamvu za dzanja lake lamphamvu. (Muzikumbukira, musamadye chakudya cha thobwa.)
Tsiku lero, m'mwezi wa Abibu ya chilimwe, mwatuluka.

Yehova akakubweretsa ku dziko la aKanani, aHiti, aAmori, aHivi, ndi aYebusi — (analumbira kwa makolo ako kuti adzakupatsa dziko ili loyenda mkaka ndi uchi) — uzisunga chikondwererero ichi m'mwezi umodziwo chaka ndi chaka.
Masiku asanu ndi awiri mudye mkate wopanda thobwa, ndipo pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri kondwererani chikondwerero kwa Yehova.
Masiku asanu ndi awiri ameneyo muzidye mkate wopanda thobwa. Thobwa singapezeke kwa inu — ngakhale mlunda mopanda thobwa uwiririka m'malire onse a dziko lanu.
'Pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri uzifotokozera ana ako kuti: "Ndi chikumbukiro cha zimene Yehova anandichitira ndinkatuluka ku Igupito."

Chikondwererero ichi chikhale chizindikiro pa dzanja lako ndi chikumbutsoko pa mphumi yako. Panga kuti mawu a Yehova akhale nyengo wako nthawi zonse: "Ndi dzanja lamphamvu, Yehova anakutulutsa ku Igupito.'
'Sunga chilamulo ichi pa nthawi yake, chaka ndi chaka.
'Ukafika pa nthawi imene Yehova akukwaniritsira lonjezo lake kwa iwe ndi makolo ako, akakupatsa dziko kumene aKanani akukhala —
muzipe Yehova ana oyamba kubadwa aamwamuna onse, chifukwa ndi ake.
Ana oyamba kubadwa a bulu angombola ndi wana wa nkhumba kapena mbuzi m'malo mwake. Ngati siuomboli, umusule khosi. Koma ana oyamba kubadwa onse aamwamuna uzi awombole.
'Mwana wako akakufunsa mtsogolo mwake, "Zimenezi n'chiyani?" umwuze: "Ndi mphamvu za dzanja la Yehova lamphamvu, anatulutsa ife ku Igupito, m'nyumba ya akapolo.

Farao anakakamira mosatula ife, choncho Yehova anapha ana oyamba kubadwa onse aamwamuna m'dziko lonse la Igupito — anthu ndi ziweto. Nthawi ndi yomweyo ndiperekezera kwa Yehova ana aamwamuna onse oyamba kubadwa — komatu ana aamwamuna onse oyamba kubadwa ndiwombolera."
Izi zikhale ngati chizindikiro pa dzanja lako ndi ngati kuchimba pa mphumi yako, kuti ukumbuke kuti ndi mphamvu ya dzanja la Yehova lamphamvu anatulutsa ife ku Igupito.'

Farao ataturula anthu, Mulungu sanatsolere njira ya m'mbali mwa Afilisiti, ngakhale yinali yafupi kupita ku Dziko Lolonjezedwa. Mulungu anauza yekha, 'Ngati anthu akumana ndi nkhondo, angasintha mtima nabwerera ku Igupito.'
Choncho Mulungu anatsogolera anthu m'dera la chilimwe ndikankhombwe la Nyanja Ilokomera. Motero Aisraeli anatuluka ku Igupito, okonzeka ngati gulu lankhondo.
Mose anatenga mifupa ya Yosefe naye, pakuti Yosefe anapiritsa ana a Isiraeli kulumbira. Anauza, 'Ndithu Mulungu adzakubwererani. Mukatero, mutenge mifupa yanga nayi nanu kuchokera apa.'
Aisraeli ananyamuka ku Sukoti napita ku Etamu kumuyora kwa chipululu.
Yehova anayenda patsogolo pawo. Usiku anawatsogolera ndi mzati wa thabiti, ndipo usiku anawabwiritsa ndi mzati wa moto. Motero ankakwanisa kuyenda usiku kapena usana.
Ndipo Yehova anasiye mzati wa thabiti kapena wa moto pa malo pake patsogolo pa anthu.
Pamenepo Yehova anapatsa Mose malamulo awa:
'Lamulira Aisraeli kubwerera nakampe pafupi ndi Pi-hahiroti pakati pa Migidolo ndi nyanja. Mipewe yanu khombwe mwa Baali-sefoni.
Pamenepo Farao adzanena, "Aisraeli osochera! Azingidwa ndi chipululu!"

Ndipo ndidzalimbitsanso mtima wa Farao, ndipo adzathamangira Aisraeli. Ndidzaonetsera ulemu wanga kudzera mwa Farao ndi gulu lake lonse, ndipo aEgipito adzadziwa kuti ndine Yehova!' Choncho Aisraeli anampe monga Yehova anawauza.
Mfumu ya Igupito inamva kuti Aisraeli anathawa, ndipo Farao ndi antchito ake anasinthika maganizo. 'Zinthu zaphedwa! Tinaturula Aisraeli kutisiyira mwa ife!' anauza.
Choncho Farao anayamba galeta lake natelezera magulu ake.
Anatenga magaleta okwana mazana asanu ndi limodzi a okoma koposa a Igupito, pamodzi ndi magaleta ena onse a Igupito, aliyense ndi mtsogoleri wake.
Yehova analimbitsa mtima wa Farao, mfumu ya Igupito, ndipo iye anamata Aisraeli, amene anali anatuluka manja oyanjika.

AEgipito anamata iwo ndi gulu lonse la Farao — amayi ake, magaleta ake, anthu ogwera amayi, ndi gulu lake lonse. Pakampe pa Aisraeli m'mphepete mwa nyanja pafupi ndi Pi-hahiroti, pakutsutsidwa ndi Baali-sefoni.
Farao atafika, Aisraeli anasunthira maso — ndipo aEgipito anali akubwera! Anachita mantha kwambiri nachitira kulira kwa Yehova.
Anauza Mose, 'Kodi panali manda ochepa ku Igupito muti ubweretse ife kudzafa m'chipululu? N'chiyani chomwe wachichita tinatuluka ku Igupito?
Kodi tisinauza izi ku Igupito? Tinauza, "Tisasiye! Tiloleni tikakhale akapolo a ku Igupito. Kukhala akapolo ku Igupito n'chisomo kuposa kufa m'chipululu!'
Koma Mose anauza anthu, 'Musachite mantha. Imani nokha ndikuona momwe Yehova adzakupulumutsira lero. AEgipito amene mukawaona lero, simudzawaona nakonso.
Yehova yemweyo adzamenyana nawo. Inu khalani chete.'
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'N'chifukwa chiyani ukulira kwa ine? Uze anthu anyamuke!
Kweza ndodo yako ukweze dzanja lako pa nyanja. Igawule kuti Aisraeli akayende pakati pa nyanja pa nthaka youma.
Ndipo ndidzolimbitsa mitima ya aEgipito kuti athamangire Aisraeli m'menemo. Ulemu wanga udzaonekera kudzera mwa Farao ndi gulu lake lonse, magaleta ake ndi anthu ogwera magaleta.
Ulemu wanga ukaonekera, aEgipito onse adzadziwa kuti ndine Yehova!'
Pamenepo mngelo wa Mulungu, amene ankayendera anthu a Isiraeli patsogolo, anatembenuka namuka kumbuyo kwawo. Mzati wa thabiti nawonso unanyamuka ku tsogolo nakaimirira kumbuyo kwawo.
Mzatiwu unayimirira pakati pa magulu a aEgipito ndi a Aisraeli. Usiku utabwera, chmura inasinthika kukhala moto ndi kuwale usiku. Koma masiku awa onse aEgipito ndi Aisraeli sanayandikane.

Pamenepo Mose anakweza dzanja lake pa nyanja, ndipo Yehova anatsegula njira kudzera m'madzi ndi mphepo yamphamvu ya kum'mawa. Mphepo inavuta usiku wonse, naisintha dende la nyanja kukhala nthaka youma.
Choncho anthu a Isiraeli anayenda pakati pa nyanja pa nthaka youma, madzi ngati mpanda mbali ziwiri!
Pamenepo aEgipito — amayi onse a Farao, magaleta ake ndi anthu ogwera — anamata Aisraeli m'menemo.
Koma patsala pang'ono kucha, Yehova anayang'ana pa gulu la aEgipito kuchokera m'mzati wa moto ndi wa thabiti, nasokoneza gulu lawo.
Anagwagwamutsa magurudumu a magaleta awo, mota magaleta anali okomeka kuyendetsa. 'Tithawire Aisraeli!' aEgipito anafuula. 'Yehova akumenyerana nawo motsutsana ndi Igupito!'
Aisraeli onse atafikira ku mbali inayo, Yehova anauza Mose, 'Kweza dzanja lako pa nyanja, ndipo madzi adzabwerera ndi kuphimba aEgipito, magaleta awo, ndi anthu ogwera magaleta awo.'
Choncho dzuwa litabwera, Mose anakweza dzanja lake pa nyanja, ndipo madzi anabwerera malo awo oyamba. AEgipito anayesa kuthawa, koma Yehova anawatsansola m'nyanja.
Pamenepo madzi anabwerera naphimba magaleta onse ndi anthu ogwera magaleta — gulu lonse la Farao limene linali litamata Aisraeli m'nyanja. Sinapangidwe ngakhale limodzi.
Koma anthu a Isiraeli anayenda pakati pa nyanja pa nthaka youma, madzi ngati mpanda mbali zonse.
Motero tsiku limenelo Yehova anapulumutsa Isiraeli ku manja a aEgipito. Aisraeli anakuona aEgipito akufera m'mphepete mwa nyanja.
Anthu a Isiraeli ataona mphamvu yachikulu imene Yehova anagwetsa pa aEgipito, anaopa Yehova ndipo anakhulupirira Yehova ndi mtumiki wake Mose.
Pamenepo Mose ndi anthu a Isiraeli anaimba nyimbo iyi kwa Yehova: 'Ndidzaimba kwa Yehova, pakuti wakweza mosangalatsa; amayi ndi ogwera waponya m'nyanja.
Yehova ndiye mphamvu yanga ndi nyimbo yanga; wandipatsa chipulumutso. Uyu ndi Mulungu wanga, ndidzamutamanda — Mulungu wa abambo anga, ndidzamukuza!
Yehova ndi nkhondo; Yehova ndiye dzina lake!
Magaleta a Farao ndi gulu lake wagonjetsa m'nyanja. Asilikali ake okoma koposa adabiriridwa mu Nyanja Ilokomera.
Madzi ozama adawaphimba; adatsikira pansi ngati mwala.
'Dzanja lako lamanja, Yehova, litamanda ndi mphamvu. Dzanja lako lamanja, Yehova, lagwetsa adani.
M'ukulu wa ulemu wako wagwetsa opandukira. Waloza mkangala wako woyaka; udyera iwo ngati chipabi.
Ndi kupuma kwa mphuno yako, madzi anasonkhana! Madzi oyenda anaimirira ngati mpanda; madzi ozama anadolimira pakati pa nyanja.
'Adani anauza, "Ndidzawamata ndidzawafikira. Ndidzawachotsa nawapha. Ndidzawaphula lupanga langa; dzanja langa lidzawaononga."
Koma wafuula na mphepo yako, nyanja inawaphimba. Adatsirira ngati tsulo m'madzi amphamvu.
'Ndani mofanana nawe pakati pa milungu, Yehova — yotamandika mu uyeriyeri, otchuka mu ulemu, wochita zodabwitsa?
Wakweza dzanja lako lamanja, ndi nthaka inadza ndi adani.
'Ndi chikondi chako chosakhalitsa watsogolera anthu amene wawombola. Ndi mphamvu zako wawatsogolera kunyumba yako yoyera.
Anthu amva naunjikana; maufu agwera okhala ku Afilisiti.
Akulu a Edomu akaopa; atsogoleri a Moabu anjikana. Onse okhala ku Kanani asanza.
Mantha ndi dzantha zagwa pa iwo. Ndi mphamvu ya dzanja lako, achithe ngati mwala — mpaka anthu ako adapita, Yehova, mpaka anthu amene unawagula adapita.
Udzawabweretsa nawatcha pa phiri lako — malo, Yehova, amene ukasungira kukhala kwako, chipinda chopatulika, Ambuye, amene manja yako anachimanga.
Yehova adzalamulira mpaka muyaya!'
Pakuti amayi a Farao, magaleta ake, ndi anthu ogwera adalowera m'nyanja, ndipo Yehova anabweretsa madzi pa iwo. Koma anthu a Isiraeli anayenda pa nthaka youma pakati pa nyanja!
Pamenepo Miriamu, mneneri wamkazi, mlongo wa Aroni, anatenga nkhonje nadanso, ndi akazi onse anamtsatira ankuvina ndi kunimba nkhonje zawo.
Miriamu anaimbira, 'Imbirani Yehova, pakuti wakweza mosangalatsa; amayi ndi ogwera waponya m'nyanja.'
Pamenepo Mose anatsogolera anthu a Isiraeli kutuluka ku Nyanja Ilokomera, napita kutchire kwa Shuri. Anayenda m'chipululu kwa masiku atatu wopanda madzi.
Atafika ku Mara, sanakwanise kumwa madzi chifukwa anali owawa. (Choncho dzina la malo aja linatchulidwa Mara, kutanthauza "owawa.")
Pamenepo anthu anakana ndi Mose. 'N'chiyani tidzamwa?' anafunsa.

Choncho Mose analira kwa Yehova, ndipo Yehova namuonetsa chipande cha mtengo. Mose anasonyeza m'madzi, ndipo madzi anasitha kukhala oyenera kumwa. Kumeneko, ku Mara, Yehova anaika malamulo nalamula anthu kuchita zachilungamo, nakayesa chikhulupiriro chawo.

Iye anauza, 'Ngati mwera kumvera mawu a Yehova Mulungu wanu ndikuchita chomwe chiri chilungamo pamaso pake, ndikumvera malamulo ake ndi kusunga mitemo yake yonse, ndidzasasakumikizani zomwe ndimikizira aEgipito, chifukwa ndine Yehova wocha mankhwala anu.'
Kenaka anafika ku Elimu, kumene panali akasupe khumi ndi awiri ndi mitengo ya masamba makumi asanu ndi awiri ndi anayi. Nampe kumeneko pafupi ndi madzi.

Pamenepo banja lonse la Isiraeli linatuluka ku Elimu napita kutchire kwa Sini, pakati pa Elimu ndi Phiri la Sinai. Anafika kumeneko pa tsiku lachumi ndi lisanu la mwezi wachiwiri, mwezi umodzi atangotuluka ku Igupito.
Kumeneko luso banja lonse la Isiraeli linakana ndi Mose ndi Aroni.

Akadakhala Yehova anapha ife ku Igupito!' anagaagaa. 'Kumeneko tinakhala m'mbali ndi mafupa odzaza nyama ndikudya mkate wokwanira. Koma tsopano mwatibweretsa m'chipululu chakuphera anthu onse ndi njala.

Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Taona, ndidzathira chakudya kuchokera kumwamba. Anthu adzatuluke nsiku ndi nsiku kukatenga zofikira nsiku imeneyo. Ndidzawayesa kuti aone ngati adzamvera malangizo anga kapena ayi.
Pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chimodzi adzikonzere zochuluka, ndipo akadya, padzakhala kangwirire kawiri kuposa masiku ena.'
Choncho Mose ndi Aroni anauza anthu onse a Isiraeli, 'M'mawa mudzaziwa kuti Yehova ndiye wakutulutsa ku Igupito.
M'mawa mudzaona ulemu wa Yehova, chifukwa wakumva makanano anu motsutsana naye — si ife. N'chiyani ife wachitira kuti mutidzane?'

Pamenepo Mose anauza, 'Yehova adzakupatsani nyama kudya usiku ndi mkate kukusakanitsani m'mawa, chifukwa wakumva makanano anu onse motsutsana naye. Ife tili ndani? Makanano anu ndi motsutsana ndi Yehova, si ife.'
Pamenepo Mose anauza Aroni, 'Uze banja lonse la Isiraeli, "Sonkhanani pamaso pa Yehova, chifukwa wakumva makanano anu.'
Aroni atalankhula ndi banja lonse la Isiraeli, anasunthira maso kutchire — ndipo ulemu wa Yehova unaonekera m'thabiti.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose,
Ndakumva makanano a Aisraeli. Uwazekatero: "M'madzulo mudzadya nyama, ndipo m'mawa mudzakhuta ndi mkate. Pamenepo mudzadziwa kuti ndine Yehova Mulungu wanu."
M'madzulo mazana a nkhanga anabwera nakaphimba msasa. Ndipo m'mawa malo onse ozungulira msasa anali ndi mame.
Mame akanyanyala, panali chinachake chofewa ngati utaka pansi.
Aisraeli ataona chinachake ichi, anafunsa wina ndi mzake, 'N'chiyani ichi?' chifukwa sankadziwa. Mose anauza, 'Ndi chakudya chimene Yehova wakupatsani kudya.
Izi ndi malamulo a Yehova: Aliyense atenga monga akukwanira. Tenga ma omer awiri a munthu aliyense m'hema lako.'
Choncho anthu a Isiraeli anachita momwemo. Ena anatenga ambiri, ena ochepa.
Koma atalereza, aliyense anali ndi okwanira. Amene anatenga ambiri anali ndi okwana, ndipo amene anatenga ochepa anali ndi okwanira. Banja lililonse linali ndi chokwanira.
Pamenepo Mose anauza, 'Musasungire chilichonse mpaka m'mawa.'
Koma ena sanagwirizane nasungira mpaka m'mawa. Linasweka ndi mabisi ndipo linanunkhira. Mose anakwiya ndi iwo.
Pambuyo pake anthu anatenga chakudyacho m'mawa ndi m'mawa, aliyense pa zokwanira. Dzuwa litawala, chinangʼamba nachisintha.
Pa tsiku lachisanu ndi limodzi, anatenga zowirirana zochuluka — ma omer anayi pa munthu aliyense m'malo mwa awiri. Pamenepo akulu onse a gulu la Isiraeli anabwera kwa Mose ndi mafunso.

Mose anauza, 'Ichi ndi zimene Yehova analamula: Mawa idzakhala Sabata yoyera, Sabata yopatulika kwa Yehova. Bwakani kapena phikani chilichonse chimene mufuna lero, ndipo sungirireni chotsala mpaka m'mawa.'
Choncho anasungira mpaka m'mawa monga Mose anawalamula. Ndipo chotsalachi sinchinauke kapena kununkhira.
Mose anauza, 'Dya chakudyachi lero, pakuti lero ndi Sabata yopatulika kwa Yehova. Lero sudzapeza chakudya pansi.
Muzitenga chakudya masiku asanu ndi limodzi, koma tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri ndi Sabata. Pa tsiku limenelo kudzakhala chopanda chakudya pansi.'
Ena m'tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri anatuluka kukatenga, koma sankapeza chilichonse.
Yehova anafunsa Mose, 'Mpaka liti anthu awa adzakana malamulo ndi malangizo anga?

Dziwani kuti Sabata ndi mphatso ya Yehova kwa inu. Motero pa tsiku lachisanu ndi limodzi wakupatsani chilichonse cha masiku awiri. Mu Sabata aliyense akhale ku malo ake. Musatuluke kukatenga chakudya pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri.'
Choncho anthu anasungira Sabata — sanatenga chakudya pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri.
Aisraeli anatchula chakudya ichi mana. Chinali chakuda ngati mbewu ya koriyana, ndipo chinkamva ngati mkate wa uchi.

Pamenepo Mose anauza, 'Ichi ndi zimene Yehova analamula: Dzadza mbiya ya ma omer awiri ndi mana kuti isungidwe kwa zidzukulu zanu. Zidzukulu zanu zidzaona chakudya chimene ndanikupatsani m'chipululu ndinakutulutseni ku Igupito.'
Mose anauza Aroni, 'Tenga mbiya uizadze ndi ma omer awiri a mana. Kenaka aisunge m'malo opatulika patsogolo pa Yehova kuti isungidwe kwa mibadwo yonse.'
Aroni anachita monga Yehova analamula Mose. Pa nthawi yake anaisungira patsogolo pa Bokosi la Pangano — patsogolo pa zoyeretsedwa ndi malamulo.
Choncho anthu a Isiraeli anadya mana zaka makumi anayi mpaka anafika m'dziko limene ankadzakhala. Anadya mana mpaka anafika ku malire a Kanani.
(Choyezera chinatumikika pakuyeza mana chinali omera, limodzi la makumi a chi-efa; linkhala pafupi ndi ma lita awiri.)
Pa lamulo la Yehova, banja lonse la Isiraeli linatuluka kutchire kwa Sini, nakayendera malo ndi malo. Pamene anafika ku Refidimu, panali madzi opanda anthu amwa.
Choncho anthu anakana ndi Mose. 'Tipatseni madzi!' anafuula. 'Chete!' Mose anayankha. 'N'chifukwa chiyani mukana ndi ine? N'chifukwa chiyani mukuyesa Yehova?'
Koma anthu ankadwala ndi ludzu, ndithu ankakana ndi Mose. 'N'chifukwa chiyani unatitulutsa ku Igupito? Ukufuna kupha ife, ana athu, ndi ziweto zathu ndi ludzu?'
Pamenepo Mose analira kwa Yehova, 'Ndichite chiyani ndi anthu awa? Pafupi kundimenyera miyala!'
Yehova anauza Mose, 'Yendera patsogolo pa anthu. Tenga ndodo yako, imene udagwira Naili nayo, ndipo yitana akulu ena a Isiraeli kuti apite nawe.
Ndidzaimirira patsogolo pako pa mwala ku Phiri la Sinai. Gwera mwala, ndipo madzi adzatuluka kuti anthu amwe.' Mose anachita momwemo pamaso pa akulu a Isiraeli.
Anapatsa malo aja dzina Masa (kutanthauza 'kuyesa') ndi Meriba (kutanthauza 'kukana') chifukwa anthu a Isiraeli anakana ndi Mose, ndi kuyesa Yehova ponena, 'Kodi Yehova ali pakati pathu kapena ayi?'
Anthu a Isiraeli akili ku Refidimu, ankhondo a Amaleki anabwera nakagumana nao.
Mose analamula Yoswa, 'Sankha amuna apite kukamenyana ndi ankhondo a Amaleki. Mawa ndidzaimirira pamwamba pa phiri, ndodo ya Mulungu m'dzanja langa.'
Choncho Yoswa anachita monga Mose anamulamulidwa nakamenyana ndi Amaleki. Pakali pake Mose, Aroni, ndi Huri anakwera pamwamba pa phiri lopafupi.
Mose akakweza dzanja lake ndi ndodo, Aisraeli ankagona nchondo. Koma akaobzula, Amaleki anka gona nchondo.

Mose anatopa; anakwanisa kuyalika manja ake mosangalala. Choncho Aroni ndi Huri anapeza mwala wake nadzakhala, ndipo naimimirira mbali zonse, nayalika manja ake. Motero manja ake anakhala olimba mpaka dzuwa linagwa.
Chifukwa chake Yoswa anagonjetsa ankhondo a Amaleki.
Patagonjetsedwa, Yehova analamula Mose, 'Lemba izi pa mwandiona ngati chikumbukiro chokhazikika, ndipo uzenso Yoswa: Ndidzachotsa kukumbukika kwa Amaleki pansi pa thambo.'
Mose anazenga guwa lansembe kumeneko nakatchula Yahweh-Nissi (kutanthauza 'Yehova ndi chizindikiro changa').
Anauza, 'Akweza dzanja motsutsana ndi mpando wachifumu wa Yehova, choncho Yehova adzamenyana ndi Amaleki m'badwo ndi m'badwo.'
Jetiro, wansembe wa Midiani, abambo apakwati a Mose, anakumva za chilichonse chimene Mulungu anachitira Mose ndi anthu ake Aisiraeli — makamaka momwe Yehova anapulumutsa Isiraeli ku Igupito.
Kale kale Mose anabweza mkazi wake Zipora ndi ana awiri ake kwa Jetiro, amene anawatenga nawasunga.
(Mwana woyamba wa Mose anatchulidwa Gereshomu, Mose ananena pamene mwana anabadwa kuti, 'Nakhala mlendo m'dziko la alendo.'
Mwana wake wachiwiri anatchulidwa Eliezeri, pakuti Mose anauza, 'Mulungu wa makolo anga anali wothandiza wanga; wandipulumutsa ku lupanga la Farao.')
Jetiro, abambo apakwati a Mose, anabwera kumkumana naye kutchire pamodzi ndi mkazi wake ndi ana awiri ake, pamene Mose ndi anthu ankampe pafupi ndi phiri la Mulungu.
Jetiro anatumiza uthenga kwa Mose, 'Ine Jetiro, abambo ako apakwati, ndikubwera kukuona — mkazi wako ndi ana awiri ake amene.
Choncho Mose anatuluka kukakumana ndi abambo ake apakwati, nagwada pansi namupsya. Anafunsa mfundo wa wina ndi mzake, kenaka analowa m'hema la Mose.

Mose anauza abambo ake apakwati chilichonse chimene Yehova anachita kwa Farao ndi Igupito m'dzina la Isiraeli. Anafotokozanso matamando onse amene anakumana nawo pa njira ndi momwe Yehova anawapulumutsa.
Jetiro anasangalala kwambiri ndi ntchito yabwino yonse imene Yehova anachitira Isiraeli pakumupulumutsa ku manja a aEgipito.
'Tamandani Yehova!' Jetiro anauza, 'pakuti wakupulumutsani ku aEgipito ndi kwa Farao. Inde, wapulumutsa Isiraeli ku dzanja lamphamvu la Igupito!
Tsopano ndidziwa kuti Yehova akuposera milungu yonse, pakuti anawapulumutsa ku mazunzo a aEgipito odzikuza.'
Pamenepo Jetiro, abambo apakwati a Mose, anabweretsa nsembe yayotcha ndi nsembe zina kwa Mulungu. Aroni ndi akulu onse a Isiraeli anabwera ndi Jetiro kudya pamodzi patsogolo pa Mulungu.
M'mawa wake, Mose anakhala pakuweruzana ndi anthu. Anthu anaima pamaso pake kuyambira m'mawa mpaka madzulo.

Abambo apakwati a Mose ataona chilichonse chimene Mose anachitira anthu, anafunsa, 'Ndi chiyani chimene ukuchita kwa anthu? N'chifukwa chiyani ukukhala kuchita izi nokha anthu onse ataimirira kuyambira m'mawa mpaka madzulo?'
Mose anayankha, 'Chifukwa anthu abwera kwa ine kukafunsa kwa Mulungu.
Mikangano ikabuka, abwera kwa ine, ndipo ine ndi wenye kutsimikizira pakati pa iwo awiri. Ndikuphunzitsa anthu malamulo ndi malangizo a Mulungu.'
'Izi sizabwino!' abambo apakwati anauza.
'Udzatopetsa iwe nokha — ndi anthu nawonso. Ntchito iyi ndi yolema kwa iwe; sungakwanise kuichita nokha.
Ndiramvera tsopano, ndidzakupatsa uphungu, ndipo Mulungu akhale nawe. Iwe ukhale mwakhala wa anthu pamaso pa Mulungu, nabweretsa mikangano yawo kwa iye.
Phunzitsa anthu malamulo ndi mitemo ya Mulungu. Onetsa momwe angayendere moyo wawo.
Koma sankha pakati pa anthu onse amuna okhulupilika, owopa Mulungu, osakanana, ndi osaonda masewera a chinyengo. Waikira ngati atsogoleri a mitengo ya chikwi, mazana, makumi asanu, ndi khumi.
Akonzere kupereka miweruzano yamakono nthawi zonse, koma akubweretse nkhani zamakulidwe. Izi zidzathandiza kuwunika ntchito, nakupatsani mpumulo.
Ngati uchita zimenezi, ndipo Mulungu ndi wo nazo, udzakhala wa mphamvu kuzikumira, ndipo anthu onse adzabwerera kunyumba kwawo ndi mtendere.'
Mose anamvera uphungu wa abambo ake apakwati ndi kuuchita.
Anasankhira amuna olimba m'Isiraeli lonse nawaikira kukhala atsogoleri pa anthu — atsogoleri a mitengo ya chikwi, mazana, makumi asanu, ndi khumi.
Awa nthawi zonse anali akonzeka kupereka miweruzano yamakono. Mikangano yachikulu anabweretsa kwa Mose, koma yazing'ono anaweruzira okha.
Patapita pang'ono Mose anacheza ndi abambo ake apakwati, amene anabwerera m'dziko lawo.
Miyezi iwiri yomweyo atangotuluka ku Igupito, Aisraeli anafika kutchire kwa Sinai.
Atanyamuka ku Refidimu, anafika kutchire kwa Sinai napanga msasa uko kumene — ku phiri la Sinai.
Pamenepo Mose anakwera phiri kukasonkhana ndi Mulungu. Yehova anamuiidza kuchokera pamwamba pa phiri, 'Uze banja la Yakobo ndi kulalikira zidzukulu za Isiraeli tere:
"Munaona zimene ndinachita kwa aEgipito. Muona momwe ndinkakuphatira ngati mazira pa mapiko a chipanga, ndikubwera nanu kwa ine.
Tsopano ngati mwera kumvera mawu anga ndikusunga pangano langa, mudzakhala chuma changa chachipekeza pakati pa mitundu yonse; pakuti dziko lonse ndi lane.
Ndipo mudzakhala ufumu wansembe, mtundu wopatulika.' Awa ndi mawu amene muyenera kuuza anthu a Isiraeli.'
Choncho Mose anabwerera nabzera akulu onse a anthu nakauza malamulo onse amene Yehova analamula.
Ndipo anthu onse anayankha pamodzi, 'Tidzachita chilichonse chimene Yehova analamula.' Choncho Mose anabweza yankho la anthu kwa Yehova.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Ndidzabwera kwa iwe m'mtambo wagaga kuti anthu amve ine ndikayankhula nawe. Pamenepo adzakukhulupirira nthawi zonse.' Mose anauza Yehova zimene anthu ananena.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Tsika ukakonzekere anthu kubwera kwanga. Awapatulire lero ndi mawa, nadabe zovala zawo.
Akhale okonzeka pa tsiku lachitatu, chifukwa pa tsiku limenelo Yehova adzatsika pa Phiri la Sinai anthu onse akuona.
Zingirira phiri ndi malire. Chenjezani anthu: "Onani! Musapite pamwamba pa phiri kapena kukhudza malire ake. Aliyense amene akhudza phiri adzaphedwa.
Palibe dzanja limene lingakhudze munthu kapena nyama yogwa; amenyedwe miyala kapena adzulutsidwe ndi mivi. Aphedwe." Koma pemphero la hwiti lakale litamilira, anthu atsogolere pa phiri.'
Choncho Mose anatsika kwa anthu ndi kuwakonzeketsa kulambira, ndipo nadaba zovala zawo.
Anauza, 'Khala okonzeka pa tsiku lachitatu, ndipo mpaka pamenepo musalale ndi akazi.'
M'mawa wa tsiku lachitatu, kubangula kunayamba ndipo mphezi zinawala, ndipo mtambo wagaga unatsikira phiri. Hwiti ilimiririka kwambiri, ndipo anthu onse ananjikana.
Mose anatsogolera anthu kutuluka m'msasa kukasonkhana ndi Mulungu, ndipo anaimirira pansipe pa phiri.
Phiri lonse la Sinai linaotcha ndi utsi chifukwa Yehova anatsika pa licho m'moto. Utsi unakwera ngati utsi wa ng'anjo, ndipo phiri lonse linanjikana kwambiri.
Pamene hwiti inakula ndi kuchuluka, Mose anayankhula, ndipo Mulungu anamuyankha ndi kubangula.
Yehova anatsika pamwamba pa Phiri la Sinai nayitana Mose kumwamba. Mose anakwera.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Tsika ukauchenjeze anthu kuti asasorokere kuyang'ana Yehova, kapena ambiri adzagwa.
Ngakhale awansembe amene amayandikira Yehova nthawi zonse ayenera kuyeretsedwa, kuti Yehova asakawabwetse chilango.'
Koma Ambuye,' Mose anakana, 'anthu sangakwere Phiri la Sinai. Unaitcha iwe mwini kwathu kunena, "Zingirira phiri ndilipatulire ngati lopatulika."
Koma Yehova anauza, 'Tsika, ndipo ubwere ndi Aroni. Koma awansembe ndi anthu asasorokere kufikira pamaso pa Yehova, kapena adzawagwera.'
Choncho Mose anatsika kwa anthu nawauzira.
Pamenepo Mulungu anapatsa anthu malamulo onse awa:
'Ndine Yehova Mulungu wako, amene ndakutulutsa ku Igupito, m'nyumba ya akapolo.
'Usakhale ndi milungu ina kwa ine.
'Usapange chifanizo chilichonse kapena chifano cha chilichonse chakumwamba kapena pansi pa dziko ndi m'nyanja.

Usagwade nalambiranso. Pakuti ine Yehova Mulungu wako ndine Mulungu wauchisono, amene ndilolepera tchimo la makolo pa ana; banja lonse likhudza — ngakhale ana a m'badwo wachitatu ndi wachanayi a amene ankandithetsa.
Koma ndipereka chikondi chosatha kwa mibadwo chinayi ya amene anandikonda ndi kumvera malamulo anga.
'Usagwiritse ntchito dzina la Yehova Mulungu wako mosalungamira. Yehova sadzamulola kusayangidwa amene agwiritse ntchito dzina lake mosalungamira.
'Kumbukirani Sabata ndi kuipatulira.
Mukhala ndi masiku asanu ndi limodzi pa ntchito zanu zamakono,

koma tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri ndi Sabata ya mpumulo yopatulika kwa Yehova Mulungu wako. Pa tsiku limenelo palibe munthu m'banja lako amene ayenera kuchita ntchito — kaya ndi iwe, ana ako aamwamuna ndi aakazi, akapolo aamwamuna ndi aakazi, nkhumba yako, kapena mlendo amene ali pakati pako.

Pakuti m'masiku asanu ndi limodzi Yehova analenga kumwamba ndi nthaka, nyanja, ndi chilichonse mwa izo; koma pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri anapumula. Nthawi ndi yomweyo Yehova anapatulira tsiku la Sabata nalikupatulira.
'Lemekeza abambo ako ndi amayi ako. Pamenepo udzakhala moyo wautali ndi wokwanira m'dziko limene Yehova Mulungu wako akupatsa.
'Usaphere.
'Usachite chigololo.
'Usabe.
'Usapereke umboni wabodza motsutsana ndi mnansi wako.
'Usathawire nyumba ya mnansi wako. Usathawire mkazi wa mnansi wako, kapolo wake wamwamuna kapena wamkazi, ng'ombe yake, kapolo wake wa bulu, kapena chilichonse chimene ndi cha mnansi wako.'
Anthu onse anakumva kubangula ndi kulimba kwa hwiti, ndi anaona mphezi ndi utsi kuchokera ku phiri. Anaimirira patali, anjikana ndi mantha.
Anauza Mose, 'Iwe yankhula ndi ife, ndi tidzamvera. Koma Mulungu asayankhule ndi ife mwachindunji, kapena tidzafa!'
Musachite mantha,' Mose anayankha. 'Mulungu wabwera ndi dera limene kuyesa inu, ndi kuchiritsa mantha ake ku inu kuchepetsa tchimo lanu!
Anthu anaimirira patali, Mose anayandikira mtambo wachifisi kumene Mulungu anali.
Ndipo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Uze anthu a Isiraeli izi: Munaona nokha kuti ndinayankhula nainu kuchokera kumwamba.
Dziwani, musapange milungu ya siliva kapena golide kuti izindane ndi ine.

'Nzengererani guwa lansembe la nthaka, ndipo mupereke nsembe zanu — nsembe zayotcha ndi nsembe za mtendere, nkhumba ndi ng'ombe zanu. Nzengerani guwa lansembe langa m'malo onse kumene ndidzatcha dzina langa kukumbukidwa, ndipo ndidzabwera kwa inu ndidzakudalitsani.
Ngati munzenga guwa lansembe la miyala, mugwiritse ntchito miyala yamkaka yokha. Musaketeke miyala ndi chida chilichonse, pakuti zimenezo zidzaipitsa guwa lansembe.
Ndipo musayandikire guwa lansembe langa ndi kusambira. Ngati mupanga izi, wina akhoza kuona kunyada kwanu pansi pa zovala zanu.'
'Awa ndi malamulo amene uyenera kuwapereka Isiraeli.
'Ukagula kapolo wa mHebri, adzatumikira zaka zisanu ndi limodzi. Pa chaka chachisanu ndi chiwiri, mutulanso pa ufulu wapanda ndebvu.
Anabwera wekha — atuluke wekha. Anali ndi mkazi — mkazi wake atuluke naye.
'Ngati mwini wake anamupatsa mkazi pamene anali kapolo, ndipo anabala ana aamwamuna kapena aakazi, mkazi ndi ana adzakhala a mwini wake. Kapolo iye yekha adzatuluke.
Koma kapolo angathe kunena, "Ndimakonda mwini wanga, mkazi wanga, ndi ana anga. Sindifuna kutuluka ndi ufulu."

Ngati ndi choncho, mwini wake atengereze patsogolo pa Mulungu. Pamenepo mwini atengereze pa khomo kapena pa msongomano wa khomo, namlaze m'khutu ndi sukala. Atatero kapolo adzatumikira mwini wake mpaka muyaya.
'Mwamuna akagulitsa mwana wake wamkazi ngati kapolo, iye sadzatuluka monga amuna.
Ngati mwini wake amkhumudwitsa, atelole kubweredwa. Koma mwini asam'gulitse kwa alendo, pakuti wamphwanya.
Koma ngati mwini anaganiza kwa mwana wake, amuyendetse monga mwana wake.
'Ngati mwamuna akwatira mkazi wina pambuyo pa kapolo wamkazi, asachepetse chakudya, zovala, kapena zikwatizano cha mkazi woyamba.
Ngati sakhutira m'makhalidwe atatu awa, mkazi ateloleke kutuluka mwaufulu, wopanda kulipira kanthu.
'Aliyense amene agwera muntu ndi kumpha, ayenera kuphedwa.
Koma ngati anali zodzoledwa ndi Mulungu — ndiye kuti sinakonzekere — ndidzakonzekera malo amene angathamangire.
Koma ngati munthu apanga zochita kophera mnzake wolungama, agwire kuchokera ngakhale pa guwa langa lansembe ndi kuphedwa.
'Aliyense amene agwera bambo kapena mayi wake ayenera kuphedwa.
'Aliyense amene aiba munthu — kaya anali nawo kapena anawagulitsa — ayenera kuphedwa.
'Aliyense amene adzukure bambo kapena mayi wake ayenera kuphedwa.
'Ngati amuna awiri akakangana, mmodzi waphera mnzake ndi mwala kapena mkono, ndipo walasidwa koma sanaphe —
ngati kenaka amapita kunja ngakhale ndi ndodo, wam'phera saweruzidwa. Koma ayenera kumulipira wolephera ntchito ndi kumukonzera mpaka wachiritsika.
'Ngati mwamuna agwera kapolo wake wamwamuna kapena wamkazi ndi ndodo, ndipo kapolo anaphedwa, mwini ayenera kweruzidwa.
Koma ngati kapolo wakhala ndi moyo tsiku limodzi kapena awiri, mwini sazangoweruzidwa, pakuti kapolo ndi chuma chake.

'Ngati amuna akugwana-gwana ndi godzera mkazi wotenga pakati moti iye abale mwana msanathe nthawi, ndipo palibe bwino linalosali, wolasidwa atengereze chiwerengero chimene mkazi wake kufunsa ndi abweruzidwa.
Koma ngati moyo wopitirira, chilango chikhale: moyo pa moyo,
diso pa diso, dzino pa dzino, dzanja pa dzanja, phazi pa phazi,
kutcherezedwa pa kutcherezedwa, chilonda pa chilonda, ubale pa ubale.
'Ngati mwamuna agwera diso la kapolo wake wamwamuna kapena wamkazi ndipo diso limalidwe, amutulanso mwaufulu m'malo mwa diso lake.
Ngati agwera dzino la kapolo wake wamwamuna kapena wamkazi, atulanso mwaufulu m'malo mwa dzino lake.
'Ngati ng'ombe ya mwamuna igwera mwamuna kapena mkazi ndi kumpha, ng'ombe iyenera kumenyedwa miyala ndipo nyama isadyedwe. M'zimenezi, mwini sazoweruzidwa.
Koma ngati ng'ombe inali ndi mdzana wakugwera anthu kale, ndipo mwini analondolewa koma sanaisunga, ngati ng'ombe ipha munthu, iyenera kumenyedwa miyala, ndipo mwini nawonso ayenera kuphedwa.
Koma ngati banja la wophedwa limlandira nsamba — mwini wa ng'ombe aya ansamba zinthu n'kuombola moyo wake.
'Chilamulo chimodzimodzi chikhale ngati ng'ombe igwere mwana wamwamuna kapena wamkazi.
Koma ngati ng'ombe igwere kapolo wamwamuna kapena wamkazi, mwini wa ng'ombe atalipe mwini wa kapolo mashereke makumi atatu a siliva, ndipo ng'ombe imenyedwe miyala.
'Ngati wina akumba kapena kutsegula chitsime ndipo sachisunga, ndipo ng'ombe kapena bulu wachigwa —
mwini wa chitsime ayenera kupereka nsamba yathunthu kwa mwini wa nyama, koma iye akhale ndi nyama yakufa.
'Ngati ng'ombe ya wina igwera ng'ombe ya mnansi ndi kupherana, iwo awiri agulitse ng'ombe ili ndipogawana mtengo. Agawananso ng'ombe yakufa.
Koma ngati ng'ombe inali ndi mdzana wakugwera anthu kale, ndipo mwini sanaisunga, ayenera kupereka ng'ombe ya moyo m'malo mwa imwe, koma iye akhale ndi ng'ombe yakufa.
'Ngati wina aba ng'ombe kapena nkhumba ndi kupha kapena kugulitsa, amwini wache ng'ombe zinayi m'malo mwa ng'ombe imodzi, ndipo nkhumba zinayi m'malo mwa nkhumba imodzi.
'Ngati wakuba apezedwa akulowera m'nyumba ndi kugweredwa ndi kuphedwa, wampheya sazoweruzidwa.
Koma ngati zinachitika usana, wampheya azoweruzidwa ndi mlandu. "Wakuba amene apezedwe ayenera kulipira zinthu zonse zimene anaba. Ngati sakhoza kulipira, agulitsidwe ngati kapolo kupereka nsamba.
Ngati nyama imene anaba ipezeka m'dzanja lake, kaya ng'ombe, bulu, kapena nkhumba, ayenera kulipiranso m'nzisano yake.

'Ngati nyama ikudya m'munda kapena m'munda wa mpesa, ndipo mwini wachiletse kutuluka ndi kudya m'munda wa mnzake, mwini wa nyama ayenera kulipira nsamba ya mchipatso wabwino kwambiri wa munda wake kapena mpesa wake.
'Ngati moto unanyakula pang'ambira minofu ndipo moto unayamba kuswa m'munda wa mnzake, ndi kuyasa masamba kapena mbewu yosadulidwa kapena munda wonse, woyatsha moto ayenera kulipira nsamba.
'Ngati wina avekedza mnansi wake ndalama kapena katundu kuti asunga, ndipo ziba m'nyumba ya mnansi, ngati wakuba apezedwe, ayenera kulipira kangwirire kake.
Koma ngati wakuba sapezedwe, mwini nyumba atengereze patsogolo pa Mulungu kuti aone ngati iye anaba katundu wa mnansi.

'Ngati kuna mikangano pakati pa anthu awiri amene amati, mmodzi ngati mwini wa ng'ombe, bulu, nkhumba, zovala, kapena katundu ulifonse wotayika — awiri abwere patsogolo pa Mulungu. Amene Mulungu adzawaipitse ayenera kulipira kangwirire kake kwa mnzake.
'Ngati wina aika bulu, ng'ombe, nkhumba, kapena nyama inayake kwa mnansi wake kuti asunga, ndipo yafa kapena yonetsa kapena yakwiritsidwa, wopanda umboni —
mnansi mwalumbe patsogolo pa Yehova. Ngati Yehova achitikirira kuti mnansi sanaba katundu, mwini ayenera kulandira mlandu, ndipo kulipiranso sikuyenera.
Koma ngati zibidwa, mwini nyumba ayenera kulipira nsamba kwa mwini wa nyama.
Ngati nyama inawonjezedwa ndi chirombo cha kutchire, mwini atengereze mbali za nyama kuti aone, ndipo kulipira sikuyenera.
'Ngati wina agawa nyama ndi mnansi wake ndipo yoposa, mwini wosaona atenga nsamba yathunthu.
Koma ngati mwini anali nawo, kulipira sikuyenera. Ngati inabalekedwa, nyongedwa linali m'mtengo wake wakubaleka.
'Ngati mwamuna atsegula mtsikana wonkha wosaongedwa ndipo agone naye, ayenera kulipira mwana wamkazi ndi kumkwatira.
Koma ngati abambo wake akana kumupereka, mwamuna ayenera kulipira ndalama yofanana ndi mtengo wa mtsikana wosaongedwa.
'Musalilikitse mkazi wachilombo.
'Aliyense amene agone ndi nyama ayenera kuphedwa mosataya.
'Aliyense amene apelike nsembe kwa milungu inayake — osati Yehova — aonongeka.
'Musazunze kapena kuopsyetsa alendo m'njira iliyonse. Ikumbukireni kuti ninuyo munali alendo m'dziko la Igupito.
'Musaopsyetse ndi chitauko kapena mbwana.
Ngati muwaopsyetsa m'njira inayake ndi alira kwa ine, ndithu ndidzamva kulira kwawo.
Mkangala wanga udzaima motsutsana ndi inu, ndipo ndidzakuphani ndi lupanga. Ndipo akazi anu adzakhala amasiye ndi ana anu adzakhala amasiye.
'Ngati mulipe ndalama munthu wina wa anthu anga amene ali wosowa, musamugwiritse ntchito ngati woweza ndalama kwa iye. Musam'peze ndi chindapusa.
Ngati mugwiritse ntchito choval chamwandu cha mnansi wako ngati chithandizo, mubwezere asanafike dzuwa.
Zoval izi zitha kukhala choval chokha cha mnansi wako. Kodi munthu angagone bwanji wopanda choval? Ngati akulira kwa ine chifukwa cha izi, ndidzamvera, pakuti ndine wachifundo.
'Usadzukure Mulungu kapena kutemberera wolamulira wa anthu ako.
'Usagweze kunipereka chilichonse cha mbewu zako ndi zakuphwa kwako. "Ndiperekanso woyamba kubadwa aamwamuna ako.
'Uchite chimodzimodzi kwa ng'ombe zako, nkhumba ndi mbuzi zako. Siya mwana ndi mayi wake kwa masiku asanu ndi awiri; kenaka undipe pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri.
'Muzakhala anthu anga opatulika. Choncho musamadye nyama iliyonse imene chirombo cha kutchire chadya ndi kuchopeka. Iponyereni agalu.
'Usapitilize mabodza. Usagwirizane ndi oyipa kuona umboni wabodza.
'Usamange gulu m'chochita chabwino. Ukayitanidwa kuona umboni m'mikangano, usachitike ndi gulu kusinthitsa chilungamo.
Ndipo usafavore wina chifukwa cha kuti ndi wosauka.
'Ngati ukumana ndi ng'ombe kapena bulu wa adani wako wosochera, uzibweretse kwa mwini.
Ngati uona bulu wa wina amene akukudana wagwa pansi ndi katundu wake, usam'siyire olo siyira — umumate mukamchitire.
'M'milandu, usaletse chilungamo kwa wosaukitsidwa.
'Usazipanga kwa mlandu wabodza. Usapha wopanda mlandu kapena wolungama, pakuti ine ndidzandilola wopanda mlandu ngakhale asayangidwe.
'Usalandire chinyengo, pakuti chinyengo chidzachifitisa dziso la wosaona; ndi kumenyetsa mwache za wachilungamo.
