'Usaopsyetse alendo. Mudziwa momwe alendo amakumana ndi moyo, chifukwa ninuyo munali alendo m'dziko la Igupito.
'Dzalani ndi kukolola munda wako zaka zisanu ndi limodzi,

koma siyirani dziko lanu kuti lilandidwe ndi kukhala losalimidwa pa chaka cha zana la misa. Pamenepo osauka pakati pako atenga zikulukulu. Zosala zikhale kwa nyama za kutchire. Uchite chimodzimodzi ndi mpesa ndi mpesa wako wa mafuta.

'Mukhale ndi masiku asanu ndi limodzi pa ntchito yako, koma pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri muzime. Izi zipatse ng'ombe yako ndi bulu wako mpumulo. Ndiponso zipatse kapolo wako ndi mlendo mpumulo ndikuwakomola.
'Buka bwino malamulo anga onse. Usatchule mazina a milungu ina. Asatulutsedwe m'kamwa mwako.
'Chaka ndi chaka muzindichitire chikondwerero katatu.

Choyamba, kondwererani Chikondwerero cha Mkate Wopanda Thobwa. Masiku asanu ndi awiri muzidya mkate wopanda thobwa, monga ndinakulamulani. Kondwererani pa nthawi yake m'mwezi wa Abibu — nthawi ya chikondwerero ichi — pakuti m'mwezi umodziwo munanyamuka ku Igupito. Palibe amene afike pamaso panga wopanda mphatso.

'Chachiwiri, kondwererani Chikondwerero cha Kukolola, ndi mbewu zoyamba za zokolola kwanu. 'Pachitatu, kondwererani Chikondwerero cha Kukolola pa Chakumapeto cha Nthawi ya Kokolola, mukadzakolola mbewu zonse m'minda yanu.
Katatu m'chaka, amuna onse a Isiraeli afike pamaso pa Mbuye, Yehova.
'Usapereke magazi a nsembe yanga pamodzi ndi chakudya cha thobwa. Ndipo mafuta a nsembe ya chikondwerero asasalire mpaka m'mawa.
'Pakukolola munda wako, bweretsa zina za mbewu zoyamba ku nyumba ya Yehova Mulungu wako. "Usaphike wana wa mbuzi ya nkhumba m'mkaka wa mayi wake.
'Taona, ndikutuma mngelo patsogolo pako kukuteteza pa ulendo wako ndi kukufikitsa ku malo amene ndakonzekera.
Buka bwino ndi kumva mawu ake. Usam'pilikitsire, pakuti sadzakhululuka machimo anu — dzina langa lili mwa iye.
Koma ngati uchita mmene analamulira nthawi zonse ndi kumvera malamulo anga, ndidzakhala mdani wa adani ako ndi kuophosa amene akuophetsa.
Pakuti mngelo wanga adzayenda patsogolo pako nakubweretsa ku dziko la aAmori, aHiti, aPerezi, aKanani, aHivi, ndi aYebusi, ndipo ndidzawaononga.
Usamalambire milungu yawo kapena kuitumikira m'njira inayake kapena kutsata machitidwe awo abvi. M'malo mwake, ionsekere ndi kumisatsa mafano awo oyera.
'Muzitumikira Yehova Mulungu wanu. Ngati mwachita, ndidzakudalitsani chakudya ndi madzi ndi kukutetezani ku matenda.
Pamudzako sadzakhala palibe kubabikana ndi kusiya pa nzika ya nyama — ndi kukupatsa moyo wautali.
'Ndidzatumiza mantha anga patsogolo pako ndikupangitsa anthu onse amene ufika lawo kusenzeka ndi mantha. Ndidzapangitsa adani ako onse kuthawa.
Ndidzatumiza mzidwi patsogolo pako kuthamangitsa aHivi, aKanani, ndi aHiti.
Koma siwathamangitsa chaka chimodzi — chifukwa dziko lidzakhala losataliwa ndipo nyama za kutchire zidzachuluka ndikuopsyeza.
Ndidzawathamangitsa pang'ono pang'ono, mpaka anthu anu achuluke mokwanira kutenga dziko.

Ndipo ndidzaika malire anu kuchokera ku Nyanja Ilokomera mpaka Nyanja ya Mediteraneya, kuchokera ku chipululu chakum'mawa mpaka Mtsinje wa Eufurate. Ndidzaika anthu okhala m'dziko muno m'manja mwanu, ndipo mudzawathamangitsa patsogolo panu.
'Usapange mgwirizano nawo kapena ndi milungu yawo.
Asakhale m'dziko lanu, kapena adzakupangitseni kuchimwa motsutsana ndi ine. Ngati muzitumikira milungu yawo, izidzakhala chidima kwa inu.'
Pamenepo Yehova analamula Mose, 'Kwera kwa ine, iwe ndi Aroni, Nadabu, Abihu, ndi akulu makumi asanu ndi awiri a Isiraeli. Mulambire Mulungu mukhale patali.
Mose yekha ndi wololedwa kuyandikira Yehova. Ena asayandikire, ndipo palibe wina pakati pa anthu amene angakwere phiri naye.'
Pamenepo Mose anatsika kwa anthu ndi kuwafotokozera malamulo onse ndi malamulo amene Yehova anamupatsa. Anthu onse anayankha pamodzi, 'Tidzachita chilichonse chimene Yehova analamula.'
Pamenepo Mose analemba malamulo onse a Yehova. Kucha kwake Mose anadzuka nazenga guwa lansembe pansi pa phiri, ndipo anaimika mitengo khumi ndi iwiri, mtengo umodzi pa fuko lililonse la Isiraeli.
Kenaka anatuma amuna ang'ono a Isiraeli kukapereka nsembe zayotcha ndipo nakaphera ng'ombe ngati nsembe za mtendere kwa Yehova.
Mose anaika theka la magazi m'zimoyo. Ndi theka linalosali anachiphweteka pa guwa lansembe.
Kenaka anatenga Buku la Pangano ndi kuliwerengera anthu odzikumba. Iwo anayankhula kachiwiri, 'Tidzachita chilichonse chimene Yehova analamula. Tidzamvera.'
Pamenepo Mose anatenga magazi m'zimoyo nakachiphweteka pa anthu, nanena, 'Taoni, magazi awa atsimikizira pangano limene Yehova wapanga ndi inu, pokhazikika pa malamulo onse awa.'
Pamenepo Mose, Aroni, Nadabu, Abihu, ndi akulu makumi asanu ndi awiri a Isiraeli anakwera phiri.
Kumeneko anaona Mulungu wa Isiraeli. Pansi pa mapazi ake panali ngati kapeto wopangidwa ndi sapafaya, wolenguka ngati thambo lili pano.
Ndipo ngakhale atsogoleri awa a Isiraeli anaona Mulungu, Iye sanawononge. Iwo anadya ndi kumwa pamaso pake!
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose, 'Bwera kwa ine pa phiri. Khalako, ndipo ndidzakupatsa maodzilapa ayera amene ndalemba pa iwo malamulo ndi mitemo kuti uphunzitse anthu.'
Choncho Mose ndi mthandizi wake Yoswa ananyamuka, ndipo Mose anakwera phiri la Mulungu.
Mose anauza akulu, 'Khalani apa mukadikire mpaka tibweranso. Aroni ndi Huri ali nanu. Ngati kuna nkhani m'nthawi yodikira, aziyenda nawo.'
Pamenepo Mose anakwera phiri, ndipo thabiti linaiphimbira.
Ulemu wa Yehova unakhazikika pa Phiri la Sinai, ndipo thabiti linaliiphimbira kwa masiku asanu ndi limodzi. Pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri Yehova anayitana Mose kuchokera pakati mwa thabiti.
Aisraeli oima pansi pa phiri, ulemu wa Yehova unaonekera pamwamba ngati moto wolawika.
Pamenepo Mose analowa m'thabiti pamene anakwera phiri. Anakhala pa phiri masiku makumi anayi ndi masiku makumi anayi usiku.
Yehova anauza Mose,
'Uze anthu a Isiraeli kuti anibweretse mphatso zoyera. Landira mphatso kuchokera kwa onse amene mitima yawo ikuwagosora kumpereka.
Awa ndi mphatso zoyera zimene mungalandira kwa iwo: golide, siliva, ndi mkuwa;
chingwe cha buluu, chofiira ndi chopatsidwa; nsalu yokongola ndi ubweya wa mbuzi;
zikopa za nkhosa zokhadzitidwa ndi zikopa za nyambe zokongola; mtengo wa akasia;
mafuta a lampu; zakuwonjezera zakupalata za mafuta okoza ndi lubani wokumbutsa;
miyala ya onuxi, ndi miyala ina yokongola yokaikidwa m'efodi ndi chipanda cha wansembe.
'Panga iyeni banja la Isiraeli nyumba yoyera kuti ndikhale pakati pawo.
Muzenga hema la kusonkhana ndi katundu wake wonse monga chilangizo chimene ndikuonetsa.
'Banja la Isiraeli lipange bokosi la mtengo wa akasia — bukhali lautali wa mamita imodzi ndi hafu, chapakati wa mamita imodzi, ndi chakuya wa mamita imodzi.
Likhadzitire mkati ndi kunja ndi golide lachena, ndipo liikire mphete ya golide m'zingalamu zake.
Tumba mphete zinayi za golide ndipo iziike pa zako zinayi za pansi, ziwiri m'mbali imodzi.
Panga miti ndi mtengo wa akasia ukhadzite ndi golide.
Lowetsa miti m'mphete m'mbali zonse za Bokosi kuti wanyamule.
Miti imeneyi ikhale mkati mwa mphete nthawi zonse; usaichotse.
Bokosi litadzazidwa, ikamo maodzilapa oyera amene ndidzakupatsa.
'Pamenepo panga chiphiko cha Bokosi — malo odzozola — ndi golide lachena. Lakhali lautali wa mamita imodzi ndi hafu ndi chapakati wa mamita imodzi.
Pamenepo panga angelo awiri okuufa ndi golide wovimbidwa, nawaikira ku mpuni awiri a chiphiko cha dzozola.
Konzekera angelo mmodzi pa muundo umodzi wa chiphiko cha dzozola, ndi angelo wina pa muundo wina. Ayenera kukhala mgawanano umodzi wa golide.
Angelo adzayang'ana wina ndi mzake ndi kuyang'ana pansi pa chiphiko cha dzozola. Ndi mapiko awo oyanjika pamwamba, adzachipanga nacho.
Ikamo m'Bokosi maodzilapa amene ndidzakupatsa. Kenaka ikira chiphiko cha dzozola pamwamba pa Bokosi.

Ndidzakumana nawe ndi kuyankhula nawe kuchokera pamwamba pa chiphiko cha dzozola pakati pa angelo awiri okuufa pa Bokosi la Pangano. Kuchokera kumeneko ndidzakupatsa malamulo anga onse kwa anthu a Isiraeli.
'Pamenepo panga tebulo la mtengo wa akasia, lautali wa mamita imodzi, chapakati wa hafu ya mamita, ndi chakuya wa mamita imodzi.
Likhadzitire ndi golide lachena ndipo liikireko mphete ya golide m'zingalamu zake.
Panga ulola wa santimita khumi ndi isanu m'zingalamu mwake zonse, ndipo liikireko mphete ya golide m'zingalamu.
Panga mphete zinayi za golide za tebulo ndipo ziike m'ngodya zinayi m'pafupi ndi miyendo yake minai.
Ziike pafupi ndi ulola kuti zisunge miti ya kuyendetsa tebulo.
Panga miti izi ndi mtengo wa akasia ndi kuikhadzitira golide. Naigwiritse ntchito pakuchotsa tebulo.
Panga zithangu za golide zachena za tebulo — mbiya, mapula, zimoyo, ndi mikebe — zogwiritsidwa ntchito pa chipereka cha madzi.
Ikira pa tebulo mkate wa Kuimirira kuti ukhale pamaso panga nthawi zonse.
'Panga chisoko cha kuwala cha golide lachena, lovimbidwa. Panga chisoko chonse ndi zochikozoza za mgawanano umodzi — muundo wachagwa, mtengo wazikati, mikeka ya lampu, myungiyungi, ndi mapetala.
Panga ndi nthambi zisanu ndi limodzi zichokera kuchokera ku mtengo wazikati, zitatu m'mbali imodzi.
Pa nthambi zisanu ndi limodzi, imodzi ndi imodzi iziye mikeka itatu yopangidwa ngati maluwa a amondi ndi myungiyungi ndi mapetala.
Pa mtengo wazikati wa chisoko cha kuwala panga mikeka inayi yopangidwa ngati maluwa a amondi ndi myungiyungi ndi mapetala.
Padzakhala myungiyungi imodzi pansi pa nthambi iliyonse zimene nthambi zisanu ndi limodzi zichokera ku mtengo wazikati.
Myungiyungi ndi nthambi zonse zikhale mgawanano umodzi ndi mtengo wazikati, zivimbidwe ndi golide lachena.
Pamenepo panga malampu asanu ndi awiri a chisoko cha kuwala, ndi uwachite kuti awale patsogolo.
Kachitiko ka kupulukaniza malampu ndi zimoyo mayenera kumanga ndi golide lachena.
Mudzadziwa kilogiramu makumi atatu ndi asanu ndi awiri za golide lachena chisoko cha kuwala ndi zida zake.
'Onani mwachidwirire kuti mupange zonse monga chilangizo chimene ndakuonetserako pa phiri.
'Panga hema la kusonkhana ndi nsalu khumi zolukidwa mwanzeru za nsalu yokongola. Kozozani nsalu izi ndi chingwe cha buluu, chofiira ndi chopatsidwa ndi angelo olukidwa mwanzeru.
Nsalu khumi zonse ziyenera kukhala ndi kukula kotheratu — mamita khumi ndi anayi utali ndi mamita awiri chapakati.
Sungani nsalu zisanu pamodzi kukhala nsalu yautali imodzi, kenaka sungani zina zisanu kukhala nsalu yachiwiri yautali.
Ikani malupu a chingwe cha buluu m'mbali ya nsalu yokhomelana m'mphepete wa nsalu yachisanu m'chisanthi choyamba.
Malupu makumi asanu pa nsalu yochikhomelana ayenera kugwirizana ndi malupu makumi asanu a nsalu inayo.
Pamenepo panga zikhomo makumi asanu za golide ndi kuzisungira nsalu zaautali zinayi pamodzi nazo. Motero hema la kusonkhana lidzakhala mgawanano umodzi.
'Panga nsalu khumi ndi imodzi za ubweya wa mbuzi kuti zisunge hema la kusonkhana.
Nsalu khumi ndi imodzi izi ziyenera kukhala kukula kotheratu — mamita khumi ndi asanu utali ndi mamita awiri chapakati.

Sungani nsalu zisanu pamodzi kukhala nsalu yautali imodzi, ndipo sungani nsalu zina zisanu ndi limodzi kukhala nsalu yachiwiri. Tolani mamita imodzi ya zinthu za nsalu yachiwiri kuzifungamitsa pa tsogolo la hema.
Panga malupu makumi asanu m'mbali modzi ya nsalu yachikulu iliyonse.
Pamenepo panga zikhomo makumi asanu za mkuwa, nazikhometse m'malupu a nsalu zaautali. Motero nsalu zia hema zidzakhala mgawanano umodzi.
Mamita imodzi wosara wa nsalu iya ya hema isiire ndi kufungamira kumbuyo kwa hema la kusonkhana.
Tolani santimita makumi akhumi ndi asanu m'mbali iliyonse kuti hema la kusonkhana liphimbidwe bwino.
Petani chiphiko cha hema ndi pamwamba la zikopa za nkhosa zokhadzitidwa ndi pamwamba la zikopa za nyambe zokongola.
'Pa choyimba cha hema la kusonkhana, panga miyendelo ya mtengo wa akasia.
Miyendelo iliyonse iyenera kukhala mamita asanu utali ndi hafu ya mamita chapakati,
ndi madzitse awiri pa miyendelo iliyonse. Panga miyendelo yonse motero.
Panga miyendelo makumi awiri kuchota nsalu chakum'mwera.
Panganganso mitengo makumi anayi ya siliva — mitengo iwiri pansi pa miyendelo iliyonse, madzitse ake alowera mwamphete.
Chakumpoto wa hema panga miyendelo ina makumi awiri,
ndi mitengo yawo makumi anayi ya siliva, mitengo iwiri pansi pa miyendelo iliyonse.
Panga miyendelo isanu ndi limodzi kumbuyo — chakum'madzulo — kwa hema.
Pamodzi ndi miyendelo iwiri yokhaza ngodya za kumbuyo kwa hema.
Miyendelo ingodya izi ikhale yolangizana pansi ndipo izikhomane bwino pamwamba ndi mphete imodzi — yakhale ngodya imodzi. Miyendelo ingodya iwiri izi ipangidwe moteromo.
Pamenepo miyendelo isanu ndi itatu idzakhala kumbuyo kwa hema, yaika m'mitengo khumi ndi zisanu ndi limodzi ya siliva — mitengo iwiri pansi pa miyendelo iliyonse.
'Panga mizipalo ya mtengo wa akasia, isanu pa miyendelo chakumpoto
ndipo isanu chakum'mwera. Panganganso mizipalo isanu ya kumbuyo kwa hema chakum'madzulo.
Mzipalo wa pakati, wolayitsidwa chapakati pa miyendelo, uyenera kupita chakuya kuchokera muundo umodzi mpaka wina.
Khadzitani miyendelo ndi golide ndipo panga mphete za golide kuchota mizipalo. Khadzitanso mizipalo ndi golide.
'Imirani hema la kusonkhana monga chilangizo chimene unaonetsereka pa phiri.
'Mkati mwa hema la kusonkhana panga nsalu yocheuluka ndi nsalu yokongola. Ikozozani ndi chingwe cha buluu, chofiira ndi chopatsidwa ndi angelo olukidwa mwanzeru.
Iksirirani nsalu izi pa zikhomo za golide zoika pa mitengo inayi ya akasia. Khadzitani mitengo izi ndi golide, iaisiyani pa mitengo inayi ya siliva.
Iksirirani nsalu izi ndi zikhomo, kenaka bweretsa Bokosi la Pangano m'chipinda cha kumbuyo kwake. Nsalu imeneyi idzasiyana Chipinda Chopatulika ndi Chipinda Chopatulika Kwambiri.
'Pamenepo ikira chiphiko cha Bokosi — malo odzozola — pamwamba pa Bokosi la Pangano mkati mwa Chipinda Chopatulika Kwambiri.
Ikira tebulo kunja kwa nsalu ya mkati chakumpoto kwa hema la kusonkhana, ndipo ikira chisoko cha kuwala kutsutsa kwa chipinda chakum'mwera.
'Panga nsalu ina ya pa mlomo wa hema lopatulika. Ipange ndi nsalu yokongola ndi kuikolosera ndi mchitidwe wokongola, ndi chingwe cha buluu, chofiira ndi chopatsidwa.
Panga mitengo isanu ya akasia ndi kuikhadzitira golide, ndi kusirira nsalu ndi zikhomo za golide. Tumba mitengo ya mkuwa isanu.
'Ndi mtengo wa akasia, zenga guwa lansembe laing'onoing'ono la nsanu. Liyenera kukhala mamita awiri ndi hafu m'mbali yiliyonse, ndi mamita imodzi ndi hafu chakuya.
Panga nyanga pa ngodya zake zinayi kotheratu, kuti nyanga ndi guwa zikhale mgawanano umodzi. Khadzitira guwa ndi mkuwa.
Panga zida za guwa lansmebe ndi mkuwa — zimoyo za utoto, zifuwa, zimoyo za madzi, mafoloko a nyama, ndi zipanga.
Panga nsankha ya mkuwa yake, ndi ikira mphete zinayi za mkuwa pa ngodya zinayi za nsankha.
Ikira nsankha chapakati pa ubandakira wa guwa lansmebe, pansi pa mlola.
Pa kuyendetsa guwa lansembe, panga miti ya mtengo wa akasia ndi kuikhadzitira mkuwa.
Lowetsa miti m'mphete m'mbali zonse za guwa lansembe.
Guwa lansembe lipangidwe lolowera, la miyendelo. Lipangidwe monga unaonetsereka pa phiri.
'Pamenepo panga bwalo la hema la kusonkhana, lozingirirana ndi nsalu zolukidwa mwanzeru za nsalu yokongola. Chakum'mwera nsalu zikhale mamita makumi asanu utali.
Zikhale n'mitengo makumi awiri yoimitsidwa pa mitengo makumi awiri ya mkuwa. Sirira nsalu ndi zikhomo ndi mphete za siliva.
Panga nsalu zachimodzimodzi chakumpoto — mamita makumi asanu ya nsalu, ndi mitengo makumi awiri yoimitsidwa pa mitengo ya mkuwa, miphete ndi zikhomo za siliva.
Nsalu chakum'madzulo wa bwalo zikhale mamita makumi awiri ndi asanu utali, ndi mitengo khumi yoimitsidwa pa mitengo khumi.
Chakum'mawa — tsogolo — bwalo likhale mamita makumi awiri ndi asanu utali.
Tsogolo la bwalo likhale chakum'mawa, la pa nsalu ziwiri. Nsalu ya kwanja imodzi iyenera kukhala mamita asanu ndi awiri ndi hafu, yoimitsidwa pa mitengo itatu ndi mitengo ya mkuwa itatu.
Nsalu ya kwanja inayo iyenera nawonso kukhala mamita asanu ndi awiri ndi hafu, yoimitsidwa pa mitengo itatu ndi mitengo ya mkuwa itatu.

'Pa mlomo wa bwalo panga nsalu yautali wa mamita khumi, yapangidwa ndi nsalu yokongola ndi kukiolosera ndi mchitidwe wokongola wokongola, ndi chingwe cha buluu, chofiira ndi chopatsidwa. Yoimitsidwe ndi mitengo inayi, iliyonse pa muundo wake wa mkuwa.
Mitengo yonse ya bwalo iyenera kukhala ndi mphete ndi zikhomo za siliva ndi mitengo ya mkuwa.
Choncho bwalo lonse likhale mamita makumi asanu utali ndi mamita makumi awiri ndi asanu chapakati, ndi nsalu za mamita awiri ndi hafu, zapangidwa ndi nsalu yokongola. Mitengo ya mkuwa.
'Zida zonse zogwiritsidwa ntchito m'masabalairo a hema la kusonkhana, kuphatikiza mikongo yonse ya hema ndi bwalo, ndi ya mkuwa.
'Lamulirani anthu a Isiraeli kukubwererani mafuta achena a maolivi okankha a pa lampu, kuti malampu awale nthawi zonse.

Chisoko cha kuwala chidzaima m'hema la kusonkhana, patsogolo pa nsalu ya mkati yophimba Bokosi la Pangano. Aroni ndi ana ake ayenera kusunga malampu awale pamaso pa Yehova usiku wonse. Ichi ndi chilamulo chosatha kwa anthu a Isiraeli, chisuungidwe m'badwo ndi m'badwo.
'Yitana mlongo wako Aroni, ndi ana ake, Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazara, ndi Itamara. Apatuliranso pakati pa anthu a Isiraeli kuti anditumikire ngati awansembe.
Panga zovala zoyera za Aroni zokongola ndi zaulemu.
Uze anthu onse olukidwa amwanzeru amene wawadzaza ndi mzimu wa nzeru. Bwanika zovala za Aroni zomupatuliranso kuti atumikire ngati wansembe wa ine.

Izi ndi zovala zimene ayenera kupangidwa: chipanda, efodi, roba ya buluu, mchigayo wopangidwa ndi mzere, chikwama, ndi lubinde. Pamenepo bwanikani zovala zoyera izi kwa mlongo wako Aroni ndi ana ake kuti azitumikira ngati awansembe.
Choncho wapatse nsalu yokongola, chingwe cha golide, chingwe cha buluu, chofiira ndi chopatsidwa.
'Akadamu ayenera kupanga efodi ndi nsalu yokongola ndi kuiikolosera ndi golide ndi chingwe cha buluu, chofiira ndi chopatsidwa.
Lidzakhala la zigawo ziwiri, tsogolo ndi kumbuyo, zokhometsa pamapewa ndi zotolewa pamapewa.
Lubinde lokongola lidzapangidwa ndi zinthu zomwezomwe: nsalu yokongola yolukidwa ndi golide ndi chingwe cha buluu, chofiira ndi chopatsidwa.
'Tenga miyala iwiri ya onuxi ndi kulemba pa iyo mayina a mafuko a Isiraeli.
Mayina asanu ndi limodzi akhale pa miyala iliyonse, olembedwa monga mobadwira a ana oyamba kubadwa a Isiraeli.
Lemba mayina awa pa miyala iwiri monga mlembera wa chimabu malembera. Ndipo aikhire m'ziponda za golide.

Mangizani miyala iwiri pa mapewa a efodi ngati chikumbuso chakuti Aroni amayimira anthu a Isiraeli. Aroni azinyamula mayina awa pa mapewa ake ngati chikumbuso chosatha pamene afikira pamaso pa Yehova.
Panga ziponda za golide,
kenaka sungani chingwe chiwiri cha golide lachena ndipo ikhometse pa ziponda m'mapewa a efodi.
'Pamenepo, ndi luso ndi chisamaliro, panga chipanda chokafunsa kwa Mulungu. Pange kukhala ngati efodi, ndi nsalu yokongola ndi golide ndi chingwe cha buluu, chofiira ndi chopatsidwa.
Panga chipanda cha zinthu zitatu mwazipande ndi kuzisengera kukhala pepala la santimita makumi awiri ndi asanu m'mbali yiliyonse.
Ikira miyala inayi ya nyamulokole apa. Mzere woyamba uzitenga kanaeli iofiira, periditoti ya buluu yakuda, ndi smaragidi.
Mzere wachiwiri uzitenga tiyukwazi, lapis lazuli ya buluu, ndi peniina yoyera.
Mzere wachitatu uzitenga yakinti ya chili, akati, ndi amethisi ya chofiira.
Mzere wachinayi uzitenga berili ya buluu-obiriwira, onuxi, ndi yaspi obiriwira. Miyala yonse imeneyi ikhometse ndi golide.
Miyala iliyonse iziimira fuko limodzi la ana khumi ndi awiri a Isiraeli, ndipo dzina la fuko lilembe pa iyo monga chimabu.
'Pa kuchivunda chipanda ku efodi, panga zingwe zokolezeka za golide lachena.
Pamenepo panga mphete ziwiri za golide ndi zikhometse pa ngodya zachamwamba za chipanda.
Mangizani zingwe ziwiri za golide pa mphete ziwiri pa chipanda.
Mangizani malekezero a mazingwe pa ziponda pamapewa a efodi.
Pamenepo panga mphete ziwiri zina za golide ndi zikhometse ku mbali za mkati za chipanda pafupi ndi efodi.
Ndiponso panga mphete ziwiri zina za golide ndi zikhometse ku tsogolo la efodi, pansi pa pamapewa, pafupi ndi chingwe cha efodi.
Pamenepo mangizani mphete za pansi za chipanda ku mphete za efodi ndi chingwe cha buluu. Izi zidzasunga chipanda bwino pa efodi pamwamba pa lubinde.

'Motero Aroni adzanyamula mayina a mafuko a Isiraeli pa chipanda choyera pa mtima wake pamene akufikira m'chipinda chopatulika. Izi zikhale chikumbuso chosatha chakuti iye ayimira anthu pamaso pa Yehova.

Ikira Urimu ndi Timumimu m'chipanda choyera kuti zinyamulidwe pa mtima wa Aroni pamene akufikira pamaso pa Yehova. Motero Aroni adzanyamula nyengo nthawi zonse pa mtima wake chinthu chimene chimagwiritsidwa ntchito kufunafuna chifuniro cha Yehova kwa anthu ake pamene akufikira pamaso pa Yehova.
'Panga roba yofuma ndi efodi ndi nsalu imodzi ya buluu,
ndi kuwaza pa mutu wa Aroni pakati pake. Lolani mlomo pamwamba ulekezedwe ndi chingwe kuti usathyoke.
Panga mapaundi a chingwe cha buluu, chofiira ndi chopatsidwa, ndi azikhome pa chingalamu cha roba, ndi zikhomo za golide pakati pawo.
Mapaundi a golide ndi zikhomo akhale wosakhalitsa m'zingalamu mwake.
Aroni adzavala roba iyi pamene atumikira, ndipo zikhomo zidzakoma pamene akulowa ndi kutuluka pamaso pa Yehova m'chipinda chopatulika. Ngati avala, sadzafa.
'Pamenepo panga chizindikiro cha golide lachena ndipo ulemba pa chizo ngati chidole: WOPATULIKA KWA YEHOVA.
Mchite chingwe cha buluu chizo ndipo uchimangize pa tsogolo la chikwama cha wansembe, kumene uyenera kukhala.
Aroni ayenera kuvala pa mphumi yake kuti amuchotse mlandu iliyonse wa anthu a Isiraeli pamene anadzoza chipereka choyera. Uyenera kukhala pa mphumi yake nthawi zonse kuti Yehova walandire anthu.
'Luka mchigayo wa Aroni ndi nsalu yokongola. Panga chikwama ndi nsalu inayo. Panganganso lubinde ndi kulilembamo mzere wokongola ndi chingwe.
'Kwa ana a Aroni, panga michigayo, malubinde, ndi zikwama zapadera zokongola ndi zaulemu.
Vakanisani mlongo wako Aroni ndi ana ake ndi zovala izi, kenaka izozani ndi kuzisungira. Izipatuliranso kuti azitumikire ngati awansembe.
Panganganso zovala za nsalu m'munsi kwa iwo, zikhale ku chiuno mpaka mathaya. Ndi kuzoka ana aachineneri.

Izi ziyenera kuvikidwa pamene Aroni ndi ana ake alowa m'hema la kusonkhana kapena kuyandikira guwa lansembe m'chipinda chopatulika kuchita ntchito ya awansembe. Atatero sadzalandira mlandu nawupha. Ichi ndi chilamulo chosatha kwa Aroni ndi zidzukulu zake.
'Ichi ndi mwambo amene uyenera kumtsata ukadzoza Aroni ndi ana ake kuti anditumikire ngati awansembe: Tenga ng'ombe wamwamuna mmodzi ndi nkhumba ziwiri zopanda bwalo.
Kenaka, ndi ufa wosankhidwa wopanda thobwa, panga mkate, mikate yonyoka yosanjikidwa ndi mafuta, ndi mkate yochabechabe ndi mafuta.
Ikani zonse m'dengu imodzi, ndipo bweretsa mto wa nkhumba ndi nkhumba ziwiri.
'Bweretsa Aroni ndi ana ake ku mlomo wa hema la kusonkhana, nawasamba ndi madzi.
Veka Aroni zovala zake zowansembe — mchigayo, roba ndi efodi, efodi yomwe, ndi chipanda. Kenaka mumange lubinde la efodi m'mwake.
Ikani chikwama pa mutu wake, ndi mangizani chizindikiro choyera pa chikwama.
Pamenepo muzozeni ndi mafuta okoza yoitsitsa pamwamba pa mutu wake.
Pamenepo bweretsa ana ake, nawaveke michigayo.

Mmangiraniseni malubinde pa chiuno cha Aroni ndi ana ake, ndipo mukaimire zikwama zapadera pa iwo. Pamenepo ufumu wa wansembe udzakhala wawo mwa chilamulo mpaka muyaya. Motero mudzasunga Aroni ndi ana ake.
'Bweretsa ng'ombe ku mlomo wa hema la kusonkhana, kumene Aroni ndi ana ake adzaika dzanja lawo pa mutu wake.
Kenaka ipha ng'ombe pamaso pa Yehova pa mlomo wa hema la kusonkhana.
Ikani magazi ake pa nyanga za guwa lansembe ndi chala chako, ndipo tsanulani chonchi pa muundo wa guwa lansembe.
Tenga mafuta onse ozungulira m'mimba mwake, chivundi chachikulu cha chisolole, ndi impso ziwiri ndi mafuta ake ozungulira, ndipo yapikani pa guwa lansembe.
Kenaka nyama yonse ya ng'ombe — zikopa, nyama, ndi udzu — yotcheni kunja kwa msasa ngati nsembe ya tchimo.
'Pamenepo Aroni ndi ana ake adzaike dzanja lawo pa mutu wa nkhumba imodzi.
Kenaka ipha nkhumba, ndipo iphweteke magazi pa mbali zonse za guwa lansembe.
Tumula nkhumba pa zigawo, ndi samba m'mimba mwake ndi miyendo yake. Ziike pamodzi ndi mutu wake ndi zigawo zina,
kenaka yotchani yonse pa guwa lansembe. Ndi nsembe yayotcha kwa Yehova; ndi nthunzi yokomera, chiphatso chapadera chiperewedza kwa Yehova.
'Tsopano tenga nkhumba inayo, ndipo Aroni ndi ana ake adzaike dzanja lawo pa mutu wake.

Kenaka ipha, ndipo ikani magazi ake pa matumbo amayaphe a Aroni ndi ana ake. Ndiponso ndi pamene pa chala chankhono chamanja chawo ndi pa chala chankhono chamayaphe chamanja chawo. Iphweteke chonchi pa mbali zonse za guwa lansembe.
Pamenepo tenga magazi kuchokera pa guwa lansembe ndi mafuta okoza, ndipo uiphweteke pa Aroni ndi ana ake ndi pa zovala zawo. Motero iwo ndi zovala zawo zidzapatulika ngati zopatulika.

'Poyamba kupatula nkhumba ndi chifukwa chake Aroni ndi ana ake, tenga mafuta a nkhumba, mafuta ake a mkamwa wonse, mafuta ozungulira m'mimba, chivundi chachikulu cha chisolole, impso ziwiri ndi mafuta ake ozungulira, ndi chikwapu cha chamanja.
Pamenepo tenga mkate umodzi wozingirira, mikate imodzi wonyoka wolukidwa ndi mafuta, ndi mkate umodzi wochabechabe kuchokera m'dengu la mkate wopanda thobwa woimitsidwa pamaso pa Yehova.
Ikani zonse m'manja mwa Aroni ndi ana ake kuti zinyamulidwe ngati chipereka chapadera kwa Yehova.
Pambuyo pake tenanso michenga yachitatu kuchokera m'manja awo, ndipo yotchani pa guwa lansembe pamodzi ndi nsembe yayotcha. Ndi nthunzi yokomera kwa Yehova, chiphatso chapadera chake.
Pamenepo tenga chitsambo cha nkhumba ya kupatula kwa Aroni, ndipo chinyamulidwe pamaso pa Yehova ngati chipereka chapadera. Kenaka chikhale chagawo chako.
'Patuliraniko zigawo za nkhumba ya kupatula kwa Aroni ndi ana ake. Izi zikuphatikizapo chitsambo ndi chikwapu chimene zinyamulidwa patsogolo pa Yehova ngati chipereka chapadera.
M'tsogolo, anthu a Isiraeli akapereka nsembe ya mtendere, gawo lawo liyenera kukhala la Aroni ndi zidzukulu zake. Ichi chikhale ufulu wawo wosatha, chiphatso choyera kwa Yehova.
'Zovala zoyera za Aroni zikhale za zidzukulu zake zimene zidzam'tsatire, ndi azivale pa nthawi ya kuzozedwa ndi kusuungidwa kwao.
Wazilichilidwa amene adzam'tsatire ngati mkulu wa awansembe azivale masiku asanu ndi awiri, akutumikira m'hema la kusonkhana ndi m'chipinda chopatulika.
'Tenga nkhumba yopatula, ndipo phika nyama yake m'malo oyera.
Pamenepo Aroni ndi ana ake adzadya nyama imeneyo ndi mkate mu dengu, ku mlomo wa hema la kusonkhana.
Iwo okha ndi amene angadye nyama ndi mkate wogwiritsidwa ntchito pakupereka zawo mzako. Palibe mnzake angadye izo, pakuti ndi zopatulika.
Ngati chilichonse cha nyama kapena mkate ya mzako chosala mpaka m'mawa, uchiyotche. Asadyedwe, pakuti ndi choyera.
'Motero mudzasunga Aroni ndi ana ake ngati mmene ndinakulamulirani. Mwambo wa kusunga udzamangirira masiku asanu ndi awiri.
Tsiku lililonse mukapereke ng'ombe wamwamuna ngati nsembe ya tchimo yokuyeretseni, nakuchitira chilungamo. Pambuyo pake, yeretsani guwa lansembe ndi kulipatulira; kuliozani ndi mafuta.
Yeretsani ndi kulipatulira guwa lansembe masiku asanu ndi awiri. Pambuyo pake, guwa lansembe lidzakhala loyera kwambiri, ndipo chilichonse chimene chikhudze lidzakhala choyera.
'Izi ndi nsembe zimene muyenera kuzipereka nthawi zonse pa guwa lansembe. Tsiku lililonse, upereke ana awiri a nkhumba ochepera zaka.
Imodzi m'mawa ndi wina madzulo.
Pa imodzi, upereke ma lita awiri a ufa wosankhidwa wosanjikidwa ndi lita imodzi ya mafuta otsiriridwa; ndiponso lita imodzi ya vinyo ngati chipereka cha madzi.
Upereke nkhumba wina madzulo, pamodzi ndi chipereka chimodzimodzi cha ufa ndi vinyo monga m'mawa. Ndi nthunzi yokomera kwa Yehova, chiphatso chapadera chake.
'Nsembe izi zayotcha ziperewedze tsiku lililonse m'badwo ndi m'badwo. Ziperewedzedwe pamaso pa Yehova pa mlomo wa hema la kusonkhana; kumeneko ndidzakumana nawe ndikuyankhula nawe.
Kumeneko ndidzakumana ndi anthu a Isiraeli, ndipo hema la kusonkhana lidzayeretsedwa ndi ulemu wanga.
Inde, ndidzapatulira hema la kusonkhana ndi guwa lansembe, ndipo ndidzapatulira Aroni ndi ana ake kuti anditumikire ngati awansembe.
Kenaka ndidzakhala pakati pa anthu a Isiraeli ndikhale Mulungu wawo,
ndipo iwo adzadziwa kuti ndine Yehova Mulungu wawo. Ndine amene ndanaturutsa ku Igupito kuti ndizakhale pakati pawo. Ndine Yehova Mulungu wawo.
'Pamenepo panga guwa lansembe lina la mtengo wa akasia pokotcha lubani.
Liyenera kukhala la santimita makumi anayi ndi asanu m'mbali yiliyonse — laing'onoing'ono — ndi mamita imodzi chakuya, ndi nyanga pa ngodya zake zoviriridwa ndi gawano limodzi ndi guwa.
Khadzitira pamwamba, m'mbali, ndi nyanga za guwa ndi golide lachena, ndipo liikireko mphete ya golide m'zingalamu mwake.
Panga mphete ziwiri za golide ndipo zikhometse pa mbali zonse pansi pa golide zikhome kuti zisunge miti yokuyendetsa.
Panga miti ya mtengo wa akasia ndi kuikhadzitira golide.

Ikira guwa lansembe la lubani patsogolo pa nsalu ya mkati yophimba Bokosi la Pangano, patsogolo pa chiphiko cha Bokosi — malo adzozola — yophimba maodzilapa amene ndidzakupatsa. Kumeneko ndidzakumana nawe.
'Tsiku lililonse Aroni akakonzekera malampu, ayenera koyotcha lubani wookera pa guwa lansembe.
Ndi pa nthawi yoika malampu madzulo, ayenera ndinso koyotcha lubani pamaso pa Yehova. Ichi chikhale chosatha m'badwo ndi m'badwo.
Musapereke lubani wosiyana pa guwa lansembe ili, kapena nsembe yayotcha, chipereka cha ufa, kapena chipereka cha madzi.

Kamodzi pa chaka Aroni ayenera kuyeretsera guwa lansembe pakukhadzitira nyanga zake ndi magazi a nsembe ya tchimo. M'badwo ndi m'badwo, imachitike kamodzi pa chaka — chifukwa guwa ili ndi loyeradi kwambiri kwa Yehova.
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose,
'Ukayesa anthu a Isiraeli chiwerengero, aliyense amene awezedwa ayenera kulipira nsamba kwa Yehova. Pamenepo mliri sudzawagwera pakuwerengeka kwawo.
Aliyense amene awezedwa ayenera kupereka hafu ya shekel ngati chipereka choyera kwa Yehova. (Kulipira ndi hafu ya shekel, monga shekel ya nyumba yopatulika, imene iri minahiga makumi awiri.)
Onse amene afikira zaka makumi awiri azipeleke chipereka choyera kwa Yehova.
Popatsa chipereka ichi kwa Yehova kuyeretsera moyo wanu, nzeru asapereke zambiri kuposa zimene zasankhidwa, ndipo wosauka sapereke zochepa.
Landira ndalama imeneyi kuchokera kwa Aisraeli, ndi uigwiritse ntchito pa kuyangala kwa hema la kusonkhana. Izikhala chikumbuso kwa anthu a Isiraeli pamaso pa Yehova, payeretsedwa moyo wanu.'
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose,
'Panga chimoyo cha mkuwa ndi choyimirira cha mkuwa. Ikira pakati pa hema la kusonkhana ndi guwa lansembe, ndi uizadze ndi madzi.
Aroni ndi ana ake adzasamba m'menemo m'manja ndi mapazi awo.
Azisamba ndi madzi kalikonse akamulowa m'hema la kusonkhana kuwonerana pamaso pa Yehova ndipo akapita ku guwa lansembe kuyotcha zinthu zapadera kwa Yehova — kapena adzapha!
Azisamba m'manja ndi mapazi awo nthawi zonse, kapena adzapha. Ichi ndi chilamulo chosatha kwa Aroni ndi zidzukulu zake, chisuungidwe m'badwo ndi m'badwo.'
Pamenepo Yehova anauza Mose,

'Sonkhanitsa zingwe zosankhidwa — kilogramu asanu ndi awiri ndi hafu za miriya lachena, kilogramu zitatu ndi chimodzi ndi hafu cha sinimoni wookera, kilogramu zitatu ndi chimodzi ndi hafu cha kalamu wookera,
ndi kilogramu asanu ndi awiri ndi hafu za kasia — monga wezedwa ndi shekel ya nyumba yopatulika. Ndiponso lita limodzi la mafuta a olivi.
Ngati mlukidwa wanzeru wa lubani, pangani mafuta oyera okoza. Ndi mafuta opatulika okoza.
Gwiritsa ntchito mafuta opatulika okoza kuzoza hema la kusonkhana, Bokosi la Pangano,
tebulo ndi zida zake zonse, chisoko cha kuwala ndi zida zake, guwa lansembe la lubani,
guwa lansembe la nsembe yayotcha ndi zida zake zonse, ndi chimoyo ndi choyimirira chake.
Patuliraniko iwo kuti akhale oyeradi. Pambuyo pa izi, chilichonse chikhudze chidzakhala choyera.
'Zozanso Aroni ndi ana ake, nawapatulire kuti azindulambire ngati awansembe.
Ndipo uze anthu a Isiraeli, "Ichi ndi mafuta opatulika okoza osawaika m'badwo ndi m'badwo.
Asagwiritsidwe ntchito kuozera munthu aliyense wina, ndipo musapange khalidwe lofanana nazo. Ndi opatulika, ndipo muyenera kuzisunga ngati zopatulika.
Aliyense amene apanga khalidwe lofanana nazo kapena kuozera wina osakhala wansembe adzachotsedwa ku banja lako.'

Kenaka Yehova anauza Mose, "Sanga zonunkhira izi — resin, chitsamba cha nyumba ya nyanja, ndi galbanum — ndipo panga khalidwe lopatulika ndi lofifi la lubani wangwiro, wolozana pang'ono ndi pang'ono."
Panga khalidwe la lubani potsata njira za opanga lubani, ndipo uwufafanize ndi mchere kuti ube wangwiro ndi wopatulika.
Penta pang'ono wa khalidwe limeneli kukhala ufa wofewa kwambiri, ndipo uike patsogolo pa Bokosi la Pangano m'Hema la Kusonkhana, kumene ndikumana nawe. Uyenera kuzisamalira ngati zopatulika kwambiri.
Usapange lubani wokhala ndi khalidwe limeneli kwa inu nokha. Wosungidwa kwa Yehova basi, ndipo muyenera kumusamalira ngati wopatulika.
Aliyense amene apanga lubani wofanana ndi umenewu kuti azigwiritsa ntchito yake yekha adzachotsedwa mu gulu."
Kenaka Yehova anauza Mose,
"Taona, ndasankha Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mdzukulu wa Huri, wa fuko la Yuda.
Namdzaza ndi Mzimu wa Mulungu, ndi nzeru, luso, ndi chidziwitso cha maukwala onse.
Ndi katswiri wa maukwala, wopanga zinthu zagolide, zasiliva, ndi zabronze.
Adziwa kukhudza miyala yokongola ndi matabwa. Ndi katswiri wa maukwala onse!
"Ndipo napereka Oholiabi mwana wa Ahisamaki wa fuko la Dani kukhala womunyamukira. Komanso napatsa luso lapadera anthu onse a maukwala kuti apange zonse zimene ndakuuza kuzipanga:
Hema la Kusonkhana; Bokosi la Pangano; chivundikiro cha Bokosi — malo ochilikira; zikopa zonse za Hema la Kusonkhana;
tebulo ndi ziwiya zake; chale cha golide wangwiro ndi zonse za chalo; guwa lansembe la lubani;
guwa lansembe yaotcha ndi ziwiya zake zonse; beseni ndi chokwimira chake;
zovala zosungidwa bwino — zovala zopatulika za Aroni wansembe, ndi zovala za ana ake aamuna kuti atumikire ngati ansembe;
mafuta odzioza ndi lubani wowunkhira wa malo opatulika. Atsopana adzapanga chilichonse monga ndakukuuzani."
Kenaka Yehova anauza Mose malamulo awa:

"Uza anthu a Isiraeli kuti: 'Samalirani bwino Sabata langa, pakuti Sabata ndi chizindikiro cha pangano pakati panga ndi inu kwa mibadwo yonse. Linaperekedwa kuti muzindikire kuti Ine ndine Yehova, amene akupatsani ucheni.
Muyenera kusunga tsiku la Sabata, pakuti ndi tsiku lopatulika kwa inu. Aliyense amene alipoteza adzaphedwa; aliyense amene agwira ntchito tsiku limenelo adzachotsedwa mu gulu.

Muli ndi masiku asanu ndi limodzi a sabata yoyendayenda ntchito yanu, koma tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri lakhala Sabata la mpumulo wonse, tsiku lopatulika lodikiriridwa kwa Yehova. Aliyense amene agwira ntchito pa Sabata adzaphedwa.
Anthu a Isiraeli ayenera kusunga Sabata mwa kuisungirira kwa mibadwo yonse. Ndi mangano okhazikika kwa nthawi yonse.

Ndi chizindikiro chokhazikika cha pangano langa ndi anthu a Isiraeli. Pakuti mu masiku asanu ndi limodzi Yehova analenga kumwamba ndi dziko lapansi, koma pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri anayimitsa ntchito nakhala wosangalala."
Yehova atamaliza kulankhula ndi Mose pa Phiri la Sinai, anamupatsa mbale ziwiri zamiyala, zolemba pangano, zolemba ndi chala cha Mulungu.

Anthu ataona kuti Mose akuchedwa kubwera pansi pa phiri, anasonkhana kwa Aroni. 'Bwerani,' anati, 'tipangire milungu imene itsogolere ife. Sitikudziwa chimene chinachitikira Mose ameneyu amene anatibweretsa kuchoka ku Igupito.'
Choncho Aroni anati, 'Tulutsani mphete zagolide kuchipewa cha akazi anu ndi ana anu aamuna ndi aakazi, ndipo mubweretse kwa ine.'
Anthu onse anatulutsira mphete zagolide kuchipewa chao nabweretsa kwa Aroni.
Kenaka Aroni analandira golide, nagusya, napanga mfano wa mbuzi wa ng'ombe. Anthu ataona, anatukuma, 'Aisiraeli, awa ndi milungu imene inakubweretse kuchoka ku Igupito!'
Aroni ataona kuti anthu anasangalala kwambiri, anamanga guwa lansembe patsogolo pa mbuzi. Ndipo analengeza, 'Mawa likhala chikondwerero cha Yehova!'
Anthu anadzuka m'mawa moyo, napereka nsembe zaotcha ndi nsembe za mtendere. Kenaka anakondwera ndi chakudya ndi kumwa, ndinso anasewera mwachigololo.
Yehova anauza Mose, 'Pita! Tsika msanga! Anthu ako amene unawabweretsa kuchoka ku Igupito achita chiphonyeko.

Mwamsanga anatembenuka njira imene ndinawauza kutsata! Anagusya golide, napanga mbuzi wa ng'ombe, nawerama kupembedza napereka nsembe. Akuti, "Awa ndi milungu yako, Aisiraeli, imene inakubweretse kuchoka ku Igupito."
Kenaka Yehova anati, 'Naona kuti anthu awa ndi akukulupirira ndi oukira.
Tsopano ndisiye kuti mkwiyo wanga wowaka ukawononge ife. Ndipo ndidzakupatsa iwe, Mose, kukhala mtundu waukulu.'
Koma Mose anayesa kupempha Yehova Mulungu wake. 'Yehova!' anati. 'N'chifukwa chiyani mukwiyira anthu anu amene munawabweretsa kuchoka ku Igupito ndi mphamvu yaikulu ndi dzanja lamphamvu?

N'chifukwa chiyani mupase aEgipito mwayi woti ati, "Mulungu wawo anawapulumutsa ndi cholinga choyipa chobawa iwo kumadera aphiri nawamazitsa kuchoka pa dziko lapansi"? Tembenukani ku mkwiyo wanu wowaka. Sinthani maganizo anu pa tsoka lolusa imeneyi limene munaopseza anthu anu!

Kumbukirani atumiki anu Abrahamu, Isaki, ndi Yakobo. Munalumbira kwa iwo, mukunena, "Ndidzachulukitsa zipatso zanu ngati nyenyezi zakumwamba. Ndipo ndidzawapatsa dziko lonse ili limene ndinalonjeza zipatso zanu, nadzalikhala lawo kwamuyaya.'
Choncho Yehova anapilira maganizo ake pa tsoka limene anaopseza kuchiitira anthu ake.
Kenaka Mose anatembenuka natsika phiri. Ananyamula mbale ziwiri zamiyala zolemba pangano m'manja mwake. Zolemba anali mbali zonse, kutsogolo ndi kumbuyo.
Mbale zija zinali ntchito ya Mulungu; mawu azolemba ainalemba Mulungu mwini.
Yoswa atamva phokoso la anthu owoomba ndi wosangalala kumzinda wansi kwao, anauza Mose, 'Kumzinda kumamveka ngati nkhondo!'
Koma Mose anayankha, 'Ai, si kulira kwa ochita, kapena kulira kwa athakanizidwa. Ndimva mfundo ya chikondwerero.'
Atatse kumzinda, Mose anaona mbuzi wa ng'ombe ndi anthu akusewera, ndipo mkwiyo wake unawaka. Anagwetsa mbale kuchalo chake pamiyoyo ya phiri, nakepha.
Anatenga mbuzi amene anapanga naotcha. Ndipo naukuta kukhala ufa, nawuponya m'madzi, nakalamula anthu kumwa.
Pamapeto pake, anatembenuka kwa Aroni nafunsa, 'Anthu awa anakuchitira chiyani kuti ubweretse tchimo lolusa ilo pa iwo?'
'Usachite mkwiyo, mbuye wanga,' Aroni anayankha. 'Iweyo ndiwe wodziwira kuti anthu awa ndi oipa.
Anandauza kuti, "Tipangire milungu yotsogolera ife. Sitikudziwa chimene chinachitikira Mose ameneyu amene anatibweretsa kuchoka ku Igupito."
Choncho ndinawauza kuti, "Aliyense ali ndi golide, atulutsire." Atandibweretsa, ndinaigwetsa m'moto — ndipo thabwalo la mbuzi inokhayo linatuluka!'
Mose anaona kuti Aroni analola anthu kutayika msewu kwambiri, mpaka kudabwitsa adani ao.
Choncho anayimirira pakhomo la msasa nati, 'Onse amene ali mbali ya Yehova, bwera kuno kwa ine!' Ndipo Alevi onse anasonkhana kwa iye.

Mose anawauza, 'Yehova, Mulungu wa Isiraeli, akunena kuti: "Aliyense wa inu atenge lupanga lake ndipo yendani kuyenda m'msasa wonse, kumene kumene. Phanji aliyense — ngakhale abale, anzanu, ndi aumba anu.'
Alevi anachita monga Mose analamulira, ndipo anthu okwana pafupifupi 3,000 anaphedwa tsiku limenelo.
Kenaka Mose anauza Alevi, 'Lero mwadziphatikiza nokha kwa Yehova, ngakhale kunali kutanthauza kuphetsa ana ndi abale anu. Lero mwalandira dalitso.'
Tsiku linasokata Mose anauza anthu, 'Machimo anu ndi aakulu kwambiri, koma ndibwerera kwa Yehova pa phiri. Mwina ndingalandire chikhululukiro cha tchimo lanu.'
Choncho Mose anabwerera kwa Yehova nafunsa, 'Ah, anthu awa achita tchimo lolusa kwambiri. Apanga milungu ya golide kwa iwo okha.
Koma ngati mukhululukira tchimo lawo — ndipo ngati msakukhululukira, ndifutseni dzina langa mu buku limene munalemba!'
Koma Yehova anayankha Mose kuti, 'Ai, ndidzafutsa dzina la aliyense amene wanditchimwira.
Tsopano pita, utsogolere anthu ku malo amene ndinakuuza. Taona! Mngelo wanga adzatsogolere. Ndipo nditafika nthawi yongoyankhula ndi anthu, ndidzawayankhula za machimo ao."
Kenaka Yehova anawapha anthu ndi mliri waukulu chifukwa chophembera mbuzi amene Aroni anapanga.
Yehova anauza Mose, 'Nyamuka, iwe ndi anthu amene unabweretsa kuchoka ku Igupito. Pita ku dziko limene ndinalonjeza Abrahamu, Isaki, ndi Yakobo. Ndinawauza, "Ndidzapatsa dziko ili zipatso zako.'
'Ndipo ndidzatuma mngelo wako kutsogolo kwako kukumbutsa aKanani, aAmori, aHiti, aPerezi, aHivi, ndi aYebusi.
Pita ku dziko lonyiririka mkaka ndi uchi. Koma Ine sidzayenda pakati panu, chifukwa ndinu okulupirira ndi oukira. Ndikayenda ndi inu ngakhale kwa nthawi pang'ono, ndikadyetsa anthu onse."
Anthu atanamva mawu olusa awa, anachita chisoni ndipo anayimitsa kuvala zikopa ndi zovala zosangalatsa.

Pakuti Yehova anauza Mose kuwauza kuti, 'Ndinu okulupirira ndi oukira. Ndikayenda ndi inu ngakhale kwa nthawi pang'ono, ndikadyetsa anthu onse. Choncho tulutsani zikopa ndi zovala zosangalatsa, ndipo ndidzaona chimene ndichite ndi inu.'
Choncho kuyambira pamene anachoka pa Phiri la Sinai, Aisiraeli sanachitanso kuvala zikopa kapena zovala zosangalatsa.
Chinali chizolowezi cha Mose kutenga Hema la Kusonkhana nakuikhira patali ndi msasa. Aliyense amene afuna kulomba kwa Yehova adza ku Hema la Kusonkhana kunja kwa msasa.
Nthawi iliyonse Mose atalowera ku Hema, anthu onse anadzuka nayimirira pa khomo la hema lawo. Anayangana Mose mpaka atalowera mkati.
Atalowa mu hema, chipululu cha mtambo chinatsika nakakhazikika pa khomo pake pomwe Yehova analankhula ndi Mose.
Anthu ataona mtambo ukuyimirira pakhomo pa hema, anayimirira nawerama patsogolo pa mahema ao.

Mkati mwa Hema la Kusonkhana, Yehova analankhula ndi Mose nkhope ndi nkhope, monga mwa anthu oyankhalanso. Pambuyo pake Mose anabwerera ku msasa, koma mnyamata wamuyamukira, Yoswa mwana wa Nuni, anakhalabe mkati mwa Hema la Kusonkhana.

Tsiku lina Mose anauza Yehova, 'Mukudziwa kuti, "Tenge anthu awa kupita ku Dziko Lolonjezedwa." Koma simunandiuze amene mudzatuma ndi ine. Munandiuza kuti, "Ndidzikudziwa ndi dzina lako, ndipo ndimaona bwino kwa iwe."
Ngati ndi zoona kuti mumaona bwino kwa ine, ndizisani njira zanu kuti ndikudziwe bwino ndi kukondererana ndi chisomo chanu. Ndipo kumbukirani kuti mtundu uwu ndi anthu anu nokha."
Yehova anayankha, 'Ine mwini ndidzayenda ndi iwe, Mose, ndipo ndidzakupatsa mpumulo — zinthu zonse zidzakhala bwino kwa iwe.'
Kenaka Mose anati, 'Ngati simudzayenda nafe, musatitume kuchoka pa malo ano.

Ndani adzadziwa kuti mukuona bwino kwa ine — ine ndi anthu anu — ngati simudzayenda nafe? Pakuti kukhalapo kwanu pakati petu ndiko kutipatukanya ife ndi anthu anu ndi mitundu ina yonse ya dziko lapansi."
Yehova anayankha Mose, 'Inde ndidzachita chimene wakupempha, chifukwa ndikuona bwino, ndikudziwa ndi dzina lako.'
Mose anayankha, 'Ndikusonyezeni ulemerero wanu.'

Yehova anayankha, 'Ndidzapereka ubwino wanga wonse kukhodza iwe, ndipo ndidzalengeza dzina langa, Yehova, patsogolo pako. Pakuti ndidzachitira chifundo amene ndidzasankha, ndipo ndidzachitira chisoni amene ndidzasankha.
Koma sudzatha kuona nkhope yanga mwachindunji, pakuti palibe amene angandione nakhala ndi moyo."
Yehova anapitiriza, 'Taona, imirira pachitsulo ichi pali mbali yanga.
Ulemerero wanga ukakhodza, ndidzakubisa m'mpata wa thanthwe ndipo ndidzakuvundikira ndi dzanja langa mpaka nditakhodza.
Kenaka ndidzachotsa dzanja langa ndikuonetse kumbuyo kwanga. Koma nkhope yanga sidzaonedwa."
Kenaka Yehova anauza Mose, 'Yera mbale ziwiri zamiyala zofanana ndi zoyamba izo. Ndizilemba mawu omweo amene analipo pa mbale imene unapha.
Ikokerere mmawa kukwera pa Phiri la Sinai ndipo ndizozere patsogolo panga pamwamba pa phiri.
Palibe wina amene ayenera kukubwera ndi iwe. Mwachionetsero, palibe munthu woyenera kuonekera pa phirilo lonse. Ngakhale ng'ombe ndi nkhosa zisalipire chakudya pafupi ndi phirilo."
Choncho Mose anayera mbale ziwiri zamiyala zofanana ndi zoyamba izo. Mmawa woyamba anakwera pa Phiri la Sinai monga Yehova anamulamulira, nanyamula mbale ziwiri zamiyala m'manja mwake.
Kenaka Yehova anatsika mu mtambo nayimirira naye; ndipo analengeza dzina lake lonse, Yehova.
Yehova anakhodza patsogolo pa Mose, nalengeza, 'Yehova! Yehova! Mulungu wa chifundo ndi chisomo! Ndimakhalira mkwiyo nzeru ndipo ndi wodzaza ndi chikondi chokhazikika ndi kukhulupirika.

Ndimapereka chikondi chokhazikika kwa mibadwo chikwi. Ndikhululukira zosalakwa, zoukira, ndi machimo. Koma sindilekerera wachimwa. Ndimaika machimo a makolo pa ana ao ndi zidzukulu zao; banja lonse limakhuzidwa — ngakhale ana a mibadwo itatu ndi inayi."
Mose anagwezuka nthawi yomweyo, nawerama pansi napembedza.

Ndipo anati, 'Ambuye, ngati ndi zoona kuti munandiona bwino, chonde yendera nafe. Inde, anthu awa ndi okulupirira ndi oukira, koma chonde khululukirani zosalakwa zathu ndi machimo athu. Landireni monga umba wanu wopatulikawo."

Yehova anayankha, 'Tarani, ndikupanga pangano ndi inu pamaso pa anthu anu onse. Ndidzachita zozizwitsa zomwe sizinachitike kulikonse pa dziko lapansi kapena mu mtundu uliwonse. Ndipo anthu onse akuzungulira inu adzaona mphamvu ya Yehova — mphamvu yodabwitsa imene ndidzawonetsa kwa inu.
Koma imvani mwachidwi chilichonse chimene ndikuuzani lero. Ndipo ndidzayenda patsogolo panu kukumbutsa aAmori, aKanani, aHiti, aPerezi, aHivi, ndi aYebusi.
"Samalani kwambiri kuti musapange pangano ndi anthu okhala ku dziko kumene mukupita. Ngati mwachita, adzakupangitsani kutsata njira zawo zoipa ndipo mudzagwidwa ndi msampha.
M'malo mwake, muwononge maguwa ao ansembe, muvunje zipanda zawo zopatulika, ndipo mitereze mitengo yao ya Asera.
Mupembedze mulungu wina uliwonse, pakuti Yehova, dzina lake ndi Wachidwi, ndi Mulungu amene achidwira ubale wake ndi inu.
"Musapange pangano la mtundu uliwonse ndi anthu okhala dzikolo. Iwo amatetemera milungu yawo, napereka nsembe kwa iyo. Adzakuitanira inu mudye chakudya cha nsembe zawo, ndipo mudzapita nawo.
Ndipo mudzalandira ana awo aakazi, amene anapereka nsembe kwa milungu ina, ngati akazi a ana anu aamuna. Ndipo adzakopetsa ana anu aamuna kuchita chigololo ndi Ine mwa kupembedza milungu ina.
Musapange milungu ya chigolide kwa inu nokha.

"Musunga Chikondwerero cha Mkate wa Togoli Yayi. Kwa masiku asanu ndi limodzi mkate umene mudye uyenera kupangidwa popanda togoli, monga ndinalamulira. Sunga chikondwerero ichi chaka chilichonse pa nthawi yoikidwa chakuyamba cha chilimwe, mu mwezi wa Abibu, pakuti wakubwera kwa inu mwachoka ku Igupito.
"Woyamba kubadwa wa chirombo chilichonse ndi wanga, kuphatikiza woyamba kubadwa amuna a ng'ombe ndi nkhosa ndi mbuzi zanu.

Bulu woyamba kubadwa angagulidwire Yehova mwa kuwapatsa nkhosa kapena mbuzi. Koma ngati sugulidwe, uyenera kuvunja khosi lake. Ngakhale mwana wanu woyamba kubadwa wa amuna, uyenera kumugulidwa. "Palibe amene ayenera kuonekera patsogolo panga popanda mphatso.
"Muli ndi masiku asanu ndi limodzi a sabata yoyendayenda ntchito yanu, koma pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri muyenera kuyimitsa ntchito, ngakhale pa nyengo ya kulima ndi ya kukolola.
"Muyenera kusunga Chikondwerero cha Zokolola ndi zipatso zoyamba za tirigu, ndi Chikondwerero cha Zokolola Zonse pa mapeto a nyengo ya zokolola.
Katatu mu chaka chilichonse mwamuna aliyense wa Isiraeli ayenera kuonekera patsogolo pa Ambuye Wamkulu, Yehova Mulungu wa Isiraeli.
Ndidzachotsera izo mitundu ina patsogolo panu ndi kulaza malire anu, kotero palibe wina amene adzachidwira kapena kugwira dziko lanu pamene muli patsogolo pa Yehova Mulungu wanu katatu mu chaka.
"Musapereke mwazi wa nsembe yanga pamodzi ndi chakudya chilichonse chokhala ndi togoli. Ndipo palibe chakudya cha nsembe ya Pasika chimene chiyenera kusuungidwa mpaka m'mawa wake.
"Mukamkolola zokolola zanu, bwerani ndi zipatso zabwino kwambiri zoyamba ku nyumba ya Yehova Mulungu wanu. "Musaphike mwana wa mbuzi m'mkaka wa mayi wake."
Kenaka Yehova anauza Mose, 'Lemba mazungumzo awa onse, pakuti amimira maulendo a pangano limene ndikupanga ndi iwe ndi Isiraeli."

Mose anakhala pa phiri paja ndi Yehova kwa masiku makumi anayi ndi usiku makumi anayi. M'nthawi yonse imeneyo analibe chakudya kapena madzi. Ndipo Yehova analembera mbale zamiyala maulendo a pangano — Malamulo Khumi.
Mose atatsika pa Phiri la Sinai anyamula mbale ziwiri zamiyala za pangano m'manja mwake, sanadzindikire kuti nkhope yake inayala chifukwa chalankhula ndi Yehova.
Choncho Aroni ndi anthu a Isiraeli ataona kuyala kwa nkhope ya Mose, anachita mantha kudza kwa iye.
Koma Mose anawaitana ndipo Aroni ndi akulu onse a gulu anabwera kwa iye, ndipo Mose analankhula nawo.
Kenaka anthu onse a Isiraeli anabwera kwa iye, ndipo Mose anawapatsa malamulo onse amene Yehova anamupatsa pa Phiri la Sinai.
Mose atamaliza kulankhula nawo, anakhala ndi nsalu patsogolo pa nkhope yake.
Koma nthawi iliyonse atalowera mu Hema la Kusonkhana kulankhula ndi Yehova, anachotsa nsalulo mpaka atuluke. Ndipo anawapatsa anthu malamulo onse amene Yehova anamupatsa,
ndipo anthu a Isiraeli anaona kuyala kwa nkhope ya Mose. Choncho anakhala ndi nsalu pa nkhope yake mpaka atibwerenso kulankhula ndi Yehova.
Kenaka Mose anasonkhanitsa gulu lonse la Isiraeli nanena, 'Awa ndi malamulo amene Yehova akuuzani kuchita.

Muli ndi masiku asanu ndi limodzi a sabata yoyendayenda ntchito yanu, koma tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri lakhala Sabata la mpumulo wonse, tsiku lopatulika lodikiriridwa kwa Yehova. Aliyense amene agwira ntchito tsiku limenelo adzaphedwa.
Musatenthenso moto m'nyumba zanu pa tsiku la Sabata."
Kenaka Mose anauza gulu lonse la Isiraeli, 'Ichi ndi chimene Yehova alalamura:
Tengani mphatso yopatulika kwa Yehova. Aliyense wa mtima wokondola apereke mphatso izi kwa Yehova: golide, siliva, ndi bronzi;
ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira; nsalu yofewa ndi ubweya wa mbuzi;
zikopa za nkhosa zoduluka ndi zikopa zosalala za mbuzi ya mwana; matabwa a acesia;
mafuta a zaithini a nyale; zipozo za mafuta odzoza ndi lubani wowunkhira;
miyala ya onixi, ndi miyala ina yokongola yosungidwa mu efodi ndi chiswa cha wansembe.
"Bwera, inu nonse okhala ndi luso. Pangani chilichonse chimene Yehova alalamura:
Hema la Kusonkhana ndi hema lake lopatulika, chivundikiro chake, ziokozo, zipalanga, misalaba, zipanda, ndi mazinyalo;
Bokosi ndi zipanda zake zonyamulira; chivundikiro cha Bokosi — malo ochilikira; chitini cha mkati chosunga Bokosi;
tebulo, zipanda zake zonyamulira, ndi ziwiya zake zonse; mkate wa Kuimirira;
kwa nyale, chale, zinthu zake, mikombe ya nyale, ndi mafuta a zaithini a kuwotcha;
guwa lansembe la lubani ndi zipanda zake zonyamulira; mafuta odzoza ndi lubani wowunkhira; chitini cha khomo la Hema la Kusonkhana;
guwa lansembe yaotcha; chizingwe chake cha bronzi ndi zipanda zake zonyamulira ndi ziwiya zake; beseni ndi chokwimira chake;
mizititi ya malo ophatikika; zipanda zawo ndi mazinyalo awo; chitini cha khomo la malo ophatikika;
zitsiku za Hema la Kusonkhana ndi za malo ophatikika ndi ndandanda zawo;
zovala zosungidwa bwino za ansembe kuvala m'malo Opatulika — zovala zopatulika za Aroni wansembe, ndi zovala za ana ake aamuna kuvala ngati ansembe."
Choncho gulu lonse la Isiraeli linachoka kwa Mose nabwerera kumahema ao.

Onse amene mtima wawo unagumutsidwa ndi mzimu wawo unagwedezeka anabweretsa mphatso zawo zopatulika kwa Yehova. Anabweretsa zinthu zonse zofunikira pa Hema la Kusonkhana, pa zochita zake, ndi pa zovala zopatulika.

Amuna ndi akazi onse amene mitima yawo inali yolokoloka anabweretsa kwa Yehova mphatso zawo za golide — zikopa, mphete, mphete za chala, ndi mphete za khosi. Anapereka zinthu zonse za golide ngati mphatso yapadera kwa Yehova.
Onse amene anali ndi zinthu izi anazibweretsa mwaufulu: ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira; nsalu yofewa ndi ubweya wa mbuzi; ndi zikopa za nkhosa zoduluka ndi zosalala za mbuzi ya mwana.
Ndipo onse amene anali ndi siliva ndi bronzi anazipereka ngati mphatso yopatulika kwa Yehova. Ndipo onse amene anali ndi matabwa a acesia anabweretsa agwiritsidwe ntchito mu ntchito.
Akazi onse odziwa kusoka ndi kutambasuka anakonzekera ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira, ndi nsalu yofewa.
Akazi onse olokoloka ndi luso lawo anapinda ubweya wa mbuzi kukhala ulusi.
Akulu anabweretsa miyala ya onixi ndi miyala inapadera yosungidwa mu efodi ndi chiswa cha wansembe.
Iwo anaperekanso zipozo ndi mafuta a zaithini a nyale, mafuta odzoza, ndi lubani wowunkhira.
Choncho anthu a Isiraeli — mwamuna ndi mkazi aliyense amene anafuna kuthandiza ntchito imene Yehova anapatsa iwo kudzera mwa Mose — anabweretsa mphatso zawo nazipereka mwaufulu kwa Yehova.
Kenaka Mose anauza anthu a Isiraeli, 'Yehova wasankha mwachindunji Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mdzukulu wa Huri, wa fuko la Yuda.
Yehova amdzaza Bezaleli ndi Mzimu wa Mulungu, namupatsa nzeru, luso, ndi chidziwitso cha maukwala onse.
Ndi katswiri wa maukwala, wopanga zinthu zagolide, zasiliva, ndi zabronze.
Adziwa kukhudza miyala yokongola ndi matabwa. Ndi katswiri wa maukwala onse.
Ndipo Yehova wapatsa iye ndi Oholiabi mwana wa Ahisamaki, wa fuko la Dani, luso lophunzitsa ena maukwala awo.
Yehova awapatsa luso lapadera ngati okhudza miyala, osaniridwa, omanga nsalu ndi ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira pa nsalu yofewa, ndi asambe. Ndionse maukwala ndi osaniridwa."

'Yehova wapanga Bezaleli, Oholiabi, ndi atswiri ena onse ndi nzeru ndi luso kwa kuchita ntchito iliyonse yophatikizika mu kumanga malo opatulika. Awapangirire ndi kukonzekera Hema la Kusonkhana, monga Yehova alalamura."
Choncho Mose anaitana Bezaleli ndi Oholiabi ndi onse ena amene Yehova anapatsa luso lapadera ndipo anafunitsitsa kuyamba ntchito.
Mose anawapereka zinthu zoperekwa ndi anthu a Isiraeli ngati nsembe zopatulika za kumaliritsa malo opatulika. Koma anthu anakhalabe kubweretsa mphatso zazidzidzi mmawa ulionse.
Pamapeto pake atswiri amene anagwira ntchito mu malo opatulika anasiya ntchito yawo.
Anapita kwa Mose namuuza, 'Anthu apereka zinthu zochuluka moposa zomwe zifunikira kupanga ntchito imene Yehova alalamura!'

Choncho Mose analamula, ndipo uthenga uwu unatumizidwa mu msasa wonse: 'Amuna ndi akazi, musakonzekenso mphatso kwa malo opatulika. Tina ndi zochuluka!' Ndipo anthu anayimitsa kubweretsa nsembe zawo zopatulika.
Zimene anapereka zinali zochuluka koposa kwa kumaliritsa ntchito yonse.
Atswiri odziwa ntchito anapanga mitanda khumi ya nsalu yofewa ya Hema la Kusonkhana. Ndipo Bezaleli anakongoletsa mitanda ndi ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira, ndi makerubi ospangidwa ndi luso.
Mitanda yonse khumi inali ya kukula kumodzi — 42 mapazi kutalika ndi mapazi 6 kupambasuka.
Mitanda isanu inagwirizanitsidwa pamodzi kukhala chitini chachitali chimodzi, ndipo isanu ina inagwirizanitsidwa pamodzi kukhala chitini chachiwiri chachitali.
Anapanga zingwe zamakumi asanu za ulusi wabuluu ndipo anaziika ku mphepete wa chitini chachiwiri chilichonse.
Zingwe makumi asanu ku mphepete wa chitini chimodzi zinagwirizana ndi zingwe makumi asanu ku mphepete wa chitini china.
Kenaka anapanga ziokozo zili golide makumi asanu nazigwirizanitsa pa mitanda yachitali. M'njira yomweyo, Hema la Kusonkhana linakhala logwirizana limodzi.
Anapanga mitanda khumi ndi imodzi ya nsalu ya ubweya wa mbuzi kuchita hema lachivundikiro pa Hema la Kusonkhana.
Mitanda khumi ndi imodzi yonse inali ya kukula kumodzi — 45 mapazi kutalika ndi mapazi 6 kupambasuka.
Bezaleli anagwirizanitsa mitanda isanu kukhala chitini chachitali chimodzi, ndipo mitanda isanu ndi imodzi inagwirizanitsidwa kukhala chitini chachiwiri chachitali.
Anapanga zingwe makumi asanu pa mphepete wa chitini chilichonse chachitali.
Anapanganso ziokozo zili bronzi makumi asanu kugwirizanitsa mitanda yachitali pamodzi. Mnjira yomweyo, hema lachivundikiro linakhala logwirizana limodzi.
Anamaliza hema lachivundikiro ndi kotela ya zikopa za nkhosa zoduluka ndi kotela ya zikopa zosalala za mbuzi ya mwana.
Pa chalo cha Hema la Kusonkhana, Bezaleli anapanga zipalanga za matabwa a acesia.
Chipalanga chilichonse chinali mapazi 15 kutalika ndi intshi 27 kupambasuka,
ndi maziko awiri pansi pa chipalanga chilichonse. Zipalanga zonse zinali zofanana.
Anapanga zipalanga makumi awiri zodaliritsa mitanda ya kutsidwa la kum'mwera kwa Hema la Kusonkhana.
Anapanganso mazinyalo asili ya siliva — mazinyalo awiri pansi pa chipalanga chilichonse, ndi maziko okhazika bwino.
Pa mbali ya kumpoto ya Hema la Kusonkhana, anapanga zipalanga zina makumi awiri,
ndi mazinyalo awo asili a siliva, mazinyalo awiri pansi pa chipalanga chilichonse.
Anapanga zipalanga zisanu ndi chimodzi ku kumbuyo — mbali ya kumadzulo ya Hema la Kusonkhana —
pamodzi ndi zipalanga ziwiri zokhazikika ku ngodya za kumbuyo kwa Hema la Kusonkhana.
Zipalanga za ngodya ziwo zinagwirizana pansi nazimangilira kwambiri pamwamba ndi mphete imodzi, kukhala ngodya imodzi. Zipalanga zonse za ngodya ziwo zinachitidwa m'njira yomweyo.
Choncho ku kumbuyo kwa Hema la Kusonkhana kunali zipalanga zisanu ndi zitatu, zasungidwa mu mazinyalo asili ndi sita a siliva — mazinyalo awiri pansi pa chipalanga chilichonse.
Kenaka anapanga misalaba ya matabwa a acesia yogwirizanitsa zipalanga, misalaba isanu ya mbali ya kumpoto ya Hema la Kusonkhana
ndi isanu ya mbali ya kum'mwera. Anapanganso misalaba isanu ya kumbuyo kwa Hema la Kusonkhana, yakumadzulo.
Anapanga msalaba wa pakati kugwirizana pakati pa zipalanga; unapita ku nkhope zonse ziwiri za Hema la Kusonkhana.
Anaphaka zipalanga ndi golide napanga mphete za golide kusunga misalaba. Kenaka anaphaka misalaba ndi golide.
Pa mkati wa Hema la Kusonkhana, Bezaleli anapanga chitini chapadera cha nsalu yofewa. Anakongoletsa ndi ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira, ndi makerubi ospangidwa ndi luso.
Pa chitini, anapanga zipanda zine za matabwa a acesia ndi ziokozo zine za golide. Anaphaka zipanda ndi golide nazisunga mu mazinyalo asili mane a siliva.
Kenaka anapanga chitini china cha khomo la hema lopatulika. Anachikonzekera ndi nsalu yofewa nachikongoletsa ndi mchinga wokongola wa ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira.
Chitini chinakamikidwa pa ziokozo za golide zomangidwa pa zipanda zisanu. Zipanda pamodzi ndi mipata yake yokongola ndi ziokozo zinapha aka ndi golide, ndipo mazinyalo asanu anasunthidwa mu bronzi.
Kenaka Bezaleli anapanga Bokosi la matabwa a acesia — bokosi lopatulika la intshi 45 kutalika, intshi 27 kupambasuka, ndi intshi 27 kuphwa.
Anaiphaka mkati ndi kunja ndi golide wangwiro, napanga mzingo wa golide kuzungulira.
Anasuntha mphete zine za golide nazimangira ku mapazi ake anayi, mphete ziwiri pa mbali iliyonse.
Kenaka anapanga ndanda za matabwa a acesia nazipha aka ndi golide.
Anasokomeza ndanda m'mphete pazitheka za Bokosi kuti lithe kunyamulidwa.
Kenaka anapanga chivundikiro cha Bokosi — malo ochilikira — cha golide wangwiro. Chinali intshi 45 kutalika ndi intshi 27 kupambasuka.
Anapanga makerubi awiri ku golide wokhwimika nawaikira ku mphepo ziwiri za chivundikiro cha malo ochilikira.
Anakonzekera makerubi ku mphepo zonse ziwiri za chivundikiro cha malo ochilikira, nazikhala chimodzi ndi chivundikiro cha golide.
Makerubi anayangana wina ndi mnzake, nalangalira pansi pa chivundikiro. Ndi mapiko awo atambasula pamwamba, anasunga chivundikiro.
Kenaka Bezaleli anapanga tebulo la matabwa a acesia, intshi 36 kutalika, intshi 18 kupambasuka, ndi intshi 27 kuphwa.
Analipha aka ndi golide wangwiro namangilira mzingo wa golide kumphepete.
Analikongoletsa ndi mphaka ya intshi 3 kuzungulira, napanga mzingo wa golide pa mphaka.
Kenaka anasuntha mphete zine za golide pa tebulo nazimangira ku ngodya zake zine pafupi ndi miyendo inayi.
Mphete ziwo zinamangilidwa pafupi ndi mphaka kusunga ndanda zomwe zinagwiritsidwa kunyamulia tebulo.
Anapanga ndanda izi za matabwa a acesia nazipha aka ndi golide.
Kenaka anapanga ziwiya zapadera za golide wangwiro za tebulo — nkhale, ziyiko, mitsuko, ndi mikombe — yagwiritsidwa kuphulira nsembe za zakumwa.
Kenaka Bezaleli anapanga chale cha golide wangwiro wokhwimika. Anapanga chale chilichonse ndi zokongoletsa zake chimodzi — mazinyalo, msonga, mikombe ya nyale, mibambo, ndi zibalatzo.
Chale chinali ndi nthambi zisanu ndi chimodzi zituluka ku msonga wa pakati, zitatu pa mbali iliyonse.
Nthambi iliyonse ya zisanu ndi chimodzi zinali ndi mikombe itatu yosimba ngati maluwa a amando, ndi mibambo ndi zibalatzo. Zonse zinali chimodzi.
Msonga wa pakati wa chale unakonzedwa ndi mikombe inayi yosimba ngati maluwa a amando, ndi mibambo ndi zibalatzo.
Kunali mibambo ya amando pansi pa gawaniro la nthambi iliyonse pomwe nthambi zisanu ndi chimodzi zinatuluka ku msonga wa pakati, zonse zinali chimodzi.
Mibambo ya amando ndi nthambi ziwo zinali chimodzi ndi msonga wa pakati, zonse zinapha aka ku golide wangwiro.
Anapanganso nyale zisanu ndi ziwiri za chale, mchima wa nyale, ndi mbale, zonse za golide wangwiro.
Chale chilichonse, pamodzi ndi ziwiya zake, chinasungidwa ku paundi 75 za golide wangwiro.
Kenaka Bezaleli anapanga guwa lansembe la lubani la matabwa a acesia. Linali intshi 18 la lifupilo ndi intshi 36 kuphwa, ndi nyanga za ngodya zinayi zospangidwa ku chigawo chimodzi.
Anaphaka pamwamba, pazitheka, ndi pa nyanga za guwa ndi golide wangwiro, napanga mzingo wa golide kuzungulira guwa lonse.
Anasuntha mphete ziwiri za golide nazimangilira ku mbali ziwiri zosiyana za guwa pansi pa mzingo wa golide kusunga ndanda zomwe zinanyamula guwa.
Anapanga ndanda za matabwa a acesia nazipha aka ndi golide.
Kenaka anapanga mafuta opatulika odzoza ndi lubani wowunkhira, potsata njira za katswiri wa lubani.
Kenaka Bezaleli anagwiritsa matabwa a acesia kupanga guwa lansembe yaotcha labwalo. Linali mapazi 7 ndi hafu kupambasuka, mapazi 7 ndi hafu kutalika, ndi mapazi 4 ndi hafu kuphwa.
Anapanga nyanga ku ngodya zake zina zonse kotero kuti nyanga ndi guwa zinali chimodzi. Anaphaka guwa ndi bronzi.
Kenaka anapanga ziwiya zonse za guwa za bronzi — nkhale za phulusa, zishovelo, mbale, mphata, ndi zitunu.
Kenaka anapanga chizingwe cha bronzi natchingira pakati pa mbali ya guwa, pansi pa mphaka.
Anasuntha mphete zine nazimangilira ku ngodya zina zonse za chizingwe cha bronzi kusunga ndanda zonyamulira.
Anapanga ndanda za matabwa a acesia nazipha aka ndi bronzi.
Anasokomeza ndanda m'mphete pazitheka za guwa. Guwa linali lopanda mkati ndipo linali lospangidwa ndi zipalanga.
Bezaleli anapanga beseni la bronzi ndi chokwimira chake cha bronzi ku mbale za bronzi zoperekwa ndi akazi amene anali ntchito ku khomo la Hema la Kusonkhana.
Kenaka Bezaleli anapanga bwalo, lokhazikidwa ndi mitanda ya nsalu yofewa. Pa mbali ya kum'mwera mitanda inali ya mapazi 150 kutalika.
Iyo inali doskoledwa ndi zipanda makumi awiri zasungidwa bwino mu mazinyalo awiri a bronzi. Anakamika mitanda ndi ziokozo za siliva ndi mphete.
Anapanga mitanda ina ya kumpoto — mapazi 150 ya mitanda yadoskoledwa ndi zipanda makumi awiri zasungidwa mu mazinyalo a bronzi. Anakamika mitanda ndi ziokozo za siliva ndi mphete.
Mitanda ya mbali ya kumadzulo inali ya mapazi 75 kutalika, yadoskoledwa ndi ziokozo za siliva ndi mphete ndi zodaliridwa ndi zipanda khumi zasungidwa mu mazinyalo khumi.
Mphepo ya kumadzulo, patsogolo, inali ya mapazi 75 kutalika.

Khomo la bwalo linali ku mphepo ya kummawa, lodzoledwa ndi mitanda iwiri. Chitini cha kutsidwa la kukhozula linali mapazi 22 ndi hafu kutalika ndi ladoskoledwa ndi zipanda zitatu zasungidwa mu mazinyalo atatu.
Chitini cha mbali ya kum'mwera linali la mapazi 22 ndi hafu kutalika ndi ladoskoledwa ndi zipanda zitatu zasungidwa mu mazinyalo atatu.
Mitanda yonse yagwiritsidwa ntchito mu bwalo inali ya nsalu yofewa.
Zipanda zilichonse zinali ndi mazinyalo a bronzi, ndipo ziokozo ndi mphete zonse zinali za siliva. Mipata ya zipanda ya bwalo inapha aka ndi siliva, ndipo mphete zosimika mitanda zinali za siliva.

Anachita chitini cha khomo la bwalo cha nsalu yofewa, nachikongoletsa ndi mchinga wokongola wa ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira. Chinali mapazi 30 kutalika, ndipo kuphwa kwake kunali mapazi 7 ndi hafu, kofanana ndi mitanda ya mbali za bwalo.
Chinali chododozedwa ndi zipanda zina zasungidwa bwino mu mazinyalo azo a bronzi. Mipata ya zipanda inapha aka ndi siliva, ndipo ziokozo ndi mphete zinali za siliva.
Zitsiku zonse zagwiritsidwa ntchito mu Hema la Kusonkhana ndi bwalo zinali za bronzi.
Izi ndi zinthu zomwe zinagwiritsidwa ntchito mu kumanga Hema la Kusonkhana la Pangano. Alevi analemba manambala, monga Mose analamulira, ndipo Itamari mwana wa Aroni wansembe anali wolemba manambala.
Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mdzukulu wa Huri, wa fuko la Yuda, anapanga zonse monga Yehova analamulira Mose.
Anamuyamukira Oholiabi mwana wa Ahisamaki, wa fuko la Dani, katswiri wa kukhudza miyala, osaniridwa, ndi omanga nsalu ndi ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira pa nsalu yofewa.
Anthu anabweretsa nsembe zapadera za golide zakuwereza paundi 2,193, monga kuwerezedwa ndi zikwi za malo opatulika. Golide izi zinagwiritsidwa ntchito konse ku Hema la Kusonkhana.
Gulu lonse la Isiraeli linapereka paundi 7,545 za siliva, monga kuwerezedwa ndi zikwi za malo opatulika.

Siliva iyi inachoka ku msonkho wosonkhedwa ku mwamuna aliyense wolembedwa ku kalembedwe. (Msonkho ndi beka imodzi, yomwe ndi hafu ya zikwi, kutengera zikwi za malo opatulika.) Msonkho unasonkhedwa ku amuna 603,550 amene anadza pa chaka chachiwiri.
Mazinyalo zana za zipalanga za madiwa a malo opatulika ndi za zipanda zomwe zinasunga chitini cha mkati zinafunikira paundi 7,500 za siliva, pafupifupi paundi 75 pa zinyalo lililonse.
Paundi 45 zotsala za siliva zinagwiritsidwa ntchito kupanga ziokozo ndi mphete ndi kupra mipata ya zipanda.
Anthu anapereka monga nsembe zapadera paundi 5,310 za bronzi,
yomwe inagwiritsidwa ntchito kupanga mazinyalo a zipanda pakhomo la Hema la Kusonkhana, ndi guwa la bronzi ndi chizingwe chake cha bronzi ndi ziwiya zonse za guwa.
Bronzi inagwiritsidwanso ntchito kupanga mazinyalo a zipanda zodaliritsa mitanda yozungulira bwalo, mazinyalo a chitini cha khomo la bwalo, ndi zitsiku zonse za Hema la Kusonkhana ndi bwalo.
Anagwiritsa ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira kupanga zovala zopatulika kwa kutumikira mu malo Opatulika. Anapangira Aroni zovala zopatulika, monga Yehova analamulira Mose.
Anapanga efodi wa golide, ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira, ndi nsalu yofewa yosuka.
Anapinda golide kukhala zingwe nzozicheka zochepa kuziluka pamodzi ndi ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira, mu nsalu yofewa — ntchito ya katswiri.
Anapanga mapewa awiri ogwirizana ku mphepo zake ziwiri, yoti igwirizanitsidwe pamodzi.
Chimangilo chake chosangalatsa chinali chophikidwa bwino chimodzi nacho, cha golide, ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira, ndi nsalu yofewa yosuka, monga Yehova analamulira Mose.
Anapanga miyala ya onixi yokhazikidwa mu golide, yakorechera ndi dzina la ana a Isiraeli.
Anawaika pa mapewa a efodi ngati miyala yachikumbutso ya ana a Isiraeli, monga Yehova analamulira Mose.
Bezaleli anapanga chiswa ndi luso, monga efodi — cha golide, ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira, ndi nsalu yofewa yosuka.
Chinali chobwalo, chinali pafupifupi intshi 9 lifupilo ndi intshi 9 kupambasuka, ndi mkutu.
Anaika msere wa miyala inayi: msere woyamba — ndi rubini, topolazi, ndi zamaradi;
msere wachiwiri — ndi emeraldi, safiro, ndi dayamondo;
msere wachitatu — ndi jasinsi, agati, ndi ametisi;
msere wachina — ndi beryili, onixi, ndi yaspi. Iwo zokhazikidwa mu golide mu zokhazikidwa zawo.
Kunali miyala khumi ndi iwiri, imodzi pa dzina la mwana aliyense wa Isiraeli, yocorechera ndi dzina la fuko lililonse la khumi ndi iwiri.
Anapanga macheni agolide odzungulira ku chiswa, ospangidwa cha golide wangwiro.
Anapanga zokhazikika ziwiri za golide ndi mphete ziwiri za golide, nazimangilira ku mphepo ziwiri za mwamba mwa chiswa.
Anakamanga macheni awiri a golide ku mphete ku mphepo ziwiri za chiswa.
Anakamanga maphepo ena a macheni awiri ku zokhazikidwa pa mapewa a efodi.
Kenaka anapanga mphete ziwiri za golide nazimangilira ku mphepo ziwiri za mkati mwa chiswa, pafupi ndi efodi.
Kenaka anapanga mphete zina ziwiri za golide nazimangilira ku tsogolo la efodi, pansi pa mapewa, pafupi ndi mgwirizano womwe chimangilo chosangalatsa chinakamangidwa ndi efodi.

Anakamanga mphete za pansi pa chiswa ku mphete za efodi ndi zingwe zabuluu. M'njira yomweyo, chiswa chinakamangidwa bwino ndi efodi pamwamba pa chimangilo chosangalatsa. Zonse zinachitiridwa monga Yehova analamulira Mose.
Bezaleli anapanga njira yovala pamodzi ndi efodi ya golide wongwiro wa ulusi wabuluu,
ndi ngalande ya mutu wa Aroni pakati pake. Ngalande inazmaliridwa ndi zingwe yokungutika kuti isathyole.
Anapanga matomato a ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira wa uji, nazimanga ku makono a njira.
Anapanganso nyinga za golide wangwiro ndi kuzizika pakati pa matomato pa makono a njira,
ndi nyinga ndi mtomato zingapita kuzungulira makono. Njira iyi inali yovaliwa nthawi iliyonse wansembe akutumikira patsogolo pa Yehova, monga Yehova analamulira Mose.
Anapanga matumba a Aroni ndi ana ake aamuna a nsalu yofewa.
Mpale ndi zovekera zapadera zinali za nsalu yofewa, ndipo zovekera zakupempha zinali za nsalu yofewa yosuka.
Mangoli anali a nsalu yofewa yosuka nakongoledwa ndi ulusi wabuluu, wachifuwa, ndi wafiira, monga Yehova analamulira Mose.
Pamapeto pake, anapanga chizindikiro chopatulika — chidindo cha ucheni — cha golide wangwiro. Ndi korechera ngati chisindiko ndi mawu awa: WOPATULIKA KWA YEHOVA.
Anakamanga chizindikiro ndi chingwe cha buluu ku mpale wa Aroni, monga Yehova analamulira Mose.
Ndipo cha mapeto Hema la Kusonkhana linamalika. Aisiraeli anachita chilichonse monga Yehova analamulira Mose.
Kenaka anabweretsa Hema la Kusonkhana lonse kwa Mose: hema lopatulika ndi zikopa zake zonse, ziokozo, zipalanga, misalaba, zipanda, ndi mazinyalo;
zivundikiro za zikopa za nkhosa zoduluka ndi zosalala za mbuzi ya mwana; chitini cha mkati chosunga Bokosi;
Bokosi la Pangano ndi ndanda zake zonyamulira; chivundikiro cha Bokosi — malo ochilikira;
tebulo ndi ziwiya zake zonse; mkate wa Kuimirira;
chale cha golide wangwiro ndi mikombe yake yoyikidwa bwino, ziwiya zake zonse, ndi mafuta a zaithini a kuwotcha;
guwa la golide; mafuta odzoza ndi lubani wowunkhira; chitini cha khomo la hema lopatulika;
guwa la bronzi; chizingwe chake cha bronzi ndi ndanda zake zonyamulira ndi ziwiya zake; beseni ndi chokwimira chake;
mitanda ya mbali za bwalo; zipanda zawo ndi mazinyalo awo; chitini cha khomo la bwalo; ndandanda ndi zitsiku; ziwiya zonse kugwiritsidwa ntchito pamapembedzo pa Hema la Kusonkhana;
zovala zosungidwa bwino za ansembe kuvala m'malo Opatulika — zovala zopatulika za Aroni wansembe, ndi zovala za ana ake aamuna kuvala ngati ansembe.
Choncho anthu a Isiraeli anatsata malamulo onse a Yehova kwa Mose.
Kenaka Mose anafufuza ntchito yawo yonse. Atazipeza kuti zinachitidwa monga Yehova analamulira, anawapatsa dalitso.
Kenaka Yehova anauza Mose,
'Pa tsiku loyamba la mwezi woyamba yamanga Hema la Kusonkhana.
Ika Bokosi la Pangano mkati ndipo lisunga ndi chitini.
Bweretsa tebulo ndi kuikonza bwino; bweretsa chale naike nyale.
Ika guwa la golide lansembe la lubani patsogolo pa Bokosi la Pangano ndipo manga chitini cha khomo la Hema la Kusonkhana.
Ika guwa lansembe yaotcha patsogolo pa khomo la Hema la Kusonkhana.
Ika beseni pakati pa Hema la Kusonkhana ndi guwa, ndipo uzaza madzi.
Manga bwalo kuzungulira ndipo chimangila chitini cha khomo la bwalo.
"Tenge mafuta odzoza naozera Hema la Kusonkhana ndi zinthu zonse zili mkati mwake; ndiyo nazipatulika zapatulika ndi zinthu zonse zake.
Ozera guwa lansembe yaotcha ndi zinthu zake zonse kulipatulika; guwa lidzakhala lopatulika kwambiri.
Ozera beseni ndi chokwimira chake nazipatulika.
"Bweretsa Aroni ndi ana ake pakhomo la Hema la Kusonkhana ndi awasukule ndi madzi.
Muvalisire Aroni zovala zopatulika, ndi kumdzoza nampatulika, kuti atiziridwe wansembe kwa Ine.
Bweretsa ana ake ndi kuwavalisa matumba.
Ndi kuwadzioza monga unadzoza abambo awo, kuti atiziridwe ansembe kwa Ine. Kudzioza kwao kudzawapanga ansembe kwa nthawi yonse, kwa mibadwo yonse."
Choncho Mose anachita chilichonse monga Yehova analamulira. Anachita zinthu zonse m'mbali iliyonse.
Choncho Hema la Kusonkhana linamangidwa pa tsiku loyamba la mwezi woyamba wa chaka chachiwiri.
Mose anamanga Hema la Kusonkhana mwa kuikhira mazinyalo ake pansi, nasokomeza zipalanga, namangilira misalaba, nayimika zipanda.
Kenaka anatambalitsa zivundikiro pa chalo cha Hema la Kusonkhana nayika pa mwamba zikhazikiko zosunga, monga Yehova analamulira.
Anatenga mbale zamiyala zolemba pangano naziika mkati mwa Bokosi. Kenaka anakamanga ndanda zonyamulira Bokosi, nayika chivundikiro cha Bokosi — malo ochilikira — pamwamba.
Kenaka anabweretsa Bokosi la Pangano mu Hema la Kusonkhana namanga chitini cha mkati kuchisunga kuchoka kuonekera, monga Yehova analamulira.
Kenaka Mose anaika tebulo mu Hema la Kusonkhana, ku mbali yakumpoto ya Malo Opatulika, kunja kwa chitini cha mkati.
Ndipo anakonza mkate wa Kuimirira pa tebulo patsogolo pa Yehova, monga Yehova analamulira.
Anaika chale mu Hema la Kusonkhana pamaso ndi pa tebulo ku mbali ya kum'mwera ya Malo Opatulika.
Kenaka anayatsa nyale mu Hema la Kusonkhana patsogolo pa Yehova, monga Yehova analamulira.
Anaika guwa la golide lansembe la lubani mu Hema la Kusonkhana, mu Malo Opatulika patsogolo pa chitini cha mkati.
Pa guwa analotcha lubani wowunkhira, monga Yehova analamulira.
Anamanga chitini pakhomo la Hema la Kusonkhana,
ndipo anaika guwa lansembe yaotcha pafupi ndi khomo la Hema la Kusonkhana. Pa guwa anapereka nsembe yaotcha ndi nsembe ya ufa, monga Yehova analamulira.
Kenaka Mose anaika beseni pakati pa Hema la Kusonkhana ndi guwa. Nalizaza madzi kuti ansembe asukule.
Mose ndi Aroni ndi ana ake aamuna anasukula manja ndi mapazi awo ndi madzi ake.
Nthawi iliyonse adayandikira guwa kapena kulowapo mu Hema la Kusonkhana anasukula, monga Yehova analamulira Mose.
Kenaka anamanga mitanda yophatikika kuzungulira Hema la Kusonkhana ndi guwa. Ndipo anayimika chitini cha khomo la bwalo. Ndipo pamapeto pake Mose anamaliza ntchito.
Kenaka mtambo unakhala pa Hema la Kusonkhana, ndipo ulemerero wa Yehova unadzaza Hema la Kusonkhana.
Mose sanatha kulowa mu Hema la Kusonkhana chifukwa mtambo unakhazikika pa hema, ndipo ulemerero wa Yehova unadzaza Hema la Kusonkhana.
Tsopano nthawi iliyonse mtambo unatuluka pa Hema la Kusonkhana, anthu a Isiraeli ananyamuka paulendo wawo, nauwutsata.
Koma ngati mtambo sunatuluke, sananyamuka mpaka utatuluka.
Mtambo wa Yehova unali pa Hema la Kusonkhana usana, ndipo usiku moto unawala mkati mwa mtambo kuti banja lonse la Isiraeli lione. Zinachitika m'mapita ao onse.
